title: AI Engineer
description:
**Avant de postuler à un emploi, sélectionnez votre langue de préférence parmi les options disponibles en haut à droite de cette page.**
Découvrez votre prochaine opportunité au sein d'une organisation qui compte parmi les 500 plus importantes entreprises mondiales. Envisagez des opportunités innovantes, découvrez notre culture enrichissante et travaillez avec des équipes talentueuses qui vous poussent à vous développer chaque jour. Nous savons ce qu’il faut faire pour diriger UPS vers l'avenir : des personnes passionnées dotées d’une combinaison unique de compétences. Si vous avez les qualités, de la motivation, de l'autonomie ou le leadership pour diriger des équipes, il existe des postes adaptés à vos aspirations et à vos compétences d'aujourd'hui et de demain.
  
  
**Fiche De Poste**
Applies the principles of software engineering to design, develop, maintain, test, and evaluate computer software that provide business capabilities, solutions, and/or product suites. Provides systems life cycle management (e.g., analyses, technical requirements, design, coding, testing, implementation of systems and applications software, etc.) to ensure delivery of technical solutions is on time and within budget. Researches and supports the integration of emerging technologies. Provides knowledge and support for applications’ development, integration, and maintenance. Develops program logic for new applications or analyzes and modifies logic in existing applications. Analyzes requirements, tests, and integrates application components. Ensures that system improvements are successfully implemented. May focus on web/internet applications specifically, using a variety of languages and platforms. Defines application complexity drivers, estimates development efforts, creates milestones and/or timelines, and tracks progress towards completion. Provides specific functional expertise that is theoretical and conceptual in nature. This expertise is typically acquired through a combination of university education and experience within a field. May have responsibility for supervising others in the capacity of a “player coach” but primary focus is individual expertise. Particularly at higher levels, sophisticated subject matter expertise is a requirement for success. Applies working knowledge and experience in own job discipline. Continues to broaden capabilities and understanding of the company, processes and customers. Solves problems in straightforward situations by analyzing possible solutions using experience, judgment, and precedents. Impacts quality of own work and the work of others on the team. Performs a range of assignments with a moderate level of guidance and direction. Agile Engineering Best Practices
  
  

* Understands the software development lifecycle and how various agile engineering practices can be used (e.g., in planning, requirements analysis, design, coding, unit testing, acceptance testing).
* Understands when to apply agile methodologies vs. traditional methodologies to achieve the best development outcome.
* Applies agile engineering practices (e.g., Extreme Programming techniques such as pair programming and test driven development) in own software development projects. Project Management
* Develops project plans, defines timeframe, and prioritizes tasks to achieve project milestones and deliver intended objectives.
* Identifies the type of resources required to support a project, and makes recommendations for specific people, technology, partners, etc.
* Monitors progress to meet project milestones, timelines, specifications and requirements. Troubleshooting
* Gathers pertinent information about a problem by analyzing data and patterns and identifying underlying issues.
* Researches and recommends more detailed solutions to resolve problems.
* Implements solutions based on advanced knowledge of standard practices and previous experiences; escalates complex or unprecedented issues and needed. Application Development/Programming Develops and tests complex or non-routine software applications and related programs and procedures to ensure they meet design requirements. System and Technology Integration Demonstrates knowledge of advanced and relevant technology; exhibits comfort working with several forms of technology; understands the relationship between applications, databases and technology platforms. Technology Advising/Consulting
* Communicates effectively with customers; listens to customers’ concerns and issues regarding technology; determines customers’ needs and expectations and responds accordingly.
* Ensures that operational teams and subcontractors have a clear understanding of customer requirements; identifies technical issues and provides data to support solutions.
* Considers new ways of using technology to meet or enhance customers’ needs.

**Type De Contrat**
en CDI
  
  
*Chez UPS, égalité des chances, traitement équitable et environnement de travail inclusif sont des valeurs clefs auxquelles nous sommes attachés.*

title: Senior Engineer with Python, Agentic AI, Multi-cloud, MCP along with IAM, Cyber experience
description:
**Job Description**

**Senior Engineer, IAM, Chennai/Pune**

NielsenIQ is looking for an individual who can join our Identity and Access Management (IAM) Program. We are evolving our enterprise Identity and Access ecosystem by embedding AI and machine learning to improve security posture, automation, and user experience at scale. To support this effort, we are seeking a Senior AI/ML Engineer with strong experience in architecting, designing, building, and operationalizing machine learning systems in complex, distributed, and cloud-based environments.
  
  
In this role, you will lead the development of AI-driven identity, access, and security intelligence solutions, working closely with Cybersecurity, Engineering, and AI teams. You will be responsible for designing ML architectures, building production-grade pipelines, deploying models at scale, and driving measurable outcomes through applied AI for supporting out Identity Security initiative. This is a hands-on Senior Engineering role with significant technical ownership and architectural influence.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a self-driven problem solver who enjoys working at the intersection of AI/ML, Cybersecurity, Cloud platforms, and automation, and who wants to be part of growing NIQ global IAM program.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead the design and evolution of the IAM technology stack, ensuring adherence to top-tier security practices across architecture, implementation, monitoring, maintenance, and enhancements.
* Design, build, and evolve AI/ML solutions that analyze identity, access, and behavioral data to detect anomalies, reduce risk, and automate identity security services to enforce IAM, PAM and Secrets Management controls.
* Lead the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data ingestion, feature engineering, model development, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Architect and implement scalable ML pipelines using Python, cloud-native services, APIs, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Partner with Cybersecurity and other Engineering teams to integrate ML models into enterprise IAM, PAM, and Secrets Management workflows and drive roadmap decisions and enterprise-scale adoption and enforcement.
* Apply advanced security engineering principles to analyze, design, develop, deploy, and support complex software solutions and infrastructure upgrades, setting standards for best practices.
* Develop and deploy real-time and batch inference services for identity and access pattern recognition.
* Apply advanced ML techniques (anomaly detection, clustering, classification, graph-based models, etc.,) to human and non-human identity use cases.
* Design model monitoring, drift detection, and performance metrics aligned to security KPIs and business outcomes.
* Leverage cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) for distributed training, model serving, and data processing.
* Drive the adoption of MLOps best practices, including CI/CD for models, versioning, reproducibility, and observability.
* Collaborate with product owners and stakeholders to translate security problems into well-defined ML use cases.
* Communicate technical concepts, trade-offs, and results clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Mentor junior engineers and help establish Cybersecurity engineering standards for applied AI across the organization.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer science, Computer Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field (Master’s preferred).
* 7+ years of software engineering experience, with 4+ years focused on architecting and designing AI/ML systems at global scale (Cybersecurity preferred).
* Strong proficiency in Python and experience building ML systems using modern frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn).
* Hands-on experience with data pipelines, APIs, and distributed systems.
* Broad knowledge of IAM capabilities, identity stores, authentication/authorization, strong authentication, privileged access methodologies, and Zero Trust principles
* Experience deploying and operating ML models in cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP).
* Practical knowledge of MLOps practices, including model versioning, CI/CD, monitoring, and automation.
* Experience working with identity, security, or behavioral data (IAM, access logs, telemetry, or similar domains).
* Familiarity with REST APIs, Git-based workflows, containerization, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Understanding of non-human identities, service accounts, secrets, and automation-driven access patterns is a strong plus.
* Ability to design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, explainability, and operational reliability.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills in ambiguous, real-world environments.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams.
* Proven ability to work independently while driving complex initiatives across large organizations.
* Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a fast-paced environment, balancing risk reduction with business objectives.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, capable of translating complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights for diverse stakeholders.
* Strong ability to work autonomously while influencing cross-functional teams and have proven track record of driving adoption of security best practices across large organizations.

**Additional Information**

**Our Benefits**

* Flexible working environment
* Volunteer time off
* LinkedIn Learning
* Employee-Assistance-Program (EAP)

NIQ may utilize artificial intelligence (AI) tools at various stages of the recruitment process, including résumé screening, candidate assessments, interview scheduling, job matching, communication support, and certain administrative tasks that help streamline workflows. These tools are intended to improve efficiency and support fair and consistent evaluation based on job-related criteria. All use of AI is governed by NIQ’s principles of fairness, transparency, human oversight, and inclusion. Final hiring decisions are made exclusively by humans. NIQ regularly reviews its AI tools to help mitigate bias and ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations. If you have questions, require accommodations, or wish to request human review were permitted by law, please contact your local HR representative. For more information, please visit NIQ’s AI Safety Policies and Guiding Principles: https://nielseniq.com/global/en/info/niqs-ai-safety-policies/

  

**About NIQ**

NIQ is the world’s leading consumer intelligence company, delivering the most complete understanding of consumer buying behavior and revealing new pathways to growth. In 2023, NIQ combined with GfK, bringing together the two industry leaders with unparalleled global reach. With a holistic retail read and the most comprehensive consumer insights—delivered with advanced analytics through state-of-the-art platforms—NIQ delivers the Full View™. NIQ is an Advent International portfolio company with operations in 100+ markets, covering more than 90% of the world’s population.

For more information, visit NIQ.com

Want to keep up with our latest updates?

Follow us on: LinkedIn | Instagram | Twitter | Facebook

  

**Our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**

At NIQ, we are steadfast in our commitment to fostering an inclusive workplace that mirrors the rich diversity of the communities and markets we serve. We believe that embracing a wide range of perspectives drives innovation and excellence. All employment decisions at NIQ are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. We invite individuals who share our dedication to inclusivity and equity to join us in making a meaningful impact. To learn more about our ongoing efforts in diversity and inclusion, please visit the https://nielseniq.com/global/en/news-center/diversity-inclusion

title: AI Platform Engineering (B2B Integration)
description:
**Exp: 7+ yrs**
**Location Option: Chennai - WFO HYBRID**
**Job Description**
**Senior Software Developer – AI Platform Engineering (B2B Integration)**
**Location: Chennai, India (Hybrid / Remote within India)**
**Department: Product Development / AI Engineering**
**Working Model: Agile (Scrum)**
**Experience: 7 –14 Years**
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a highly motivated Senior Software Developer with strong engineering expertise and practical experience in modern AI technologies.
  
  
In this role, you will design and develop enterprise-grade services that combine Java-based microservices, cloud-native architectures, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI-driven workflows.
  
  
You will work closely with software engineers, architects, product owners, and platform teams to deliver scalable, secure, observable, and maintainable solutions for global enterprise customers.
  
  
This position is ideal for developers who enjoy building production-ready systems and applying AI technologies to solve real-world business and integration challenges.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Platform Development**

* Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade backend services using Java and Spring Boot.
* Build scalable microservices and APIs that support AI-enabled platform capabilities.
* Develop integrations between internal systems, cloud services, and external AI platforms.
* Implement event-driven architectures using Kafka or similar messaging technologies.
* Contribute to platform components that support enterprise-scale B2B integration scenarios.

**AI Engineering**

* Develop AI-powered application features using Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions, semantic search, and knowledge retrieval capabilities.
* Design prompt orchestration, context management, and AI workflow logic.
* Integrate AI tools, external services, and agent-based workflows into enterprise applications.
* Contribute to the implementation of AI governance, guardrails, and responsible AI practices.
* Evaluate and adopt emerging AI frameworks, technologies, and engineering approaches.

**Cloud & DevOps**

* Develop and deploy cloud-native applications on modern cloud platforms.
* Build and maintain containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and release processes.
* Support platform scalability, reliability, resilience, and operational excellence.

**Engineering Excellence**

* Implement automated testing strategies including unit, integration, and component testing.
* Participate in architecture discussions, design reviews, and code reviews.
* Apply software engineering best practices, clean code principles, and design patterns.
* Implement observability through logging, metrics, tracing, and monitoring.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues across development, test, and production environments.
* Mentor junior team members and contribute to knowledge sharing within the team.

**Agile Collaboration**

* Actively participate in Scrum ceremonies and Agile development activities.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams across engineering, architecture, product management, and operations.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and engineering excellence programs.

**Required Technical Skills**
**Core Backend Engineering**

* Strong hands-on experience with Java.
* Strong experience with Spring Boot and enterprise application development.
* Solid understanding of microservice architectures and distributed systems.
* Experience designing and developing REST APIs.
* Strong SQL and relational database knowledge (PostgreSQL, Oracle, or similar).
* Experience with event-driven systems and messaging technologies such as Kafka.

**AI & Generative AI**

* Experience working with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, or similar solutions.
* Experience building applications that leverage Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Practical knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.
* Understanding of prompt engineering, context management, and AI workflow patterns.
* Familiarity with vector databases, embeddings, and semantic search concepts.
* Experience with AI application frameworks such as Spring AI, LangChain, LangGraph, or similar.

**Cloud & Platform Technologies**

* Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
* Familiarity with AWS, Azure, or comparable cloud platforms.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
* Understanding of cloud-native application design principles.

**Software Engineering**

* Strong understanding of software quality, testing, and maintainability.
* Experience with Git-based development workflows.
* Knowledge of design patterns and modern software architecture principles.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**
**The following skills are advantageous but not mandatory:**

* Experience with Agentic AI architectures and AI orchestration frameworks.
* Exposure to Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar tool integration approaches.
* Experience with OpenTelemetry and modern observability platforms.
* Knowledge of enterprise integration technologies, API management, or B2B integration concepts.

**Professional Experience**

* 7 –12 years of professional software development experience.
* Strong track record of delivering enterprise-grade backend applications.
* Experience developing microservices and cloud-native solutions.
* Experience working within Agile software development teams.
* Practical experience with AI-enabled applications is highly desirable.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* Equivalent practical experience will also be considered.

title: Director - Business Intelligence
description:
The Data Experience (DEx) practice builds the data foundations, pipelines, and products that power Dentsu's media and marketing effectiveness work across Carat, iProspect, and Dentsu X. We are seeking a Director, Data Engineering to lead our offshore (DGS) engineering capability — owning the architecture, quality, and delivery of the data platform that everything downstream depends on.
  
  
This is a senior leadership and hands-on engineering role. You will set the standard for how DEx ingests, models, and serves media and marketing data on Databricks, and you will do it as a modern practitioner — using AI-assisted data development (Databricks Genie, Copilot, Claude Code) to move faster and raise quality. You will lead and mentor a team of DGS engineers while staying close enough to the code to set the bar yourself. This role demands deep Databricks expertise and a genuine understanding of what media data means, not just how to move it.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Core Skills & Requirements**
Databricks & Data Engineering
  
  

* Deep, hands-on Databricks expertise: Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow / Delta Live Tables, Medallion architecture, and performance tuning.
* Expert-level SQL and strong Python for data engineering; production experience building and operating pipelines at scale.
* Solid grasp of data modeling, orchestration, data quality, and governance — building for reuse and maintainability, not one-off delivery.
* Experience with the surrounding ecosystem (Azure, lightweight ETL / data-prep tooling such as Trifacta or dbt) is a strong plus.

AI-Assisted Data Development
  
  

* Hands-on experience developing data solutions with AI tooling — Databricks Genie, GitHub / Databricks Copilot, Claude Code, or comparable AI coding agents.
* Able to use AI assistants to accelerate pipeline build, transformation logic, and debugging while maintaining correctness, governance, and quality.
* A builder's mindset: comfortable pairing with AI tools as a force multiplier for the team, not a novelty.

Media & Marketing Data Fluency
  
  
*You must understand not just how to engineer the data, but what the data means.*

* Strong command of media and marketing data: what impressions, spend, clicks, and conversions represent, and how they relate.
* Understanding of how reach and frequency work — served vs. viewable impressions, de-duplicated reach, and frequency capping — and the implications for how data must be modeled.
* Familiarity with conversion tracking and attribution mechanics — pixels, tags, post-click vs. post-view, and lookback windows.
* Knowledge of how media data connects across campaigns, placements, creatives, and channels, and how spend flows through to outcomes.
* Practical experience with media taxonomies and naming conventions as the foundation of trustworthy, joinable data.

Leadership
  
  

* Proven experience leading and developing an engineering team, ideally in an offshore / DGS or global delivery model.
* Ability to set architecture and code standards, review work critically, and raise the quality bar across a team.
* Strong communication across time zones with onshore leads and stakeholders.

**Preferred / Nice To Have**

* Experience with streaming / near-real-time ingestion patterns.
* Familiarity with trafficking / ad ops platforms (CM360, Prisma, DV360, TTD) and how their data lands in the platform.
* Exposure to semantic / metrics layers and how engineering choices affect downstream reporting (Power BI, dbt metrics).
* Experience in an agency, ad tech, or marketing analytics environment.
* CI/CD, testing, and DataOps practices for data pipelines.

**Qualifications**

* 12+ years in data engineering, with several years in a leadership or director-level capacity.
* Demonstrated deep Databricks / Lakehouse expertise in production.
* Demonstrated domain knowledge of media and/or marketing data (hard requirement).
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Location:**
DGS India - Chennai - Anna Nagar Tyche Towers
  
  
**Brand:**
Paragon
  
  
**Time Type:**
Full time
  
  
**Contract Type:**
Permanent

title: Assistant Manager
description:
WFM Capacity Planner

**DEPARTMENT : Workforce Management**

**EMPLOYMENT : Full-time**

**REPORTS TO : Assistant Manager/Lead WFM**

**Position Summary**

The WFM Capacity Planner converts demand forecasts into practical, financially responsible workforce plans across programs, sites, channels, and skill groups. The role owns long-range and medium-range capacity views, headcount requirements, hiring and training demand, attrition and shrinkage assumptions, staffing-risk scenarios, and executive-ready recommendations.

The successful candidate connects Operations, Finance, Talent Acquisition, Training, Human Resources, and WFM so that hiring and workforce actions are initiated early enough to protect client service commitments, employee readiness, and cost targets.

**ROLE PURPOSE**

**Maintain a clear view of future workforce demand and supply, quantify risks early, and recommend the right staffing action at the right time.**

Key Responsibilities

Capacity planning and modeling

* Build rolling capacity plans by program, site, channel, skill, and planning horizon.
* Translate volume, AHT or productivity, SLA, backlog, shrinkage, occupancy, and hours of operation into required FTE and headcount.
* Maintain base, upside, downside, and contingency scenarios with transparent assumptions.

Hiring and training demand

* Calculate weekly and monthly hiring needs, class timing, training capacity, nesting, learning curves, hiring yield, and production-readiness dates.
* Track approved demand against recruiting supply, training graduation, deployment, and productive headcount.
* Identify the decision deadlines required to prevent staffing gaps.

Headcount supply and staffing risk

* Reconcile rostered, budgeted, scheduled, and productive headcount with approved positions.
* Incorporate attrition, absenteeism, leave, internal movement, shrinkage, training, and productivity ramp into supply plans.
* Quantify surpluses and deficits and recommend hiring, overtime, redeployment, cross-skilling, schedule changes, or other mitigations.

Scenario and sensitivity analysis

* Model changes in demand, AHT, productivity, service targets, channel mix, automation, site allocation, shrinkage, attrition, and hiring performance.
* Explain the FTE, cost, service, and timing implications of each scenario.
* Present a recommended option, alternatives, risks, assumptions, and decision dates.

Financial and stakeholder governance

* Connect capacity decisions to labor cost, overtime, contractors, idle capacity, recruitment, training, transitions, and budget outlook.
* Lead recurring capacity reviews with Operations, Finance, Talent Acquisition, Training, HR, and WFM.
* Document decisions, owners, due dates, risks, and unresolved assumptions; escalate missed lead times promptly.

Planning quality and continuous improvement

* Maintain version control, assumption logs, model documentation, data-quality checks, and plan-versus-actual analysis.
* Automate recurring reporting and reduce spreadsheet risk through Power Query, Power BI, SQL, Python, or approved tools.
* Protect confidential workforce and financial data and follow contractual, policy, and labor requirements.

Required Qualifications

* At least 3 years of experience in Workforce Management, capacity planning, workforce planning, forecasting, financial planning, or resource planning in a contact-center, BPO, shared-services, or operational environment.
* Demonstrated ability to convert demand forecasts into FTE, headcount, hiring, training, and cost plans across multiple time horizons.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including structured models, PivotTables, XLOOKUP, Power Query, scenario analysis, data validation, and executive-ready outputs.
* Strong knowledge of contact-center and back-office metrics, including volume, AHT, productivity, shrinkage, occupancy, attrition, service level, backlog, utilization, schedule efficiency, and cost per FTE or transaction.
* Experience with a WFM platform such as NICE IEX, Verint, Alvaria / Aspect, Genesys WFM, Calabrio, or an equivalent planning solution.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to explain assumptions, trade-offs, financial impact, and workforce risk to senior stakeholders.
* Ability to work with incomplete data while documenting limitations, confidence levels, and improvement actions.

Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations, or a related discipline.
* Experience supporting multi-site, multi-skill, multilingual, omnichannel, or global operations.
* Experience with Power BI, SQL, Python, or other analytics and visualization technologies.
* Understanding of Erlang-based staffing, simulation, backlog planning, deferred-work capacity, and skills-based routing.
* Experience partnering directly with Finance, Talent Acquisition, Training, Operations, and client-facing leadership.
* Recognized WFM, analytics, finance, Lean, or Six Sigma certification.

How Success Will Be Measured

**KPI**

**CADENCE**

**Capacity-plan accuracy**

FTE and HC reconcile to approved demand, productivity, shrinkage, and service objectives.

Monthly / quarterly

**Hiring-plan attainment**

Classes, training capacity, yield, and production-ready dates are tracked against plan.

Weekly / monthly

**Staffing-gap control**

Material deficits and surpluses are identified early, quantified, assigned, and escalated.

Weekly

**Plan-versus-actual variance**

HC, attrition, shrinkage, productivity, and cost variances include root cause and action.

Monthly

**Scenario quality**

Scenarios are complete, traceable, timely, and explain assumptions and trade-offs.

As required

**Governance quality**

Models are controlled, documented, reproducible, accurate, and delivered on schedule.

**Monthly**

What a Strong Candidate Demonstrates

* Clearly distinguishes demand, workload, required FTE, scheduled FTE, productive headcount, rostered headcount, and budgeted headcount.
* Builds transparent models with an auditable assumption chain rather than unexplained or hard-coded outputs.
* Understands that hiring plans must include lead time, hiring yield, training capacity, graduation, nesting, attrition, shrinkage, and productivity ramp.
* Challenges unrealistic assumptions constructively and quantifies the cost, service, and timing consequences.
* Communicates one recommendation, viable alternatives, key risks, owners, and decision deadlines in a concise executive format.

**READY TO SHAPE THE FUTURE WORKFORCE?**

Apply through the official Movate careers channel. Candidates may be asked to complete a capacity-planning case study as part of the selection process.

title: AI Engineer – AI/ML & Computer Vision
description:
**Position Overview**

We are seeking an innovative AI Engineer with expertise in AI/ML & Computer Vision to revolutionize automated space planning and design. You will build intelligent systems that automatically generate optimal interior layouts, particularly kitchen designs, by combining computer vision, 3D modelling, spatial reasoning, and rule-based design principles. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between AI/ML technologies and interior design expertise to create automated design solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Design Rule Engine Development**
  : Build comprehensive rules engines for interior design constraints (work triangle optimization, ergonomic guidelines, building codes, aesthetic principles)
* **Automated Kitchen Design**
  : Develop systems that analyze room dimensions and automatically place cabinets, appliances, and accessories following design best practices
* **3D Space Planning**
  : Create algorithms for optimal placement of hobs, sinks, refrigerators, and storage solutions based on kitchen workflow principles
* **Spatial Constraint Solving**
  : Implement complex constraint optimization for furniture placement, clearance requirements, and accessibility standards
* **Computer Vision for Space Analysis**
  : Process room scans, floor plans, and measurements to understand spatial constraints and opportunities
* **3D Asset Population**
  : Automatically populate 3D spaces with appropriate furniture, fixtures, and appliances from product catalogs
* **Design Validation**
  : Ensure generated designs meet safety codes, ergonomic standards, and functional requirements
* **Machine Learning for Design Preferences**
  : Build models to understand and predict user design preferences and style choices
* **Multi-constraint Optimization**
  : Balancing aesthetics, functionality, cost, and space utilization
* **Real-time 3D Visualization**
  : Interactive systems for design preview and modification

**Required Technical Skills**

Computer Vision & 3D Processing

* OpenCV
* Open3D
* Detectron2/SAM/similar technologies

Machine Learning & Deep Learning

* PyTorch
* Hugging Face Transformers
* LightGBM/XGBoost
* MLflow
* Data Management

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, or related field
* 3+ years of experience in computer vision and machine learning
* Strong programming skills in Python
* Experience with constraint programming and optimization problems
* Proven track record of building rule-based systems for complex decision-making
* Strong understanding of 3D geometry, spatial relationships, and collision detection
* Experience with version control (Git) and collaborative development

**Preferred Qualifications**

* PhD in Computer Vision, Machine Learning, or related field
* **Interior Design Background**
  : Formal training or significant experience in interior design, architecture, or space planning
* Experience with CAD software (AutoCAD, SketchUp, Revit) or 3D design tools
* Knowledge of kitchen and furniture industry standards and suppliers
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) for ML workloads
* Knowledge of containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes)
* Experience with real-time 3D rendering and visualization
* Familiarity with furniture/product catalog management systems
* Experience with generative design algorithms

title: AI architect
description:
**Purpose of the role**

Design and build the Investment Division’s data and AI platform on Databricks/Azure, serving as the technical lead for the three-person AI Lab. Own the platform architecture, integration layer connecting Addepar, Capital IQ, and all data sources to the lakehouse, the serving infrastructure delivering model outputs to dashboards, chat interface, and APIs, and the security and governance framework ensuring regulatory compliance. This role is the bridge between the AI Lab’s technical capabilities and the investment team’s business requirements

**Key responsibilities**

* Design the Databricks lakehouse architecture: medallion schema (bronze/silver/gold), Delta table design, Unity Catalog governance, and vector store configuration.
* Build and maintain the API integration layer: Addepar REST API (ingestion and reverse push), Capital IQ API, eVestment/Mercer feeds, email ingestion (Outlook Graph API), and operating division ERP connectors.
* Design the serving infrastructure: Databricks SQL dashboards, Streamlit/Genie chat interface, REST API endpoints for Addepar and external systems, alert engine, and scheduled report distribution.
* Implement the security and governance framework: Azure Active Directory integration, Unity Catalog role-based access control, encryption (Azure Key Vault), data lineage tracking, and audit trail for IC governance.
* Design the regulated entity isolation architecture (Zone A / Zone B) ensuring Nama Financing customer data stays within the SAMA-compliant perimeter.
* Manage the Databricks workspace: compute cluster sizing, job scheduling, cost optimisation, and capacity planning.
* Attend daily standups with the investment team to understand analytical requirements and translate them into technical specifications for the data engineer and ML engineer.
* Review and approve all code deployments, data model changes, and infrastructure modifications.
* Plan the platform’s extension from the Investment Division to the five operating divisions (Waves 2–5).
* Evaluate and recommend technology decisions: vendor selection, open-source vs commercial tools, build vs buy.

**Qualifications and experience**

* 8–12 years of experience in data engineering and platform architecture, with at least 3 years on Databricks or equivalent lakehouse platforms.
* Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, Spark, Delta Lake, and MLflow.
* Experience with Azure cloud services: Azure Data Factory, Azure Blob Storage, Azure Key Vault, Azure Active Directory.
* Demonstrated experience building API integrations with financial data providers (Bloomberg, Capital IQ, Refinitiv, or similar).
* Understanding of data governance frameworks, RBAC implementation, and regulatory data requirements (financial services preferred).
* Experience with RAG architectures, vector databases, and LLM deployment for enterprise applications.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, data engineering, or equivalent.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate between technical and business stakeholders.
* Experience in financial services, wealth management, or investment operations strongly preferred.

title: Knowledge Architect
description:
**About the Role**

Purple Fabric is looking for a
**Knowledge Architect**
to own the architecture and evolution of its enterprise knowledge plane — the foundation that enables AI agents and products to understand, retrieve and use enterprise information reliably.

You will shape how information is ingested, processed, represented, secured, retrieved, evaluated and reused across Purple Fabric and its related platforms.

This is a hands-on architecture role combining enterprise knowledge systems, RAG, semantic and graph technologies, data governance and production engineering. You will work closely with product and engineering teams to turn complex knowledge requirements into scalable, reusable platform capabilities.

**What You Will Own**

**1. Knowledge-Plane Architecture**

* Define the architecture, boundaries and interfaces across ingestion, parsing, OCR, chunking, metadata, embeddings, vector search, semantic and graph structures, retrieval, reranking and citations.
* Guide the evolution of the knowledge plane across enterprise AI use cases.

**2. Knowledge Representation**

* Design flexible models for documents, entities, relationships, provenance and semantic context.
* Determine when vector, relational, graph or hybrid approaches are appropriate.

**3. Retrieval Quality**

* Define architecture for RAG, hybrid search, self-query, reranking and context assembly.
* Establish measurable retrieval and evaluation criteria to assess knowledge coverage, relevance, completeness and answer quality.

**4. Knowledge Lifecycle and Governance**

* Own versioning, refresh, deletion, lineage, access-control propagation and tenant isolation.
* Address data residency, retention and policy enforcement throughout the knowledge lifecycle.

**5. Scale, Performance and Cost**

* Define measurable targets for ingestion throughput, indexing and search latency, storage growth, retrieval quality and cost.
* Guide benchmarking, capacity planning and performance optimisation.

**6. Reusable Platform Capabilities**

* Translate recurring Purple Fabric, MSOCK and customer requirements into reusable knowledge capabilities and adapters.
* Support integrations with customer-managed and external knowledge stores where appropriate.

**7. Proofs of Concept and Technical Execution**

* Prototype high-risk knowledge architecture decisions.
* Review implementations, troubleshoot retrieval and data issues, and use evidence to guide what should be built, refined or retired.

**What You Bring**

* **Production knowledge and RAG architecture:**
  Experience architecting a live enterprise knowledge, search, RAG or semantic platform, with the ability to explain actual data volumes, query characteristics, quality metrics and design decisions.
* **End-to-end ingestion and retrieval expertise:**
  Strong understanding of document processing, metadata, chunking, embeddings, indexing, retrieval, reranking, citations and real-world failure modes.
* **Semantic and graph modelling:**
  Ability to model entities, relationships, ontologies, semantic structures and provenance, and understand when graph-based approaches add value.
* **Evaluation discipline:**
  Experience defining coverage, retrieval relevance, grounding, completeness and answer-quality evaluations beyond subjective demonstrations.
* **Enterprise governance:**
  Understanding of access controls, tenant isolation, PII, lineage, retention, auditability and customer-hosted or data-residency requirements.
* **Hands-on engineering:**
  Ability to prototype using Python, Java or equivalent, review APIs and data models, troubleshoot pipelines and work directly with engineering teams on production issues.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with MongoDB Atlas Search, OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, pgvector, Azure AI Search, Neo4j or other vector, graph and search technologies.
* Exposure to code and software knowledge graphs, ontology-driven systems or engineering knowledge platforms.
* Experience with multi-cloud, customer-hosted and regulated-enterprise deployments.
* Familiarity with agentic AI, knowledge-tool integration, evaluation frameworks and AI-assisted engineering.

**Interested?**

If you have built and evolved enterprise knowledge platforms in production and want to shape how AI systems access and use enterprise knowledge, we'd like to hear from you.

Apply through this LinkedIn job listing or contact the recruiter listed in the accompanying recruitment post.

As Technical Lead, Platform Engineering, you will be the technical authority for our global Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) platform supporting Online Reliability Services (ORS). You will shape the architecture and technical direction across Edge connectivity, Microsoft Azure cloud services, data platforms, APIs, analytics, and customer-facing applications.
  
  
In this role, you will lead the development of secure, scalable, and highly available digital solutions that enable predictive maintenance, equipment reliability, and data-driven services for customers worldwide. Working closely with Product Management, Scrum Masters, software engineers, Edge developers, and domain experts, you will translate business needs into robust technical solutions while driving engineering excellence, cybersecurity, continuous improvement, and platform innovation.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**

* Serve as the technical lead for the global IIoT platform supporting Online Reliability Services (ORS), providing architectural guidance and technical direction across software development teams.
* Own and evolve the end-to-end platform architecture spanning Edge devices and connectivity, Microsoft Azure cloud services, data pipelines, APIs, analytics, and customer-facing applications.
* Design scalable, resilient, secure, and high-performing cloud-native solutions using Azure services, including Azure IoT Hub, cloud messaging, data storage, event-driven architectures, and distributed systems.
* Guide technical design and development across Java, Node.js, C#, REST APIs, microservices, and real-time data processing technologies, ensuring seamless integration between industrial equipment, Edge devices, cloud services, and enterprise applications.
* Establish engineering standards, development practices, and architecture principles that promote maintainability, scalability, software quality, and security.
* Mentor and develop software engineers through technical coaching, code reviews, design reviews, and knowledge sharing, while fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Drive platform operational excellence and maintain availability of 99.9% or greater through effective monitoring, observability, logging, incident management, capacity planning, and performance optimization.
* Lead disaster recovery, business continuity, backup validation, failover strategies, resilience testing, and root-cause analysis for critical production issues.
* Optimize Microsoft Azure infrastructure and resource utilization to balance platform performance, scalability, reliability, and cloud operating costs.
* Champion secure software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices and industrial cybersecurity principles, including IEC 62443, while partnering with infrastructure and cybersecurity teams to identify and mitigate technical risks.
* Partner with Product Management, Scrum Masters, software and Edge developers, data engineers, automation engineers, and domain experts to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.
* Support technical estimation, solution reviews, project and release planning, and clearly communicate technical strategies, dependencies, risks, and recommendations to key stakeholders.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, cloud services, and engineering practices, and contribute to the long-term technology roadmap for IIoT, digital services, and industrial automation.

title: Product Architect
description:
**About the Role**

Purple Fabric is looking for a
**Product Architect**
to own the architecture and technical evolution of its enterprise AI platform.

You will shape how core platform capabilities are designed, how the platform scales and how it operates reliably in production. Working closely with Product and Engineering teams, you will make critical architecture decisions, translate customer and business needs into reusable platform capabilities, and drive technical improvements from concept through release.

This is a hands-on leadership role with significant decision-making authority and accountability for product outcomes. You will combine architectural depth, engineering expertise and a strong understanding of enterprise AI to influence the platform's technical direction.

**What You Will Own**

**1. Core Platform Architecture**

* Define service boundaries, APIs and shared architectural patterns across agent design, runtime, knowledge and governance.
* Make day-to-day architecture decisions and recommend changes that influence the platform's technical direction.

**2. Platform Capability Design**

* Shape platform capabilities in partnership with Product, using roadmap priorities, product usage, production performance and customer feedback.
* Translate recurring customer and business requirements into reusable platform capabilities.
* Establish measurable outcomes to assess the impact of new capabilities.

**3. Proofs of Concept and Technical Validation**

* Lead time-boxed POCs to validate new platform capabilities and high-risk architectural decisions.
* Define success criteria and test solutions using representative enterprise workloads.
* Use evidence and results to decide what to build, refine or discontinue.

**4. Production Scale and Reliability**

* Define measurable targets for platform capacity, latency, availability and cost.
* Guide Engineering and QA teams in benchmarking, performance testing and failure-recovery validation.
* Ensure releases meet performance and security requirements.

**5. Technical Execution and Ownership**

* Prototype critical platform changes and review technical designs and code.
* Resolve cross-team technical blockers and drive architecture decisions through implementation.
* Follow capabilities from design through release and use production insights to guide continuous improvement.

**What You Bring**

* **Architecture at production scale:**
  Experience architecting a live product operating at substantial scale. You can explain actual peak concurrency, throughput or workload volumes, the architectural decisions you owned and the outcomes measured.
* **Enterprise product experience:**
  Experience owning core architecture for products used by external enterprise customers. You understand how to evolve shared capabilities across releases while addressing tenant isolation, integration and auditability.
* **Recent architecture ownership:**
  Ability to demonstrate a substantial product design or redesign undertaken within the past 12 months, including the trade-offs made and the resulting production impact.
* **Applied enterprise AI:**
  Experience designing and delivering AI capabilities for real-world enterprise use cases. You understand how to evaluate quality, latency and cost, and when to apply rules, guardrails or human approvals.
* **Hands-on technical depth:**
  Ability to prototype, review code and troubleshoot distributed systems using any programming language.
* **Technical leadership and accountability:**
  Experience driving technical decisions across teams and demonstrating ownership of product outcomes.

**Experience:**
Typically 8–12 years of relevant experience.

**Good to Have**

* Experience building products for regulated industries.
* Familiarity with SaaS and customer-hosted deployment models.
* Experience applying AI-assisted engineering practices with appropriate review and testing gates.

**Our Commitment**

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

**Interested?**

If you have owned enterprise product architecture at scale and want to shape the next generation of enterprise AI platforms, we'd like to hear from you.

Apply through this LinkedIn job listing or contact the recruiter listed in the accompanying recruitment post.

title: AI Prompt Engineer - Job
description:

Advertflair builds AI-powered visual production for brands that need thousands of consistent, on-brand images without running a photo studio. title: Data Architect - Snowflake
company: KNORR-BREMSE TECHNOLOGY CENTER INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED
description:
**Position Summary:**

Knorr-Bremse, the world leader in braking systems and safety-critical mobility solutions, is building an AI Center of Excellence to accelerate innovation across its truck and rail businesses. To realize this ambition, KB must establish an enterprise AI-ready data foundation layer that is trusted, governed, and reusable across every business domain. We are seeking an AI Ready Data Lead to design and develop scalable digital data foundation for AI and the end-to-end technical authority for that platform.

This is a senior management role within KB’s global AI leadership, demanding strong technical leadership combined with enterprise-scale influence. The successful candidate will define technical standards, cross-squad patterns, and the policies and metrics that govern data accuracy and reliability, while designing the self-service infrastructure that lets delivery squads build and deploy data assets independently. The technical platform will focus on Snowflake. This is a highly impactful portfolio with direct ownership of the data backbone underpinning KB’s AI transformation.

**Essential Functions:**

**Technical Leadership & Standards**

* Provide strong technical leadership across the global AI organization, acting as the design authority for the AI-ready data foundation.
* Define
  **technical standards, cross-squad patterns, and reference designs**
  that ensure architectural integrity and consistency across all data squads.
* Set organization-wide policies and metrics for data accuracy, reliability, freshness, and trust, and hold the platform accountable to them.

**Self-Service Platform & Automation**

* Design the infrastructure and platform capabilities that allow squads to build, certify, and deploy data assets and data products independently.
* **Automate the underlying tooling — databases, orchestration, and ML-Ops —**
  consumed by the squads, reducing manual effort and accelerating delivery.
* Establish the data foundation layer (Bronze/Silver/Gold tiers) on a Snowflake-centric platform, ensuring scalability, performance, and cost efficiency.

**Architectural Oversight & Design Authority**

* **Act as the ultimate technical authority for AI products data architecture**
  , ensuring best practices in multi-cluster (virtual warehouse) environments, secure data sharing, and workload isolation.
* Review and approve key architectural decisions, balancing performance, cost, security, and long-term maintainability.

**Data Governance & Security**

* **Lead the implementation of data governance frameworks**
  (e.g., Collibra, Snowflake Data Clean Rooms) across the enterprise.
* **Implement Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)**
  and row-level and column-level masking to enforce least-privilege access and protect sensitive data.
* Ensure the data foundation aligns with GDPR, the EU AI Act, and KB’s internal information and data security guidelines.

**Vendor & Partner Scaling**

* **Set up and manage vendor and partner ecosystems**
  to scale the data foundation across the organization and to optimize the run (operate) organization.
* Drive build-vs-buy decisions and manage delivery partners against clear quality, cost, and SLA expectations.

**Mentorship**

* **Provide technical leadership, code reviews, and mentorship**
  to junior and mid-level data engineers, raising the engineering bar across squads.
* Promote a culture of architectural discipline, documentation, and knowledge sharing.

**Skills:**

* Data Lake / Cloud Data Platform: Snowflake (multi-cluster, data sharing, workload isolation)
* Data Modeling & Medallion Architecture (Bronze / Silver / Gold)
* Data Governance & Cataloguing: Collibra, Snowflake Data Clean Rooms
* Security: RBAC, row-level & column-level masking, data classification
* ELT/ETL, Orchestration, ML-Ops and platform automation
* Cloud Platforms: AWS, Azure, GCP

**General Skills**

* Technical Leadership & Architecture Authority Expert
* Data Governance & Security Expert
* Vendor / 3rd party resource management Expert
* Communication / presentation skills Expert
* Automotive / Railways industry analytics Functional

**Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills**
are essential, including the ability to influence peers and senior business stakeholders across Knorr-Bremse AG.

**Experience:**

* 12+ years in data engineering / data platform architecture, with significant experience leading enterprise-scale data foundation initiatives.
* Proven, hands-on expertise architecting and operating Snowflake at enterprise scale.
* Track record of defining technical standards and self-service platforms that enable independent delivery squads.
* Demonstrated ability to set up and scale vendor/partner ecosystems and optimize run organizations.
* Strong team leadership and mentoring experience; entrepreneurial, execution-focused mindset.

**Education:**

* B.Tech / Master’s in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields.
* **Certification on a data lake / cloud data platform such as Snowflake is an advantage**
  ; cloud professional certification preferred.

**Position Requirements:**

* Ability to travel up to 25% domestically and internationally.

**What We Offer**

* A unique opportunity to build and own the AI-ready data foundation for a global mobility and safety-critical leader.
* Exposure to global-scale AI and data programs spanning truck, rail, and industrial domains.
* Career growth as part of Knorr-Bremse’s global leadership in digital and AI-driven transformation.

12+ years of overall experience in data engineering, data platforms, analytics, or enterprise data architecture, with 5+ years in data platform modernization/cloud data engineering and strong hands-on expertise in Databricks, Microsoft Fabric and Azure Data Factory.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Data Engineering Modernization Architect to lead the transformation of legacy data platforms, ETL pipelines, and data warehouses into modern, scalable, cloud-native data platforms. The architect will define the target-state data architecture, modernization strategy, migration roadmap, engineering standards, and reusable frameworks. The role requires a strong combination of architecture, hands-on engineering, cloud technologies, data modelling, migration, performance optimization, and automation. The ideal candidate should have successfully delivered at least two enterprise-scale data engineering modernization projects, involving migration from legacy ETL/data warehouse technologies to platforms such as Databricks and Microsoft Fabric, One Lake with Azure Data Factory or equivalent orchestration.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead modernization of legacy data platforms, ETL/ELT processes and data warehouses into modern cloud-based architectures.
* Assess existing data platforms, pipelines, databases, ETL jobs, data models and workloads.
* Define As-Is, To-Be and transition architectures.
* Develop modernization roadmaps.

description: When you join VerizonYou want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. You will bridge the gap between applied research and enterprise engineering—translating ambiguous business requirements into robust, high-performance AI architectures. You will guide business from proof-of-concept (PoC) to scalable production, establish technical governance, and mentor emerging AI talent.What You Will DoArchitect & Deliver End-to-End Solutions: Design, prototype, benchmark, and deploy enterprise-grade Agentic systems, multi-stage RAG pipelines, and fine-tuned Foundation/Small Language Model (LLM/SLM) architectures to solve complex business problems.Lead AI Engineering & Productionization: Implement modern LLMOps/GenAIOps standards, including prompt orchestration, deterministic guardrails, structured outputs, automated red-teaming, latency/token-cost optimization, and continuous evaluation (e.g., LLM-as-a-judge).Execute High-Impact Fine-Tuning & Quantization: Conduct parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT/LoRA/QLoRA), alignment tuning (DPO, RLHF), and model quantization/distillation for downstream domain specialization and edge/on-premise inference.Drive Client Advisory & Executive Communication: Partner with cross-functional global stakeholders, translate complex algorithmic decisions into measurable business impact (ROI, cost-per-query, latency budgets), and deliver compelling technical presentations to C-suite leadership.Practice Growth & Technical Evangelism: Lead technical proposals (RFPs/POCs), formulate point-of-view (PoV) whitepapers, explore emerging frontier models and open-source tooling, and continuously enhance internal IP, reference architectures, and reusable accelerators.Mentorship & Technical Leadership: Foster engineering excellence by conducting rigorous code/design reviews, guiding junior scientists on applied ML/GenAI methodologies, and enforcing reproducible data science standards.What We Are Looking ForYou are an applied AI practitioner and pragmatic engineer who thrives on turning raw research and frontier models into secure, reliable software systems. You balance algorithmic depth with system architecture, understand the operational bottlenecks and scaling best practices and are able to own technical delivery at scale end to end.Minimum QualificationsEducation & Experience: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, paired with 4+ years of hands-on experience in applied machine learning, deep learning, and advanced NLP/GenAI in an enterprise or consulting environment.GenAI & Agentic Architectures: Deep hands-on experience building autonomous agents and complex multi-agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel) using tool-calling, stateful memory, and routing graphs.Advanced RAG & Retrieval Systems: Demonstrated expertise implementing hybrid search pipelines (dense vectors + sparse BM25), semantic routing, contextual compression, reranking models (e.g., Cohere, BGE), and production vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Qdrant, Milvus, pgvector).Fine-Tuning & Model Adaptation: Practical experience fine-tuning open-source LLMs/SLMs (e.g., Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Phi) using PEFT, LoRA/QLoRA, DeepSpeed, or Unsloth, paired with robust knowledge of post-training evaluation frameworks (e.g., Ragas, DeepEval, TruLens).Software Engineering & APIs: Strong proficiency in Python, modern asynchronous web frameworks (FastAPI), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and designing secure, low-latency REST/gRPC endpoints.Cloud & Distributed Computing: Hands-on experience architecting ML/AI workloads on at least one major cloud platform (AWS SageMaker/Bedrock, Azure OpenAI/ML, or GCP Vertex AI).Where you’ll be workingIn this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.Scheduled Weekly Hours40Equal Employment OpportunityVerizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: GDS Cyber - AI Driven IAM - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Cyber Security- Senior AI Engineer – IAM & Cybersecurity**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is seeking a Senior AI Engineer to support the design and delivery of AI-led solutions across Identity and Access Management and Cybersecurity domains. This role will help shape how AI capabilities are applied to modern IAM challenges such as identity governance, access management, privileged access, directory services and non-human identity security.
  
  
As a senior profile, the candidate will work closely with IAM, Cyber, cloud and business stakeholders to understand client problems, identify practical AI opportunities and convert them into working solutions, prototypes and scalable delivery assets. The focus is not only on technology implementation, but also on improving identity risk visibility, access decisioning, governance efficiency and operational effectiveness.
  
  
The ideal candidate should bring strong hands-on engineering experience, curiosity to work in the IAM and Cyber domain, and the ability to apply AI, automation and analytics to solve real enterprise identity challenges. While the role requires practical exposure to AI and IAM technologies, the emphasis is on problem solving, consulting mindset, solution ownership and the ability to contribute to enterprise-scale IAM transformation programs.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop and operationalize AI solutions for IAM and Cybersecurity use cases across SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, IGA, PAM, AD/Entra ID and NHI domains.
* Build hands-on AI/ML capabilities using Python, PowerShell, LLM/SLM APIs, embeddings, RAG, LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, ADKs and AI orchestration engines.
* Develop agentic AI workflows, copilots and automation frameworks for access requests, certification campaigns, provisioning, privileged access, remediation and identity operations.
* Integrate AI solutions with SailPoint, Saviynt, CyberArk, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Azure, AWS, Microsoft Graph API, SIEM/SOAR, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike and XDR platforms.
* Analyze identity, access, privilege, vault, directory, activity and security logs to identify risk patterns, anomalies, access recommendations, role mining opportunities and policy gaps.
* Support AI-driven IAM governance including risk-based authentication, risk-based provisioning, access reviews, compliance checks, SOD, identity lifecycle orchestration and audit-ready reporting.
* Apply ML, classification, optimization, time series analysis, pattern recognition, NLP, UEBA, anomaly detection and predictive risk scoring for identity and access intelligence.
* Work on Non-Human Identity use cases including service accounts, managed identities, service principals, enterprise applications, API-based identities, workload identities, agent identities, token misuse and agent overreach controls.
* Contribute to PAM analytics and automation across CyberArk, Privilege Cloud, EPM, EPV, CPM, PSM, JIT/JEA, password rotation, secret lifecycle management, session monitoring and vault log analytics.
* Create dashboards and insights using Power BI, Tableau and identity analytics views to explain access risk, compliance posture, user activity trends and remediation priorities.
* Collaborate with business, cyber and IAM stakeholders to convert problem statements into working prototypes, scalable solutions and executive-ready recommendations.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**
**Required Skills**

* 5+ years of hands-on experience in AI engineering, software development, data science, automation, cybersecurity analytics or IAM technology delivery.
* Practical experience building AI applications using LLM/SLM APIs, RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering, agentic AI, AI agents, copilots and multi-agent workflows.
* Strong programming and automation experience in Python, PowerShell, APIs, SQL basics and Microsoft Graph API; exposure to HTML, CSS and JavaScript is preferred.
* Hands-on exposure to Azure AI, OpenAI, AWS, Python-based AI/ML frameworks, ML models, classification, optimization, NLP, pattern recognition, time series analysis and anomaly detection.
* Working knowledge of IAM concepts including SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, SAML, OAuth, OIDC with PKCE, authentication, authorization, federation, certificate management and key management.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Entra Connect, Cloud Sync, Directory Services, DNS, Global Catalog, GPO, OU, Domains/Forests, FSMO roles and Sites and Services.
* Experience or strong exposure to IGA platforms and concepts such as SailPoint, Saviynt, identity lifecycle, access reviews, certification campaigns, role mining, SOD, access risk and policy compliance.
* Experience or strong exposure to PAM concepts and tools including CyberArk, Privilege Cloud, EPM, EPV, CPM, PSM, JIT/JEA, password rotation, secrets, session monitoring and vault logs.
* Understanding of NHI and AI identity security including service accounts, managed identities, service principals, enterprise applications, API-based identities, workload identities, agent identities and token controls.
* Experience with security monitoring or analytics platforms such as SIEM, SOAR, UEBA, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike, XDR and Identity Protection.
* Strong consulting mindset with the ability to communicate AI, IAM and Cybersecurity topics clearly to technical teams and leadership stakeholders.

**Nice to have**

* Experience identifying AI use cases for IAM transformation, identity analytics, access recommendations, privileged access recommendations, NHI governance and automated remediation.
* Experience with data pipelines, identity and privilege analytics pipelines, model monitoring, observability, MLOps and scalable deployment of enterprise AI solutions.
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau, dashboards and data storytelling for access risk, compliance posture and identity operations.
* Exposure to SOX, GDPR, HIPAA, ISO 27001, CISSP, CISM, SailPoint, Saviynt, CyberArk, Azure AI or Google ML certifications is preferred.
* Prior experience in a consulting, professional services or large enterprise environment is a plus.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.

title: Technical Lead – AI Engineering
description:
**About Us**
**Cognet HRO**
is a leading Business Process Outsourcing Services Company providing full range of
**HR and F&A**
services to
**US based clients ,**
With over 17 years of rich experience in
**Payroll Tax, Benefits S & HR Administration, Finance & Accounting , Sales Support**
.
