has been serving the PEO, ASO, HRO and HR Technology spaces since our inception. We help organizations extend their capabilities through simplified implementation, productivity performance measured to the minute, easy collaboration, and transparent pricing built around real time utilization. Our extensive expertise, data library, and workflow development tools accelerates the client implementation process .We have developed a deep expertise of process and technology in our Services , which allows us to rapidly deliver value to our clients.
**Cognet**
has been delivering outsourced solutions to the clients around the Globe.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Job Description**
**Technical Lead – AI Engineering**
**Company:**
CogNet HR Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai, India
  
  
**Department:**
Technology / AI Engineering
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**Experience:**
8–10 Years
  
  
**Position Level:**
Technical Lead / Lead AI Platform Engineer
  
  
**About CogNet Drive**
CogNet Drive is an AI-powered intelligent document processing and workflow automation platform being developed by CogNet HR Solutions.
  
  
The platform is designed to transform how organizations process, extract, validate, reconcile, analyze, and manage complex business documents.
  
  
By combining Large Language Models (LLMs), Optical Character Recognition (OCR), agentic AI workflows, intelligent validation, and enterprise integrations, CogNet Drive aims to automate document-intensive business processes while delivering high accuracy, scalability, security, and operational efficiency.
  
  
Our initial focus includes payroll and HR documents, employee benefits, insurance underwriting submissions, claims and loss-run reports, financial records, and other structured and unstructured business documents.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced, hands-on
**Technical Lead – AI Engineering**
who can architect, develop, and lead the engineering efforts required to transform CogNet Drive into a scalable, secure, enterprise-grade SaaS product.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Technical Lead will be responsible for the overall technical architecture, engineering strategy, and delivery of CogNet Drive.
  
  
This role requires a strong combination of software engineering expertise, cloud-native architecture, AI/LLM application development, and technical leadership.
  
  
The ideal candidate must be capable of independently designing complex systems, solving challenging engineering problems, writing production-quality code, mentoring developers, and making critical architectural decisions.
  
  
This is not a purely managerial position. We expect the Technical Lead to remain actively involved in architecture, coding, debugging, performance optimization, and production deployments.
  
  
The candidate will work closely with product leadership, AI developers, backend engineers, frontend developers, and domain specialists to deliver a reliable, commercially viable AI platform.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Technical Architecture & Platform Engineering
* Own the end-to-end technical architecture of CogNet Drive, covering frontend, backend, AI processing, databases, integrations, and cloud infrastructure.
* Design scalable, modular, cloud-native applications using microservices, APIs, asynchronous processing, and event-driven architecture.
* Define architectural standards, coding guidelines, design patterns, and engineering best practices.
* Design a secure multi-tenant SaaS architecture supporting multiple enterprise customers.
* Architect reliable document ingestion, processing, validation, reconciliation, and output-generation workflows.
* Build systems capable of handling concurrent users, high document volumes, and computationally intensive AI workloads.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend appropriate frameworks, infrastructure, and engineering approaches.
* Ensure the platform remains extensible, maintainable, and cost-efficient as product capabilities expand.
* AI & LLM Engineering
* Lead the technical development and integration of AI-powered document processing capabilities.
* Architect LLM-based applications using Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, and other suitable models.
* Design and implement multi-agent workflows for document extraction, analysis, reconciliation, and validation.
* Establish structured-output mechanisms using JSON Schema, Pydantic, and deterministic validation.
* Develop model-independent AI integration layers that support switching between LLM providers.
* Implement prompt management, versioning, evaluation, and regression-testing frameworks.
* Design confidence scoring, exception handling, and human-in-the-loop review workflows.
* Optimize model performance, token consumption, latency, and processing costs.
* Evaluate retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool calling, agent orchestration, and other AI techniques where appropriate.
* Ensure AI-generated outputs are accurate, traceable, reproducible, and suitable for enterprise workflows.
* Intelligent Document Processing & OCR
* Architect document-processing pipelines supporting PDF, Excel, scanned images, and other business document formats.
* Lead integration and optimization of PaddleOCR PP-OCRv4 and associated document-processing technologies.
* Develop intelligent mechanisms to distinguish digitally generated documents from scanned documents and select the appropriate processing approach.
* Design document classification, layout analysis, table extraction, and structured-data extraction workflows.
* Ensure reliable processing of complex documents containing tables, multiple sections, inconsistent layouts, and handwritten or scanned content where supported.
* Build validation and reconciliation engines capable of identifying missing information, inconsistencies, and discrepancies across multiple documents.
* Implement document-level and field-level traceability, confidence scoring, and exception reporting.
* Optimize OCR performance using CPU/GPU resources while controlling infrastructure costs.
* Backend Development & API Engineering
* Lead the development of backend services using Python, FastAPI, and related technologies.
* Design and implement secure REST APIs for document upload, processing, workflow execution, status tracking, and output retrieval.
* Architect asynchronous task processing using AWS SQS, Step Functions, and worker-based execution.
* Implement robust error handling, retry mechanisms, idempotency, and recovery procedures.
* Design database schemas and data-access layers using PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy, and related technologies.
* Develop integrations with HRIS, payroll, benefits, insurance, CRM, and third-party enterprise systems.
* Ensure seamless integration between AI services, backend APIs, and frontend applications.
* Establish API versioning, authentication, authorization, rate limiting, and performance standards.
* AWS Cloud Architecture & DevOps
* Design, deploy, and manage CogNet Drive's AWS infrastructure.
* Work with AWS services including EC2, ECS, S3, RDS, SQS, Step Functions, Lambda, CloudWatch, IAM, and related services.
* Architect GPU-enabled document-processing infrastructure with intelligent resource allocation and autoscaling.
* Implement queue-based workload management, dynamic worker provisioning, and efficient resource utilization.
* Design systems supporting continuous operations with appropriate availability and disaster-recovery mechanisms.
* Establish CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or equivalent technologies.
* Implement containerization using Docker and appropriate orchestration services.
* Define infrastructure-as-code practices using Terraform or AWS CDK.
* Monitor application performance, processing throughput, infrastructure consumption, and cloud costs.
* Drive infrastructure optimization without compromising performance, security, or reliability.
* Product Scalability, Reliability & Performance
* Design the platform to support an initial workload of approximately 1,000 documents per day and a target of 100 concurrent users, with the ability to scale further.
* Engineer processing workflows toward a target turnaround time of 1–5 minutes for supported document-processing scenarios.
* Establish performance benchmarks for OCR, LLM processing, document validation, and output generation.
* Identify and eliminate processing bottlenecks across AI services, APIs, databases, and infrastructure.
* Implement distributed processing, caching, asynchronous execution, and resource optimization where appropriate.
* Establish monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability standards.
* Design fault-tolerant systems with retries, dead-letter queues, recovery mechanisms, and failure isolation.
* Define service-level objectives for availability, throughput, processing accuracy, and response time.
* Ensure the platform can scale efficiently as customer adoption and document volumes increase.
* Security, Compliance & Data Protection
* Architect enterprise-grade security across application, infrastructure, and AI processing layers.
* Implement authentication, authorization, role-based access control, and secure tenant isolation.
* Design encryption mechanisms for data at rest and in transit.
* Ensure secure handling of confidential payroll, HR, financial, insurance, and personally identifiable information.
* Implement comprehensive audit logging, document access tracking, and processing traceability.
* Apply secure coding practices and integrate vulnerability assessments into the development lifecycle.
* Work within applicable ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, and GDPR requirements based on product and customer needs.
* Establish appropriate data retention, deletion, backup, and recovery mechanisms.
* Implement controls to prevent unauthorized data access, cross-tenant exposure, and sensitive-information leakage through AI services.
* Technical Leadership & Team Management
* Provide technical direction and mentorship to AI developers, backend engineers, frontend developers, and other engineering resources.
* Translate product requirements into technical designs, engineering tasks, and development milestones.
* Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, and technical design discussions.
* Establish engineering standards covering code quality, documentation, testing, security, and deployment.
* Actively contribute production code, particularly for critical components and complex technical challenges.
* Guide developers in troubleshooting, performance optimization, and root-cause analysis.
* Coordinate development activities across a lean, cross-functional engineering team.
* Work closely with product stakeholders to prioritize technical deliverables and manage dependencies.
* Identify technical risks early and recommend practical solutions.
* Build a culture of accountability, technical excellence, continuous learning, and engineering ownership.
* Quality Engineering & Product Delivery
* Establish automated testing strategies covering unit, integration, API, performance, security, and end-to-end testing.
* Develop evaluation frameworks for measuring document extraction accuracy and reconciliation quality.
* Implement automated regression testing for prompts, AI models, OCR components, and document-processing workflows.
* Establish release management, deployment approvals, and rollback procedures.
* Ensure proper technical documentation covering architecture, APIs, infrastructure, and operational procedures.
* Collaborate with QA and product teams to establish acceptance criteria and release readiness.
* Support customer pilots, production deployments, incident resolution, and ongoing platform improvements.
* Take ownership of technical deliverables from design through successful production operation.

**Requirements**
**Required Technical Skills**
**Programming & Backend Development**

* Strong proficiency in Python, including asynchronous programming and production application development.
* Extensive experience with FastAPI, REST APIs, Pydantic, and backend service architecture.
* Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, design patterns, and distributed systems.
* Experience with SQL, PostgreSQL, database optimization, and ORM frameworks.
* Working knowledge of C# / ASP.NET Core is an advantage.

**AI, LLMs & Document Intelligence**

* Hands-on experience building production applications using LLM APIs.
* Experience with Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, or comparable AI platforms.
* Knowledge of LangChain, LangGraph, agent orchestration, tool calling, and structured outputs.
* Experience developing document extraction, classification, validation, or AI automation solutions.
* Familiarity with OCR technologies such as PaddleOCR, Tesseract, or Amazon Textract.
* Understanding of prompt engineering, model evaluation, hallucination mitigation, and AI reliability.

**Cloud & Infrastructure**

* Strong practical experience with AWS cloud architecture.
* Experience with Docker, containerized services, CI/CD, and cloud deployments.
* Understanding of S3, ECS, EC2, RDS, SQS, IAM, CloudWatch, and related AWS services.
* Experience designing scalable asynchronous processing architectures.
* Familiarity with GPU-based workloads and infrastructure cost optimization.

**Architecture & Security**

* Strong understanding of microservices, distributed systems, and event-driven architecture.
* Experience designing scalable SaaS platforms or enterprise applications.
* Knowledge of authentication, authorization, RBAC, encryption, and secure API design.
* Understanding of multi-tenant application architecture and data isolation.
* Familiarity with observability, application monitoring, and production incident management.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 8–10 years of professional software engineering experience.
* At least 3 years of experience in a senior engineering or technical leadership role.
* Demonstrated experience architecting and delivering production-grade enterprise applications.
* Strong hands-on Python backend development experience.
* Practical experience integrating LLMs or AI capabilities into real-world applications.
* Experience working with AWS cloud infrastructure and distributed processing systems.
* Proven ability to lead small engineering teams while remaining actively involved in development.
* Experience taking products from proof of concept through production deployment is strongly preferred.

**Preferred / Additional Qualifications**

* Experience related to building commercial SaaS products from the ground up.
* Experience with intelligent document processing, insurance technology, payroll, HR technology, or financial automation.
* Knowledge of document layout analysis, OCR optimization, and GPU-based inference.
* Experience with React, TypeScript, or modern frontend technologies.
* Familiarity with RAG, vector databases, and AI evaluation frameworks.
* Experience implementing enterprise-grade data governance and compliance controls.
* Exposure to MLOps, LLMOps, infrastructure-as-code, and automated cloud provisioning.
* AWS certifications or relevant cloud architecture certifications.
* Experience integrating with HRIS, payroll, insurance carrier, or financial systems.

**Key Performance Indicators**
The Technical Lead will be evaluated against the following outcomes:
  
  
**Platform Delivery**

* Successful transformation of CogNet Drive from proof of concept into a production-ready SaaS platform.
* Timely completion of agreed product milestones and technical deliverables.
* Quality, maintainability, and extensibility of the platform architecture.

**AI Processing Accuracy**

* Target document-processing accuracy of 98% or higher for defined, benchmarked workflows.
* Reduction in manual intervention and processing exceptions.
* Reliable extraction, reconciliation, and validation across supported document types.

**Performance & Scalability**

* Achievement of agreed document-processing turnaround targets.
* Reliable support for planned document volumes and concurrent users.
* Efficient CPU/GPU utilization and controlled infrastructure costs.

**Security & Reliability**

* Effective tenant isolation, access controls, and auditability.
* Production stability, monitoring, and incident response.
* Adherence to established security and engineering standards.

**Engineering Leadership**

* Development productivity and code quality.
* Effective mentoring and technical guidance.
* Reduction in technical debt and recurring production defects.
* Successful coordination of engineering activities across the product team.

**What We Are Looking For**
We are looking for a

title: Agentic Engineering Lead (L3/L4)
description:
**Agentic Engineering Lead (L3/L4)**

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are hiring engineering leaders who deliver enterprise modernization and AI solutions with agents as the primary workforce and people as architects, reviewers and client partners. OptiSol is a Claude partner and works with AWS and Microsoft Azure. You will lead squads (formed per client engagement) and chapters (skill communities of 10-20 engineers) working on our iBeam (agentic application and data modernization), elsAi Foundry (agent governance and orchestration) and client solutions with agents embedded in them.

This is a full-time role in the Build & Modernize and Data & AI business units. The level is L3 (Squad Lead / Chapter Lead) or L4 (BU Lead / Engineering Manager), decided by your scope and leadership depth.

**LOCATION**

Chennai, Madurai or Coimbatore (Hybrid)

**EXPERIENCE**

L3: 5+ years. L4: 8+ years. This is indicative only, and enterprise depth matters more than years.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN YOUR FIRST YEAR**

* Your squads deliver enterprise modernization with agents doing the bulk of the build, under clear governance and human review.
* Engineers on your team grow into proficient Agent Engineers and are Claude-certified.
* Client CIOs and architects trust you with the solution architecture, not only the delivery.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Run delivery on an agentic SDLC**

* Lead your squad so that BA, Dev and QA agents do the build work while people own intent, specification, review and acceptance.
* Own the instructions, skills and guardrails the agents run on, and the human-in-the-loop review queue that keeps their output trustworthy.
* Follow and improve OptiSol's Agentic SDLC SOPs, including the iBeam SOPs for application and data modernization.
* Track outcomes that matter: delivery against commitments, defects and rework, and cost per outcome including token spend.

**Architect solutions with agents in them**

* Design solutions where agents are used to build the system and where agents run inside it.
* Define how the agentic layer is built, deployed, monitored and governed in the client's own cloud or on-prem environment.
* Choose models, SDKs and cloud combinations per client constraint, and defend the trade-offs.

**Lead enterprise engagements**

* Work with client CIOs, enterprise architects, security teams and business owners from discovery through go-live.
* Run architecture reviews, solution walkthroughs and proofs of concept, and support proposals and estimates that reflect agent-assisted productivity.
* Spot modernization and AI opportunities inside accounts and bring them to business leadership.

**Build the bench**

* Coach developers to become proficient Agent Engineers and field-deployed engineers (FDE), and support their Claude certification.
* Hire, assess and grow engineers using hands-on, practical evaluations rather than self-assessment.
* Turn what your squad learns into reusable skills, patterns and accelerators for iBeam and elsAi Foundry.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* Enterprise delivery depth: 5+ years (L3) or 8+ years (L4) of software, data or AI engineering, with delivery on enterprise projects involving legacy estates, integrations, compliance and scale, and real stakeholder engagement with client IT, business owners, security and procurement.
* Claude-first, hands-on: you build with Claude Code and the Claude Agent SDK as your normal way of working, and can show real work such as specifications, skills, instructions, agents and evaluations you wrote. GitHub Copilot fluency is welcome.
* Clear thinker and communicator: you turn ambiguous business problems into precise specifications and explain trade-offs to a CIO in plain words.
* Deep in one area, credible across several: depth in application engineering, data engineering or AI/ML, plus enough breadth to guide teams outside your home stack. We do not screen on a checklist of technologies.
* Leader of people: you have led squads or teams, mentored engineers, and held a delivery commitment with a client.
* Cost and governance instincts: you treat token cost, security, auditability and human review as design inputs, not afterthoughts.
* Legacy modernization exposure (strong advantage): experience modernizing Oracle Forms, PowerBuilder, .NET, Java, or Oracle and Sybase to Postgres.

**TECHNICAL AREAS YOU SHOULD BE COMFORTABLE WITH**

* Agents in the build: run an end-to-end agentic SDLC with specification, BA, Dev and QA agents, human review and CI/CD. Engineer context, skills and instructions, and measure agent quality with evaluations.
* Agents in the solution: decide where an agent belongs and where deterministic code is better. Design tools and MCP servers, workflows versus autonomous agents, and state and memory.
* The agentic layer: build, deploy and operate orchestration, observability, versioned instructions and skills, identity and permissions, audit trails, cost controls and human-in-the-loop gates.
* Agent SDKs: integrate the Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK and Microsoft agent frameworks, and choose between them. Use open protocols (MCP, agent-to-agent) so no vendor SDK becomes a lock-in.
* Models and clouds: combine Anthropic Claude (direct API, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Microsoft Foundry), Azure OpenAI and Gemini per client estate, weighing data residency, private networking, IAM, quotas, latency and cost.
* On-prem and open-weight models: design for clients that need sovereign or on-prem models, benchmark open-weight models against a frontier baseline, and route work between them.
* Client-environment deployment: run the platform inside the client's cloud, VPC or on-prem network, with the client's repositories, ticketing and CI/CD, and with security and compliance sign-off.
* Model-agnostic design: keep models swappable behind a gateway so cost, capability and policy changes do not force a redesign.

**L3 VS L4 - HOW THE LEVEL IS DECIDED**

**L3 (Squad Lead / Chapter Lead):**
You lead one squad on an engagement or one chapter of 10-20 engineers. You run the agentic SDLC hands-on, tune agents and skills, and own squad outcomes. You design and defend the solution architecture for an engagement, act as technical lead with client architects and delivery owners, and coach developers to become proficient Agent Engineers. You contribute to pre-sales, proposals, PoCs and agent orchestration.

**L4 (BU Lead / Engineering Manager):**
You lead a business unit, or several squads, chapters or a client portfolio. You set the delivery model and standards across squads and own governance and cost per outcome. You set reference architectures, model and cloud strategy, and approve high-risk designs. You act as a trusted advisor to the client CIO and leadership and shape the account and the deal. You build and manage leads, plan capacity and succession, and run hiring. You own margin and utilization and lead business unit strategy, offerings and growth.

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Claude or GitHub Copilot certification
* Experience on an agentic modernization platform, or building agents for BA, Dev or QA work
* Hands-on modernization of Oracle Forms, PowerBuilder, or database migrations such as Oracle or Sybase to Postgres
* Experience serving or fine-tuning open-weight models on-prem or in a client's private cloud
* MLOps, DataOps and data governance experience
* Cloud certifications on AWS or Azure
* Pre-sales, RFP and estimation experience; talks, articles or open-source work on agentic engineering

title: Senior Financial planning and Analysis Analyst
description:
KLDiscovery is looking for someone who can build the infrastructure, run the models, develop strategy. This person will sit at the intersection of financial systems, data engineering, advanced modeling, and strategic insight, and they will operate with significant autonomy.

We are a $350M PE-backed company going through a Quality of Earnings process. The Finance function is rebuilding from the ground up: new planning platform (Pigment), new India data team, new AI agent infrastructure, new KPI framework. This role will be a founding architect of that rebuild, not a passenger in it.

On any given week you might build a Python script to automate a data pipeline, develop a 3+9 reforecast in Pigment, write a one-page strategy memo on the financial impact of a pricing change, and co-build a Claude AI agent with the US Sr. FP&A Analyst.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Financial systems and data infrastructure

* Design and build Oracle → Pigment data pipelines that are clean, automated, and reconciled daily.
* Own data integrity across Oracle, Pigment, and Salesforce; catch discrepancies before the US team's morning.
* Automate manual report pulls (SSRS AR reports, collections reports, close checklists).
* **Pigment/Adaptive administration:**
  versioning, data refresh, user access, API connections.

AI agent co-development (with US Sr. FP&A Analyst)

* Co-build all six Claude agents: Close, Rolling Forecast, Variance+Commentary, Strategy+Scenario, Investor Reporting, Collections Intelligence.
* Own the data feeds each agent reads; if the data is wrong, the agent is wrong.
* Once agents are live: operate, monitor, validate outputs, and continuously improve prompt quality and accuracy.

Financial modeling and analysis

* **Rolling forecast:**
  end-to-end ownership of actuals ingest, model update, reforecast, sensitivity, and assumptions memo.
* **EBITDA Bridge:**
  monthly production from June 2026 with waterfall, variance commentary, and distribution to the CFO.
* **3+9 reforecast:**
  monthly update of full-year forecast, refreshed assumptions, drift flagged, distributed to ELT.
* **Scenario modeling:**
  acquisition, pricing change, headcount, DSO improvement; P&L impact plus sensitivity range.
* **Capital and investment analysis:**
  ROI modeling for major decisions (India build, Pigment, BI tooling, and other infrastructure replacements).

Strategy development and original insight

* **Peer benchmarking:**
  quarterly comparison of KLD vs. PE-backed peers at $300M+ on close cycle, DSO, EBITDA margin, and headcount ratio.
* **Strategy memos:**
  one-page financial impact write-ups for key decisions, written to go directly to the CFO and ELT as-is.
* **KPI framework:**
  define scorecards by group (Collections, Analysts, FP&A, Sales Ops) with baseline, target, and measurement.
* Identify patterns in the data the US team hasn't seen, and surface them unprompted.
* **ELT pre-reads:**
  financial analysis, scenario tables, and recommendation summaries for executive meetings.

**Qualifications**

Financial Modeling:

* Four to six years building integrated three-statement models in FP&A, consulting, banking, or PE; must be able to build from a blank sheet.
* Expert Excel across dynamic models with scenario toggles, sensitivity tables, named ranges, and zero hardcoded assumptions.
* Experience building PE-grade deliverables (EBITDA bridges, rolling forecasts, investor packages, scenario memos) in live contexts.
* Pigment, Adaptive, Anaplan, or similar is non-negotiable; you will administer the platform from day one.

Technical Systems:

* Python (pandas, requests, API calls) to build and maintain data pipelines without IT assistance.
* SQL to query Oracle at GL level, validate data, and build reconciliation logic.
* REST API experience reading and writing via API (Pigment API and Claude API).
* LLM API familiarity with the ability to co-build AI agents, write system prompts, and validate outputs.

Strategy and insight:

* Ability to translate complex financial analysis into a crisp one-page executive narrative.
* Experience working directly with CFO- or PE-sponsor-level leadership on financial analysis.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity: build the model when the inputs aren't clean and the question is still forming. PE-backed company experience or direct exposure to PE exit processes is a strong plus.

Leadership and communication:

* Exceptional written English; strategy memos are read by CFO, ELT, and PE sponsors without editing.
* Self-directed: identifies what needs building and builds it without a task list. Mentors the Financial Model Analyst and FP&A Data Engineer on modeling standards and output quality.
* MBA from a top institution is preferred but not required if experience speaks for itself.

**Driving Career Growth, Benefit Excellence: The KLD Advantage**

At KLD we invest in employees and their families by placing their wellbeing first. We offer competitive total compensation that includes base pay, bonus potential, inclusive benefits, wellness programs, and perks. We use market and industry data to inform pay decisions while considering geography and labor markets, individual experience, and business needs. India compensation is based upon the local competitive market.

* Paid time off, that offers various time off options to help employees maintain a work-life balance, such as Casual, Earned, Sick, Special Leave, and Holidays
* Ongoing learning and development, a focus on continuous professional development through various training and education reimbursement programs
* A diverse and inclusive workplace where we all learn, grow, and achieve the greatest heights…together
* A surrounding team of mission-driven individuals who genuinely love what they do
* Free, fun, interactive and incentivized global wellness program that promotes the wellbeing of our employees
* India compensation is based upon the local competitive market

**Who We Are**

KLDiscovery provides technology-enabled services and software to help law firms, corporations, and government agencies solve complex data challenges. With offices in 26 locations across 17 countries, KLDiscovery is a global leader in delivering best-in-class data management, information governance, and eDiscovery solutions to support the litigation, regulatory compliance, and internal investigation needs of clients. Our Nebula Ecosystem provides powerful end-to-end eDiscovery and enterprise-grade information governance. The Associate Director of AI Science is a highly strategic, business-facing leadership role dedicated to driving commercial value across our Home and Mobility verticals. Sitting at the intersection of advanced machine learning and business strategy, this role focuses on leveraging propensity modeling and dynamic microsegmentation to unlock new revenue streams, optimize the customer lifecycle, and elevate customer lifetime value.
  
  
You will act as the crucial bridge between our technical AI Science teams and the Home and Mobility business units, ensuring that complex AI and data science capabilities are translated into adopted, scalable solutions that deliver measurable ROI and continuous business growth.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Business Strategy & Commercial Value Creation**

* Monetize AI Capabilities: Lead the strategic application of advanced propensity models (e.g., likelihood-to-buy, churn prediction, next-best-action, cross-sell/up-sell) to drive tangible growth and retention in the Home and Mobility sectors.
* Define Microsegmentation Strategy: Guide the development of highly granular, behavioral microsegments to personalize marketing efforts, optimize pricing strategies, and tailor product offerings in real-time.
* ROI Accountability: Establish frameworks to measure the commercial impact of deployed AI models. Define, track, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) that demonstrate direct value creation, revenue lift, and cost optimization.
* Lifecycle Optimization: Embed AI-driven insights into critical touchpoints along the customer lifecycle, ensuring predictive interventions are timed perfectly with high-impact trigger events.

**Stakeholder Management & AI Adoption**

* Executive Liaison: Serve as the primary strategic advisor and translator between the AI Science function and Home/Mobility business leaders (Marketing, Product, Sales, and Customer Experience).
* Drive Business Adoption: Champion the operationalization of AI models. Overcome organizational silos and resistance by demonstrating clear business value, securing buy-in, and embedding AI tools directly into end-user workflows.
* Storytelling with Data: Translate highly technical machine learning concepts, model performance metrics, and statistical outputs into clear, compelling narratives and strategic recommendations for senior executive leadership.
* Needs Translation: Proactively identify business pain points within Home and Mobility and translate these into actionable data science projects, defining clear modeling requirements for the technical teams.

**Technical Oversight & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Model Lifecycle Strategy: Oversee the business strategy for models deployed in high-impact areas, ensuring continuous optimization, accuracy, and relevance to shifting market dynamics.
* Pipeline Integration: Partner closely with Data Engineering, MLOps, and IT teams to ensure models are seamlessly deployed into production environments and marketing automation platforms.
* Team Mentorship: Provide strategic direction and business-context mentorship to data scientists and AI engineers, ensuring their technical execution remains tightly aligned with corporate objectives.

**Core Competencies & Qualifications**
**Experience & Education**

* Education: Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Business Analytics, or a related field (an MBA with a strong quantitative focus is highly preferred).
* Industry Experience: 8+ years of experience in data science, advanced analytics, or AI strategy, with a minimum of 3 years in a leadership, product management, or business-facing role.
* Domain Knowledge: Deep understanding of the telecommunications, broadband, or consumer technology industries, specifically within Home (e.g., fiber, smart home, IoT) and Mobility (e.g., 5G, wireless services) verticals.

**Technical & Business Skills**

* AI/ML Fluency: Strong foundational understanding of machine learning algorithms, deep learning, NLP, and LLM architecture. Must be highly conversant in how techniques utilizing frameworks like PyTorch and scikit-learn are applied to business problems, even if not writing production code daily.
* Advanced Propensity & Segmentation: Proven track record of designing, evaluating, and strategically deploying end-to-end propensity models and clustering techniques for large-scale customer bases.
* Data Stack Familiarity: Experience working with cloud platforms (e.g., GCP, AWS, Azure), production MLOps tools, and large-scale data extraction processes.
* Exceptional Communication: Elite presentation skills with the ability to distill complex analytical findings into actionable business strategies for non-technical stakeholders.

What Success Looks Like in Year One
  
  

* Successfully integrated at least three major propensity or microsegmentation models into the Home and Mobility go-to-market workflows.
* Established a regular cadence of AI performance reporting that clearly demonstrates incremental revenue lift or churn reduction to the executive team.
* Achieved a high adoption rate of AI-driven recommendations among business stakeholders, shifting the organizational culture toward proactive, model-driven decision-making.

Where you’ll be working
  
  
In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.

Moative is an AI company that partners with mid-market businesses in asset-heavy, regulated industries to co-build industry-specific agentic and machine-learning solutions, then scales them across the industry through revenue-share and equity-linked models. The founders have built and sold two companies, one of them in AI, and the 20+ person team of AI/ML engineers, data scientists and mathematicians comes from IITs, IISc, CERN, UZH and IBM Research. **About the Role**

As CTO for Moative's healthcare business, you'll lead technology for an AI management services organisation (AI MSO) for US healthcare practices. It combines operational expertise, data infrastructure and AI to manage and improve revenue-cycle and administrative workflows, automating tasks progressively with clear controls and human accountability. You'll own technology strategy, platform architecture and the engineering organisation, and stay hands-on in architecture, prototypes, code reviews and hard production problems. The role is based in Chennai (Bengaluru is possible), hybrid with 3 days a week in person with the founders and the healthcare AI pod.

* Hire and develop engineers, data scientists and technical leads, and represent Moative's technology to practice owners, partners and investors

**What you bring**

* You've built and scaled a product or technology business as a founder, CTO or senior engineering leader, with clear customer adoption and commercial results
* Experience delivering healthcare or RCM products, with a practical grasp of billing workflows, claim submission, payer interactions, denials, appeals and payment posting
* You've led teams that deploy and support AI in live operations, including LLM applications or agents with evaluation, monitoring and human escalation
* Deep experience integrating and modelling fragmented operational data, including multi-customer platforms with clear data isolation
* Strong Python, SQL and cloud architecture on AWS, Azure or GCP
* Technical controls for sensitive healthcare data: access management, audit trails, secure logging, vendor access and incident response
* Experience owning technology budgets and working directly with CXOs, founders and investors

**Nice to have**

* Building for US outpatient practices, MSOs or RCM companies
* Taking a company through an acquisition, merger or exit, including technical diligence
* Turning services engagements into reusable products
* Healthcare data exchange (claims, remittances, EHR, clearinghouses), process mining, or browser and voice agents for operations

description:

**Position Tittle: EY GDS – Senior Cyber AI Engineer, Technology Consulting:**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services:**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**Role Overview:**
As a Senior Cyber AI Engineer within EY's Global Delivery Services (GDS) Cybersecurity Team, you will drive the convergence of Cybersecurity, Vulnerability Management, and Artificial Intelligence to build intelligent, scalable, and automated security operations.
  
  
You will design, implement, and enhance AI-enabled vulnerability management programs that leverage machine learning, generative AI, intelligent analytics, and automation to improve risk identification, prioritization, remediation, and executive decision-making across enterprise environments.
  
  
In addition to delivering client engagements, you will help shape EY’s AI-driven Cybersecurity capabilities, contribute to thought leadership, and mentor teams on applying AI responsibly and securely within cyber operations.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As organizations rapidly adopt AI and cloud-native technologies, cybersecurity teams must evolve beyond traditional vulnerability management approaches. You will help clients transform their security operations by applying AI and data-driven techniques to vulnerability management lifecycle
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
AI Security & Guardrails
  
  

* Design, implement, and maintain enterprise AI security guardrails.
* Develop controls to mitigate prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage, hallucinations, model abuse, and adversarial attacks.
* Define AI trust, safety, governance, and security standards.
* Evaluate AI applications against organizational security, privacy, and compliance requirements.
* Establish policies and enforcement mechanisms for responsible AI usage.
* Conduct security architecture reviews for AI applications, agents, and autonomous workflows.
* Define secure deployment patterns for LLM, RAG, and agent-based solutions.
* Establish security logging, monitoring, and detection capabilities for AI systems.

AI Red Teaming
  
  

* Conduct AI red team assessments against enterprise AI applications.
* Develop adversarial testing scenarios and attack simulations.
* Identify and document vulnerabilities and weaknesses within AI systems.
* Perform threat modeling for AI-enabled business processes.
* Define remediation recommendations and compensating controls.
* Perform AI-focused penetration testing against LLM, RAG, and agentic applications.
* Assess risks related to prompt injection, indirect prompt injection, tool manipulation, excessive agency, data poisoning, and model abuse.
* Execute threat-informed adversarial simulations aligned to MITRE ATLAS and OWASP LLM guidance.

Engineering & Automation
  
  

* Develop Python-based automation for AI security and testing workflows.
* Build APIs, integrations, and orchestration frameworks supporting AI evaluation efforts.
* Integrate testing and governance controls into CI/CD pipelines.
* Create dashboards and reporting capabilities that provide visibility into AI risk and performance.
* Integrate AI security controls into DevSecOps and Secure SDLC processes.
* Automate security validation, compliance verification, and security regression testing for AI applications.

**Additional AI Security Skills**

* Application Security (OWASP Top 10)
* Secure SDLC / DevSecOps
* Penetration Testing and Red Teaming
* Security Architecture Reviews
* Cloud Security
* Identity and Access Management
* Threat Detection and Monitoring
* Vulnerability Management

Additional Security Frameworks
  
  

* MITRE ATLAS
* OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications
* OWASP ASVS
* NIST AI Risk Management Framework
* NIST Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF)
* Secure AI Development and Governance Frameworks

**To Qualify for the Role**
**Education**

* BE / BTech / MTech / MSc / MCA

**Experience**

* 4–8 years in Cybersecurity
* 2+ years working with AI/ML or Security Automation initiatives
* Experience leading enterprise Vulnerability Management programs

**Preferred Certifications**

* CEH, CISSP, CISM, OSCP, GIAC, Azure AI, Open AI, AWS ML, Azure ML certifications

**What We Look For**
**Professionals who can bridge the gap between cybersecurity and artificial intelligence by:**

* Building AI-enabled cyber defense solutions.
* Automating vulnerability and risk management processes.
* Driving next-generation cyber transformation initiatives.

The ideal candidate combines the mindset of a Security Architect, Vulnerability Management Leader and AI Engineer to create intelligent, scalable, and resilient cybersecurity VM programs.
  
  
**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

**Role Title:**
Senior Consultant - Data Migration, Cleanse and Harmonization Specialist
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai
  
  
We are one purpose-led global organisation. The enablers and innovators, ensuring that we can fulfil our mission to push the boundaries of science and discover and develop life-changing medicines. We take pride in working close to the cause, opening the locks to save lives, ultimately making a massive difference to the outside world.
  
  
AstraZeneca (AZ) is in a period of strong growth and our employees have a united purpose to make a difference to patients around the world who need both our medicines and the ongoing developments from our science. In this journey AZ must continue to work across borders and with partners and new colleagues in a fast and seamless way. The ambition, size and complexity of the organisation, coupled with the opportunities afforded by new technology, has led the Board to approve a large-scale transformation programme – Axial.
  
  
The Axial Programme will be powered by S/4HANA a new ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) system which will be implemented right across the organisation and will provide our business with standardised processes, enhanced financial management, common data and real time reporting, transforming the way we work through our entire supply chain - from bench to patient.
  
  
The new system will be used by more than 20,000 employees daily, is foundational to all AZ entities and is central to most core business processes. This is a once in a generation programme for AstraZeneca and will shape our ways of working globally for many years to come.
  
  
The Axial programme needs the best talent to work in it. Whether it’s the technical skills, business understanding or change leadership, we want to ensure we have the strongest team deployed throughout. We are aiming to deliver a world class change programme that leaves all employees with a fuller understanding of their role in the end-to-end nature of our global company. This programme will provide AZ with a competitive edge, to the benefit of our employees, customers and patients.
  
  
We are looking for a passionate Data Migration and Cleanse and Harmonization Specialist for AstraZeneca, a world leading Pharmaceutical company which operates in over 100 countries and is head quartered in the United Kingdom, translating business requirements into data requirements to create data structures and data integration paths. They will identify, profile, cleanse and quality assess potential source data sets, understand and align with any data restrictions and support the data design elements of the S/4 Programme.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Data Strategy and Design: Translate business requirements into data requirements, architect fit-for-purpose data models, and define integration paths that deliver scalable, maintainable solutions.
* Business Partner Migration: Lead the migration of ECC Customers and Suppliers to S/4HANA Business Partner roles, ensuring robust BP configuration, data alignment, and continuity of business processes.

* Insight Delivery: Acquire data from primary and secondary sources, analyze patterns and trends, and provide evidence-based recommendations that influence process and system design.
* Target Model Design: Support the design of target data models that adhere to enterprise standards, strengthening consistency and interoperability across domains.
* Operational Sustainability: Execute BAU activities to maintain continuity, support releases, and embed continuous improvements that uplift data operations at scale.

**Essential For The Role**
The role holder will possess a blend of SAP data requirement analysis, data quality analysis, data stewardship skills
  
  

* Strong functional knowledge of and experience with SAP Data structures in more than one module e.g. MM, PP, FI, CO, QM, etc.
* Strong expertise in Business Partner (BP) configuration and setup in S/4HANA, including the migration of ECC Customers and Suppliers to the corresponding S/4HANA Customer and Supplier roles, together with the associated Business Partner data.
* Solid knowledge of Purchasing Information Records (PIRs), Quotas, Source Lists, and other procurement-related objects and processes.
* Vast Exposure to Data Analysis - Ability to guide team to perform data profiling, data analysis and present the insights to the business.
* Strong Exposure to IT Project Lifecycle and SAP Data management
* Good Communication skills - should be able to interact effectively with the partners.
* Experience in translating requirements into fit for purpose data models, data processing designs and data profile reports
* Experience in working relevant domains e.g. Pharma, R&D, Manufacturing, Commercial, Finance, HR, Legal, Facilities etc.
* Knowledge on BI Tools and/Information Architecture are added advantages.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, and consultancy skills
* Understanding of fundamental design principles behind a scalable application and data design.
* Ability to interpret and communicate technical information into business language.
* Carry out Business As Usual (BAU) activities required by the role.

**Desirable for the Role**

* Strong SAP data knowledge and project management skills, with the ability to handle assigned activities, collaborate with the Data Analyst team, allocate tasks, monitor deliverables, and provide weekly status updates, including any risks or issues.
* Translate business requirements into data requirements to create data structures and data integration paths

* Experience in coaching Junior Data Analysts and guiding team members to improve their skills for future Business (Data) Transformation
* Good knowledge in improving operating models, ways of working and build the team to deliver effective data analysis services

title: AI Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Overview of Role:
  
  
The AI Forward Deployed Engineer partners directly with business stakeholders to identify high-value opportunities and convert them into secure, scalable and measurable AI solutions. The role combines strong software engineering, generative AI and machine learning capability with stakeholder-facing delivery. It owns the journey from discovery and rapid prototyping through enterprise integration, production deployment, adoption and continuous improvement.
  
  
KPIs:
  
  

* Business Impact: Measured value delivered through AI solutions, including efficiency, quality, revenue, cost or risk outcomes.
* Time to Production: Speed and predictability in progressing priority use cases from discovery and proof of concept to production.
* Solution Quality and Reliability: Accuracy, relevance, latency, availability, scalability and operational stability of deployed solutions.
* Adoption and Stakeholder Satisfaction: Active usage, stakeholder feedback and successful integration into business workflows.
* Security and Governance: Adherence to data privacy, access control, responsible AI and enterprise governance requirements.
* Reusability and Enablement: Reusable accelerators, reference implementations, documentation and knowledge transfer created for broader adoption.

Key Year One Deliverables:
  
  

* Opportunity and Current-State Assessment: Assess priority business opportunities, existing AI capabilities, data sources, platforms, integrations and delivery constraints.
* Stakeholder Needs Analysis: Define business objectives, user needs, success measures, adoption barriers and technical requirements with key stakeholders.
* Prioritized Delivery Roadmap: Create and maintain a roadmap based on business value, feasibility, data readiness, risk and resource needs.
* Prototypes and Proofs of Concept: Develop rapid prototypes to validate technical feasibility, user value and solution direction.
* Production AI Solutions: Build, deploy and operationalize selected AI solutions with appropriate security, scalability, reliability and support readiness.
* Enterprise Integration: Integrate AI capabilities with enterprise applications, identity systems, APIs, data sources and operational workflows.
* Evaluation and Observability: Establish evaluation, error-analysis, logging, metrics, tracing, usage and cost-monitoring mechanisms.
* Documentation and Enablement: Deliver architecture documentation, runbooks, reusable patterns, training and knowledge transfer for users and support teams.

Qualifications:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science , Engineering, Data Science or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Hands-on experience developing software, machine learning or generative AI solutions through internships, academic projects or professional environments; production deployment experience is preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into practical technical solutions and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Experience and Skills:
  
  

* Software Engineering: Strong Python programming; backend and API development using FastAPI, Flask REST or equivalent; REST APIs, SQL, relational databases, Git, testing, debugging and code review.
* Generative AI and Context Engineering: Large language models, prompt and context engineering, RAG and Graph RAG, embeddings, semantic search, vector databases, tool/function calling, memory, agent orchestration and evaluation.
* Machine Learning: ML and deep-learning fundamentals, natural language processing, model evaluation, data preprocessing and experience with PyTorch and/or TensorFlow.
* Production Engineering: Containerization, CI/CD, cloud or on-premises deployment, observability, performance tuning, scalability, resilience and production troubleshooting. Familiarity with multi-model architectures, AI gateways, model routing, token and cost management, and model selection is preferred.
* Data and Integration: Data pipelines, enterprise application integration, identity and access management, secure configuration and interoperability across systems.
* AI Quality and Governance: Evaluation frameworks, error analysis, guardrails, responsible AI, data privacy, security, access control, lifecycle management and usage/cost monitoring.
* Forward Deployed Delivery: Stakeholder discovery, problem decomposition, rapid prototyping, ambiguity management, end-to-end ownership, documentation and knowledge transfer.
* Good to Have: Microsoft Azure and Azure OpenAI; LangGraph, LangChain or comparable frameworks; Qdrant, Milvus, pgvector or FAISS; Docker, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL and Redis; OpenTelemetry, Prometheus and Grafana; LiteLLM or comparable AI gateways.

Key Behaviors:
  
  

* Customer and Business Focus: Builds trusted stakeholder relationships and keeps solutions anchored to measurable user and business outcomes.
* Ownership: Takes responsibility from discovery through production stabilization, adoption and continuous improvement.
* Problem Solving: Uses structured analysis and hands-on troubleshooting across application, model, data, integration and infrastructure layers.
* Agility and Adaptability: Works effectively with ambiguity, changing priorities and evolving AI technologies.
* Collaboration and Communication: Explains complex topics clearly and works effectively across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Infrastructure, Security and business teams.
* Continuous Learning: Actively evaluates new approaches while applying sound engineering judgment, governance and evidence-based decision-making.
* Attention to Detail: Maintains high standards for quality, security, documentation and operational readiness.

Reporting Structure:
  
  
This role reports to the Innovation department lead.
  
  
Visteon Culture
  
  
If you thrive in a fast-paced organizational culture that requires agility, adaptability and a growth mindset to stay ahead of the curve, Visteon is the place. We value high performance and a drive for results. Innovation, risk-taking and continuous learning help us keep pace with the ever-changing landscape of our industry and remain market leaders. At Visteon, you can be more.

title: AI Enterprise Architect
description:
As Ford accelerates its enterprise-wide digital and AI transformation, the AI Advancement Center is expanding its ability to design, build and deploy secure, high-performing AI platforms that can be reused across business functions and geographies.
  
  
As a Principal AI Architect, you will define the architectural vision and technical standards for enterprise AI platforms, connecting strategic business requirements with engineering execution.
  
  
You will work across engineering, data, cloud, cybersecurity and business teams to establish scalable patterns for Machine Learning Operations (MLOps), Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), model serving, data processing and AI governance.
  
  
This is a senior technical leadership role with significant enterprise influence. Your work will help Ford accelerate AI adoption while improving platform reliability, security, reusability and cost efficiency.
  
  
**Enterprise AI Architecture**

* Define end-to-end architecture for enterprise-scale AI, ML and Generative AI platforms across cloud and distributed environments.
* Establish reusable architectural patterns for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), model fine-tuning, inference, model serving, vector search and MLOps.
* Evaluate architectural trade-offs across scalability, performance, security, reliability and cost.

**Platform Engineering & Scale**

* Define engineering standards for high-availability and low-latency AI services.
* Design scalable architectures using technologies such as Kubernetes, Docker, Apache Kafka, Apache Spark and cloud-native services.
* Establish patterns for observability, resiliency, fault tolerance, API integration and production AI operations.
* Guide teams in building reusable platform components instead of isolated point solutions.

**Technical Leadership**

* Provide architecture leadership across multiple engineering and business teams.
* Translate business requirements into scalable technical roadmaps and architecture decisions.
* Lead technical design reviews and help engineering teams resolve complex architectural challenges.
* Communicate architecture strategy, trade-offs and investment priorities to senior technical and business stakeholders.

**AI Governance, Security & Responsible AI**

* Establish AI architecture guardrails covering security, privacy, model governance and responsible AI.
* Partner with cybersecurity, privacy, legal and data-governance teams to embed appropriate controls into AI platforms.
* Support enterprise compliance requirements, including applicable privacy and AI regulations.

**AI FinOps & Optimisation**

* Define strategies for efficient use of cloud AI infrastructure, including GPU and accelerator resources.
* Monitor architectural choices for cost, performance and utilisation.
* Establish patterns for optimising training, inference and high-compute AI workloads.

**Required**

* 8+ years of relevant technology experience, including significant experience designing enterprise-scale distributed or cloud-based platforms.
* Proven experience architecting and deploying AI/ML and Generative AI solutions in production.
* Hands-on architectural experience with capabilities such as:

+ Large Language Models (LLMs)
+ Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
+ Vector databases/vector search
+ Model serving and inference
+ Model fine-tuning
+ MLOps and model lifecycle management

* Strong knowledge of at least one major cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Deep understanding of distributed systems, microservices and container orchestration using technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience with large-scale data and event processing technologies such as Apache Kafka and Apache Spark, or equivalent platforms.
* Experience designing highly available, fault-tolerant and performance-sensitive production systems.
* Demonstrated ability to influence architecture and engineering decisions across multiple teams.
* Strong communication skills with experience engaging senior technical and business stakeholders.

**Preferred**

* Experience establishing enterprise AI governance, privacy, security and Responsible AI controls.
* Knowledge of regulatory frameworks relevant to AI and data protection, such as the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and EU Artificial Intelligence Act.
* Experience optimising GPU or accelerator-based workloads and implementing cloud Financial Operations (FinOps) practices.
* Experience working within an AI Centre of Excellence (CoE), enterprise platform organisation, or other central technology function.
* Experience leading enterprise-scale AI adoption or technology transformation programmes.

Awareness of MLflow, Vector Search, RAG, and AI/ML platform integration.
  
  
**Experience In Enterprise FinOps, Chargeback/showback, And Cloud Cost Governance.**

title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
About Team
  
  
GDF sits at the core of Walmart's AI & Data organization, building the foundational data platforms that make it possible for every team at Walmart — technical or non-technical — to build with trustworthy, well-governed, discoverable data. Our platforms serve billions of transactions and interactions across 19 countries, powering everything from supply chain intelligence to customer-facing personalization to enterprise AI agents. This particular team is newly formed to solve one of GDF's next big platform bets — which means you'll be shaping charter, operating model, and delivery cadence essentially from a blank page, not inheriting someone else's playbook.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
Lead the engineering team(s) responsible for designing, building, and operating GDF's core data platform capabilities - pipelines, processing frameworks, storage layers, and service APIs that power downstream analytics and AI workloads across Walmart.
  
  
Stay hands-on: write and review production code, prototype solutions to hard technical problems, and participate directly in design and code reviews rather than delegating all technical depth to the team.
  
  
Own the engineering roadmap, technical execution, and delivery of scalable, high-throughput data services built on languages/frameworks including Java, Python, and Spark.
  
  
Guide architecture and system design decisions across distributed data processing systems, batch and streaming pipelines, data lake/lakehouse storage, and enterprise integrations.
  
  
Drive the design and evolution of Big Data capabilities - data ingestion, transformation, quality, observability, and governance - at the scale Walmart's platforms require.
  
  
Partner with product managers, data scientists, ML engineers, and platform/security teams to deliver reliable, well-governed data capabilities that enable downstream analytics, reporting, and AI/ML use cases.
  
  
Lead pragmatic integration of AI and GenAI capabilities into the data platform - e.g., feature pipelines for ML models, embeddings/vector search for retrieval, LLM-assisted data quality checks, and intelligent pipeline monitoring - wherever they create measurable engineering or business value.
  
  
Ensure systems are designed for scalability, reliability, performance, observability, security, and cost efficiency, appropriate for petabyte-scale enterprise data platforms.
  
  
Lead engineering execution across the full software development lifecycle - design, coding, testing, CI/CD, deployment, monitoring, incident management, and ongoing operational excellence.
  
  
Champion DevOps, platform engineering, and automation best practices to improve engineering velocity, reduce toil, and support continuous delivery for a newly formed team building process and standards from scratch.
  
  
Establish engineering standards through architecture reviews, design reviews, code reviews, testing strategy, observability practices, and production readiness reviews.
  
  
Define and track engineering and data quality metrics - availability, latency, pipeline SLAs, data freshness, defect rates, deployment frequency, incident trends, and cost efficiency.
  
  
Hire, mentor, and develop hands-on engineers, building a high-performing team culture grounded in craftsmanship, ownership, and continuous learning.
  
  
Build strong cross-functional relationships across engineering, product, data science, and business teams to align priorities, manage dependencies, and remove blockers.
  
  
Continuously evaluate emerging Big Data, cloud, and AI/ML technologies, applying them pragmatically where they improve platform reliability, engineering productivity, or business value.
  
  
What You'll Bring
  
  
12+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant hands-on experience building and operating large-scale data platforms, distributed systems, and backend services.
  
  
4+ years of engineering leadership experience, including managing engineers and leading technical teams through complex delivery programs.
  
  
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  
  
Genuinely hands-on: comfortable writing, reviewing, and debugging production code - not just directing others. Strong proficiency in Java and Python is required; working knowledge of Spark for distributed data processing is expected.
  
  
Strong exposure to Big Data technologies and ecosystems - Spark, Hadoop/HDFS, Hive, Kafka, or equivalent - including batch and streaming data processing, data pipeline design, and large-scale data transformation.
  
  
Experience with data platform fundamentals: data modeling, ETL/ELT pipeline design, data quality and observability, data governance, and integration with enterprise data lakes/lakehouses (e.g., Delta Lake, BigQuery, Databricks).
  
  
Strong experience with microservices architectures, distributed systems, event-driven patterns, API design, and enterprise system integration.
  
  
Deep understanding of cloud-native engineering practices - CI/CD, containerization, Kubernetes or equivalent orchestration, infrastructure automation, and production operations.
  
  
Strong knowledge of reliability engineering - observability, distributed tracing, logging, metrics, alerting,
  
  
incident response, capacity planning, and fault tolerance for large-scale data systems.
  
  
Full exposure to AI technologies in a production data platform context - hands-on experience integrating model APIs and GenAI/LLM-based tooling, working with embeddings/vector search, and applying MLOps practices (feature stores, model lifecycle, retraining pipelines). Comfortable using AI to strengthen data quality checks, pipeline monitoring, and engineering productivity, not just aware of it conceptually.
  
  
Proven ability to translate ambiguous business/technical problems into clear execution plans, especially in a newly formed team without established process.
  
  
Strong people leadership skills - hiring, coaching, mentoring, performance management - and a track record of building engineering culture from the ground up.
  
  
Strong ownership mindset, sound technical judgment, high accountability, and comfort operating in a 0-to-1 environment.
  
  
**About Walmart Global Tech**
Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We’re a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world’s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered.We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail.
  
  
Walmart’s culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our Chennai office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives.
  
  
**Benefits**
Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more.
  
  
Belonging
  
  
We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone.
  
  
At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included." By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is—and feels—included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we’re able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate.
  
  
Equal Opportunity Employer
  
  
Walmart, Inc., is an Equal Opportunities Employer – By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions – while being inclusive of all people.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications...Outlined below are the required minimum qualifications for this position. If none are listed, there are no minimum qualifications.
  
  
Option 1: Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, computer information systems, software engineering, or related area and 5 years’ experience in software engineering or related area.
  
  
Option 2: 7 years’ experience in software engineering or related area. 2 years’ supervisory experience.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications...Outlined below are the optional preferred qualifications for this position. If none are listed, there are no preferred qualifications.
  
  
Master’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, computer information systems, software engineering, or related area and 3 years' experience in software engineering or related area., We value candidates with a background in creating inclusive digital experiences, demonstrating knowledge in implementing Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 AA standards, assistive technologies, and integrating digital accessibility seamlessly. The ideal candidate would have knowledge of accessibility best practices and join us as we continue to create accessible products and services following Walmart’s accessibility standards and guidelines for supporting an inclusive culture.

**AI Engineer - Intern (Autonomous Driving) — Tempero**

**About Kedge and Tempero**

Kedge Systems Private Limited (https://kedge360.com/) is hiring 2–3 software developer interns for 5–6 months, starting December 2026 or January 2027, to build AI-driven Python tools for the Tempero project.

Kedge is a Chennai-based software consulting company, in business since 2008, with a team of 30 across Chennai and Bangalore working for European clients.

Tempero (https://tempero.tech/) works on scenario-based validation for simulation testing of autonomous driving systems: scenario intelligence, causal analysis of scenarios, and software-in-the-loop (SIL) and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing with simulators such as CarMaker, DYNA4 and esmini.

**Internship at a glance**

Role: AI Engineer - Intern

Openings: 2–3

Duration: 5–6 months, full-time

Start: December 2026 or January 2027

Location: On-site at Kedge, SSPDL Alpha City, Navalur, Chennai

Project: Tempero
(https://tempero.tech/)

**What you'll work on**

•
You'll write production-quality Python that applies AI to autonomous-driving test scenarios, working alongside Tempero's engineers in Chennai.

• Build Python modules and services for Tempero's scenario-analysis and validation workflows

• Integrate large language models (LLMs) through APIs: prompt design, structured outputs, tool calling and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)

• Develop data pipelines that parse, clean and analyse scenario files, simulation logs and test results

• Prototype machine-learning and statistical methods, including causal analysis of scenario outcomes

• Help connect Tempero modules to simulators such as esmini, CarMaker and DYNA4 in SIL setups

• Evaluate what you build: create small benchmark sets, measure accuracy and report findings

• Write tests with pytest, document your code and take part in code reviews on Git

• Demo your progress to the team at regular sprint reviews

**What we're looking for**

•
Strong Python fundamentals and the ability to learn fast matter more than prior AI experience.

• Final-year student or 2025/2026 graduate in BE/BTech, ME/MTech, MCA or MSc (Computer Science, IT, ECE, EEE, Mechatronics, Automobile, Data Science or a related field)

• Available full-time and on-site in Chennai for at least 5 months; final-semester students need college approval for a full-time internship

• Solid Python: functions, classes, modules, virtual environments, error handling, and reading and writing JSON, XML and CSV

• Working knowledge of data structures, algorithms and object-oriented design

• Hands-on use of at least one of NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn or PyTorch

• Basic familiarity with LLMs: you have called an LLM API or built a small project with one

• Comfortable with Git and the Linux command line

• Clear written and spoken English

• At least one project (GitHub, academic or personal) you can walk us through in detail

**Nice to have**

•
None of these are required; each one helps you ramp up faster on Tempero.

• Built something with an LLM framework or SDK (for example LangChain, LlamaIndex or a model provider's SDK), embeddings or a vector database

• Experience exposing Python code as a web API with FastAPI or Flask, and packaging it with Docker

• Interest in automotive, ADAS or autonomous driving; exposure to OpenSCENARIO, OpenDRIVE, esmini, CARLA or MATLAB/Simulink

• Grounding in statistics, probability or causal inference (for example DoWhy)

• Hackathon, Kaggle or open-source contributions

description:
Fieldproxy (YC W22) builds the operating system for field service companies: HVAC, electrical, plumbing, facilities and installation businesses in the US, UK, Australia and New Zealand. Most of them still run on spreadsheets, WhatsApp and software from 2005. We rebuild how they work, using AI.
