description:
SENIOR MANAGER - FORWARD DEPLOYED
  
  
ENGINEER
  
  
**Location: Chennai (on site) | Type: Fulltime**
**About Newpage Solutions**
Newpage Solutions is a global digital health innovation company helping people live longer, healthier lives. We partner with life sciences organisations which include, pharmaceutical, biotech and healthcare leaders, to build transformative AI and data driven technologies addressing real-world health challenges.
  
  
From strategy and research to UX design and agile development, we deliver and validate impactful solutions using lean, human-centered practices.
  
  
We are proud to be a
**Great Place to Work certified**
company for the last three consecutive years. We also hold a top
**Glassdoor rating**
and are named among the "Top 50 Most Promising Healthcare Solution Providers" by CIOReview. As an organisation, we foster creativity, continuous learning and inclusivity, creating an environment where bold ideas thrive and make a measurable difference in people s lives.
  
  
Your Mission
  
  
We are hiring a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer to take the hardest AI problems in Finance and Global Business Services from whiteboard to production for a global pharmaceutical company, and to set the patterns the rest of the team builds on. You will join a function team, define the problem, and lead the build from first prototype through production handoff and support, taking the engagements that span multiple systems or teams in areas such as financial close, forecasting, accounts receivable, procure-to-pay, tax, treasury and shared services operations.
  
  
This is a senior hands-on individual contributor and technical lead role in the company's Finance and Global Business Services technology and AI capability center in Chennai. You will set the engineering patterns other Forward Deployed Engineers follow, review their designs and code, and still write code every week, alongside Product Owners, process owners, and digital platform and architecture teams. You will work directly with Finance and Global Business Services leaders worldwide, so you find out fast whether what you build works. You can grow your career through technical leadership without moving into people management. Success is measured by adoption, demonstrable business outcomes (time saved, quality, risk, controls, cycle time, better decisions, financial impact) and how much of your work others reuse.
  
  
The role needs regular overlap with US and European time zones, including some early-evening IST calls, and can be demanding at times, including period-end close support and leading the response to production incidents. You don't need every bonus skill listed. If you have led AI into production that people use and want to work close to the business, we want to hear from you.
  
  
What You ll Do Problem Discovery and Business Partnership
  
  

* Work in person in Chennai while embedding virtually with assigned Finance and Global Business Services teams.
* Lead discovery for complex, cross-functional use cases through regular calls, screen-share walkthroughs and process reviews with senior stakeholders and process owners across regions, including the US and Europe, and shape them into roadmaps with measurable outcomes.
* Work with Product Owners to turn priorities and specifications into solution designs and delivery plans, and to rank use cases by value, feasibility and risk.
* Say no, or not yet, when a use case lacks data, sponsorship or a clear value case, and push back when a specification doesn't match the underlying problem or runs into technical issues and limitations.

Technical Leadership and Build
  
  

* Serve as technical lead on complex engagements: own solution design, stay hands-on in the code, and lead the design of agentic AI built with frontier models on the company's enterprise AI platforms.
* Design multi-agent and multi-step workflows on Azure AI Foundry, Vertex AI and other market-leading runtimes, using frameworks such as Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph and Lang Chain, with MCP, A2A and APIs connecting enterprise systems, deterministic business rules and human approval steps.
* Set coding standards, evaluation practice and quality bars for the engagements you lead, including review standards for AI-generated code.
* Use AI coding agents in your daily workflow to speed delivery, show other engineers how to use them well, and make build-versus-buy and platform choices with digital platform and architecture teams.

Data and Enterprise Integration
  
  

* Lead integration across Finance and Global Business Services data and systems through governed MCP tools or APIs and certified data products, such as SAP S/4HANA, Snowflake (including Cortex), Databricks, SAP Ariba and Business Network, Oracle EPM, Microsoft 365, other enterprise platforms and custom solutions.
* Help shape a shared Finance and Global Business Services data and AI foundation (ontology, rules engine, MCP tool library and decision ledger), and decide which patterns become shared building blocks.
* Define data contracts, semantic models and access patterns, and extend the shared ontology and business rules, such as Delegation of Authority, Segregation of Duties and materiality, that other engineers and agents reuse.
* Set data access, entitlement and classification practice for financial and personal data on the engagements you lead.

Controls, Compliance and Responsible AI
  
  

* Own control design for your solutions. Engage SOX, Internal Audit, Privacy, Legal, Security and AI governance early, including data privacy (GDPR, India DPDP Act) and EU AI Act review, and pass required gates before release.
* Define evaluation and monitoring for accuracy, drift and failure modes on financial outputs, and make sure agent evidence, approvals and actions are recorded in the decision ledger.
* Enforce responsible AI safeguards: data access controls, prompt injection defenses, human review and output monitoring.

Production, Reliability and Reuse
  
  

* Own production readiness and ongoing support for the solutions you lead: LLMOps practice, deployment pipelines, monitoring, incident response and run costs.
* Establish support ownership, runbooks, service expectations, escalation paths, knowledge transfer and root cause analysis for production solutions.
* Set the standard for logging, tracing, monitoring and alerting with Azure Monitor, Application Insights and Foundry Observability.
* Convert proven solutions into reusable components, templates and accelerators across Finance and Global Business Services, and identify and pay down technical debt before it blocks scale.

Mentoring, Value and Adoption
  
  

* Mentor Manager-level Forward Deployed Engineers, and engineers in Finance and Global Business Services function teams, through design reviews, pairing and code review.
* Contribute to Forward Deployed Engineering playbooks, interview loops and team upskilling.
* Build business cases and track realized value: hours saved, cycle time, cost avoidance and risk reduction.
* Present results and tradeoffs to senior Finance and Global Business Services stakeholders and Forward Deployed Engineering leadership, and build champions in the business so adoption sticks.

What You Bring Engineering and AI Delivery
  
  

* 7+ years of software or data engineering experience, including at least three years building and shipping LLM-based applications to production, with at least one multi-step agentic system with tool use, evaluation and monitoring.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related field.
* Technical lead experience on complex, multi-system builds.
* Expert-level Python, with strong TypeScript/JavaScript and SQL.
* Hands-on experience with cloud architecture, ideally Azure; AWS is also considered. Includes API-first design, CI/CD and observability.
* Hands-on LLMOps practice: evaluation, tracing, and prompt, model and agent versioning.
* Daily use of AI coding agents in your own engineering work, with the judgement to review AI-generated code.

Business Partnership and Leadership
  
  

* Able to partner with the business, turn messy problems into working solutions, and show the impact in numbers.
* Proven ability to influence senior business stakeholders without formal authority.
* Experience mentoring engineers.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* A Master's degree in a technical field, or a finance or accounting background combined with engineering experience.
* Deep knowledge of finance processes such as record-to-report, order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, FP&A or treasury, or prior work in finance technology.
* Experience integrating with SAP (S/4HANA, GTS, Ariba), Snowflake (including Cortex), Databricks, the Azure AI stack (AI Foundry, AI Search, Document Intelligence, Azure ML), Vertex AI or Oracle EPM; comparable enterprise platforms are also considered.
* Experience with agent orchestration frameworks such as Microsoft Agent Framework, Lang Graph or Lang Chain, MCP server development and A2A; other orchestration frameworks are also considered.
* Experience with ontologies, knowledge graphs or rules engines.
* Experience with SOX and IT general controls in a regulated industry.
* Experience turning bespoke solutions into reusable platforms or products.

What We Offer
  
  
At Newpage, We Re Building a Company That Works Smart And Grows With Agility, Where Driven Individuals Come Together To Do Work That Matters. We Offer

title: Senior Research Specialist, AI & ML
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
  
  
**Group/Division**
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. At KLA, physics and data are at the core of everything we do. Our AI and Modeling Center of Excellence drives innovation across KLA products by combining expertise in physics modeling, high-performance computing (HPC) and AI. The group is comprised of top-tier physicists, machine learning engineers, HPC architects and data scientists that collaborate to develop scalable, cutting-edge solutions for our customers. We’re hiring across multiple disciplines—this is your opportunity to make a global impact.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
  
  
The work spans both applied and fundamental research. You will identify high-value research problems, formulate them mathematically, develop novel learning methods, build proof-of-concept systems, and conduct rigorous evaluations. Successful research outcomes will be translated into scalable solutions through collaboration with multidisciplinary engineering and domain teams.
  
  
This role is not focused on building conversational assistants or connecting foundation models through predefined workflows. The central challenge is to develop intelligent systems that interact with analytical tools, reason over heterogeneous engineering data, make sequential decisions, and improve through feedback. We are looking for researchers who view agentic AI as a learning and decision-making problem involving observations, actions, tools, feedback, uncertainty, and measurable outcomes. We value scientific rigor and sound judgment, selecting methods based on the structure of the problem rather than on current trends.
  
  
**What You Will Work On**
You will develop intelligent systems capable of:
  
  

* Reasoning over images, text, measurements, metadata, and domain knowledge.
* Planning and executing multi-step analytical workflows.
* Selecting and invoking specialized algorithms, models, and software tools.
* Examining intermediate results and deciding what action to take next.
* Learning from expert demonstrations, human feedback, and execution outcomes.
* Improving decision policies through reinforcement learning.
* Explaining decisions using grounded and verifiable evidence.
* Operating reliably in complex scientific and engineering environments.

**Potential Research Areas**

* Reinforcement learning for foundation-model reasoning and post-training.
* Multimodal agents for engineering analysis and decision support.
* Sequential decision-making for inspection and metrology workflows.
* Adaptive tools, algorithms, measurement, and data acquisition strategies.
* Learning from domain-expert feedback and verifiable execution outcomes.
* Reward design, agent trajectory learning and optimization.
* Human-agent collaboration and knowledge-grounded reasoning.
* Agent reliability, interpretability, and failure of recovery.
* Fine-tuning and evaluating LLMs and VLMs for specialized domains.

**Day-to-Day Responsibilities**

* Identify high-value opportunities for reinforcement learning, agentic AI, and multimodal reasoning in semiconductor inspection and metrology.
* Formulate scientific and engineering workflows as learning and sequential decision-making problems.
* Design intelligent agents that reason over multimodal data, use specialized tools and adapt their actions based on feedback.
* Develop and evaluate learning methods that improve agent reasoning, planning, tool use, and decision quality.
* Adapt foundation models to specialized scientific and industrial applications.
* Design rigorous experiments to assess performance, reliability, generalization, grounding, and failure recovery.
* Build reproducible prototypes and collaborate with engineering, infrastructure and domain teams to translate successful research into scalable solutions.
* Communicate research findings and collaborate with global multidisciplinary teams.
* Manage a team of engineers working in the space of AI

**Minimum Qualifications**

* PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning or a related discipline, with 3 to 5 years of relevant research or industrial experience; or a master’s degree with 5 to 10 years of relevant experience. Candidates with less experience may be considered if they demonstrate an exceptional research or engineering record.
* Strong foundation in at least one of the following: reinforcement learning; sequential decision-making; learning-based agents; foundation-model post-training; or planning and decision-making under uncertainty.
* Hands-on experience designing, implementing or evaluating intelligent agents involving planning, tool use, retrieval, memory, self-correction, multi-step execution, or learning from feedback.
* Working experience with LLMs, VLMs, multimodal foundation models, or generative foundation models.
* Sound understanding of reinforcement-learning concepts, including policies, rewards, value functions, exploration, credit assignment, policy optimization and evaluation.
* Ability to formulate real-world problems in terms of observations, states, actions, rewards, and sequential objectives.
* Strong foundation in deep learning, transformer architectures and representation learning.
* Hands-on experience developing, training, fine-tuning and evaluating models using PyTorch, JAX, TensorFlow or a comparable framework.
* Strong Python programming skills and the ability to develop maintainable and reproducible research software.
* Ability to formulate research and engineering problems mathematically.
* Experience designing controlled experiments, defining appropriate baselines, and selecting meaningful evaluation of metrics.
* Ability to analyze experimental results, identify failure modes, and draw evidence-based conclusions.
* Ability to follow rapidly evolving research and translate relevant ideas into working prototypes.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and geographically distributed teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Research or industry experience in reinforcement learning, agentic AI, multimodal learning, or foundation-model adaptation.
* Experience developing intelligent systems that learn from feedback, interact with tools, and operate over extended decision-making horizons.
* Experience training, fine-tuning, or evaluating language, vision-language, or multimodal foundation models.
* Experience developing robust evaluation frameworks for agent performance, reliability, and generalization.
* Experience applying machine learning to complex scientific, engineering, or industrial problems.
* Evidence of strong technical depth across modern machine learning, deep learning, and AI systems research.
* Evidence of team leadership in small or large organizations.

**Things That Would Make Us Go “Wow”**

* A demonstrated record of advancing the state of the art in reinforcement learning, agentic AI, multimodal learning, or foundation models.
* Experience building intelligent agents that learn from feedback, use tools effectively, and operate reliably in complex environments.
* Evidence of applying advanced AI methods to challenging scientific, engineering, or industrial problems with measurable impact.
* Experience defining rigorous evaluation methodologies for agent performance, reliability, and robustness.
* A track record of translating research innovations into scalable systems, products, or business outcomes..

**About KLA**
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.
  
  
**Use of AI Statement**
At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.
  
  
*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*
*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.*

At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing...**
This is a leadership role that will require deep technical expertise in AI Engineering and will focus on establishing a strong AI Engineering, AI Platforms that enables Generative and Agentic AI solutions at scale.
  
  
Delivering AI Platforms at Scale
  
  

* Leading the AI engineering team and overseeing the end-to-end development, deployment, and maintenance of scalable AI platforms and frameworks, including delivering core services across the Generative and Agentic AI landscape.
* Owning non-functional KPIs across production deployments of AI applications and agents on the Enterprise AI platform, covering key components such as the AI SDK, Agent Registry, and Agent Builder.
* Managing and tracking strategic KPIs to evaluate the effectiveness, efficiency, and business impact of enterprise AI solutions.
* Driving innovation by researching, evaluating, and adopting emerging AI technologies, tools, and methodologies to expand organizational AI/ML capabilities.
* Ensuring best-in-class engineering standards in AI development—including rigorous model validation, automated testing, and reliable deployment—while adhering to ethical and regulatory frameworks.
* Directing project delivery timelines, budgets, and engineering resources to ensure the execution of high-impact AI initiatives.

Building and Managing the Team
  
  

* Championing a transparent global operating model to establish strong operational foundations across regions.
* Building and scaling a high-performing engineering team that operates with autonomy, high accountability, and urgency toward delivering business outcomes.

Fostering Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion
  
  

* Attracting and retaining top-tier AI engineering talent with deep technical expertise.
* Enabling team member growth through continuous training pathways, structured on-the-job coaching, and dedicated mentorship.
* Fostering an open research culture that empowers practitioners to conduct pioneering work and contribute externally via open-source initiatives and technical publications.

description:
**Hiring for:**
An AI-driven US healthcare technology company, recognised among the USA's Top 25 fastest-growing healthcare companies.

**Role:**
Principal AI Engineer - Scalable GenAI Systems- Chennai - 0 to 1 building

**Positions:**
1

5 to 10 years

**Work Shift: UK Shift 3.30 PM - 12.30 AM (In office, Chennai)**

**Location(s):**
Chennai

**Type:**
On-site / Permanent

**Salary:**
Best in Market

We are looking for a hands-on AI Architect who can own the AI thought vision for the Client and personally drive AI-powered features from idea to production.

This is a builder’s role, not an advisory one — you will architect the AI infrastructure, write production code, integrate AI tools across our stack, and design systems that scale with our patient population. You will be the technical owner of every AI capability client ship.

Indicative time split:

* 80% Hands-On Technical Development
* 20% Other (vision, architecture reviews, stakeholder alignment, tooling evaluation).

**Key Focus Areas**

* AI Thought Vision — set the technical direction for how AI is applied across the Client’s clinical, operational, and patient-facing workflows.
* Build AI Infrastructure — design and implement the foundational platform (model gateways, retrieval pipelines, prompt management, evaluation harness, observability).
* Full Execution / Hands-On — write production code, build prototypes, and ship AI features end-to-end. This is not a hands-off architect role.
* Integrate All AI Tools — bring together LLM APIs, vector stores, agent frameworks, AI voice/transcription, and AI-powered SaaS into a cohesive, well-governed stack.
* Build for Scalability — design systems that scale across thousands of patients and millions of interactions, with cost, latency, accuracy, and safety in mind
  **.**

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Own the architecture for all AI capabilities — conversational agents, summarization, clinical decision support, workflow automation, voice/transcription, and analytics.
* Take AI ideas from concept to production — prototype, validate, harden, and ship real applications used by patients and clinicians.
* Build the core AI infrastructure: model abstraction layer, prompt versioning, evaluation pipelines, retrieval (RAG) systems, agent orchestration, guardrails, and observability.
* Design and implement RAG pipelines over clinical and operational data with strong relevance, freshness, and privacy controls.
* Build and operate AI agents and tool-use workflows that interact with EHRs, telephony, messaging, and internal systems.
* Define and enforce evaluation methodology — offline eval sets, online metrics, regression detection, and accuracy/safety benchmarks for every AI feature.
* Drive responsible AI practices — PHI handling, prompt-injection defense, hallucination mitigation, audit logging, and HIPAA-aware design.
* Evaluate and integrate the best-of-breed AI tools, models, and platforms (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source LLMs, vector DBs, agent frameworks, AI voice).
* Optimize for cost and latency — model routing, caching, batching, distillation, and rightsizing.
* Partner with the Technical Manager and engineering team to ship AI features cleanly into the production platform.
* Partner with Product, Clinical, and Operations leaders to identify the highest-value AI opportunities and convert them into shippable applications.
* Mentor engineers on AI engineering practices; raise the team’s overall AI literacy and execution capability.
* Maintain a forward-looking view of the AI landscape and continuously bring proven advances into the product.

**Technical Requirements**

* Proven hands-on experience taking AI ideas from prototype to real-time, production grade applications running at scale.
* Strong programming proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to write and ship production code independently.
* Deep, working knowledge of modern LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, and open-source models) — including function/tool calling, structured outputs, streaming, and cost/latency optimization.
* Hands-on experience designing and operating RAG systems — chunking, embeddings, vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, or similar), hybrid retrieval, and reranking.
* Experience building agentic systems with tool use, planning, and multi-step workflows.
* Strong prompt engineering skills, including evaluation, versioning, and continuous improvement.
* Experience with AI evaluation frameworks — golden sets, LLM-as-judge, A/B testing, and regression tracking.
* Solid backend engineering fundamentals — REST APIs, asynchronous processing, queues, observability, and scaling patterns.
* Working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and serverless/low-code environments.
* Strong understanding of data privacy, PHI/HIPAA constraints, and responsible AI practices.
* Good to have: experience with AI voice/transcription (Whisper, Deepgram, ElevenLabs, etc.), AI-powered telephony, or conversational AI in regulated domains.
* Good to have: experience fine-tuning, distilling, or self-hosting open-source models.
* Good to have: experience working with healthcare data formats (HL7v2, FHIR, CCDA) and EHR integrations.

**Preferred candidate profile**

* Demonstrated technical excellence and a strong portfolio of AI applications taken from idea to real-time production — not just prototypes or proofs of concept.
* Years of experience are secondary to proven ability to ship; we are optimizing for builders who can show concrete, scaled outcomes.
* Track record of architecting AI systems that handle real users, real data, and real reliability/cost constraints.
* First-principles thinker who can decompose ambiguous problems, evaluate trade-offs, and pick the simplest workable AI architecture.
* Strong ownership mindset and bias for shipping — comfortable with iteration, measurement, and continuous improvement.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; able to explain AI trade-offs clearly to engineering, clinical, and business stakeholders.
* Good to have: prior experience in healthcare AI, clinical NLP, or AI in regulated domains.
* Good to have: open-source contributions, published work, or talks demonstrating AI engineering depth.
* Willingness to work to align with US business hours.

We are looking for an experienced engineer to develop and deploy AI applications on AWS, combining generative AI, autonomous agents and machine learning. You will take solutions from experimentation through production, with responsibility for reliability, evaluation, security and ongoing operation.
  
  
Role: Hands-on engineering with client interaction

* Apply guardrails, personal-data protection, audit logging and human review controls.
* Develop conventional ML workflows where needed, including feature engineering, training, tuning, deployment, monitoring and retraining.
* Implement testing, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, model and prompt versioning, observability, alerting and operational documentation.
* Work with architects, data engineers, application teams, domain specialists and client stakeholders to define and deliver testable capabilities.
* Support demonstrations, user acceptance testing, production releases, troubleshooting, performance improvements and knowledge transfer.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* 6–8 years of experience in AI/ML, data science or software engineering, with strong Python programming and production engineering skills.
* Hands-on experience with Amazon Bedrock, including foundation models, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, model evaluation and agent or tool-calling implementations.
* Strong practical understanding of GenAI and RAG, including embeddings, vector databases, retrieval strategies, reranking and prompt engineering.
* Experience with agent orchestration, planning, memory, tool invocation, human approval workflows and multi-agent coordination.
* Working knowledge of supervised learning, feature engineering, model evaluation, deployment, drift detection and monitoring.
* Experience integrating solutions using AWS Lambda, Step Functions, OpenSearch, S3 and APIs, with secure access to enterprise data.
* Hands-on experience with Git, automated testing, CI/CD, containers and infrastructure or configuration automation.
* Ability to work directly with US-based business and technical stakeholders, explaining solution behaviour, evaluation results, limitations and engineering trade-offs.

* Amazon SageMaker for developing and operating ML pipelines.
* Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Strands Agents, LangGraph, LangChain or comparable agent frameworks.
* OpenSearch vector search or knowledge graphs.
* AI delivery in Life Sciences or Healthcare, particularly research, clinical operations, medical affairs, commercial operations, manufacturing or pharmacovigilance.
* Familiarity with regulated environments and GxP requirements.
* Responsible AI, red teaming, synthetic evaluation data, LLM observability, fine tuning or multimodal applications.
* Terraform or AWS CDK.
* Relevant AWS certifications in AI or machine learning.

What Success Looks Like
  
  
Delivering secure, reliable AI applications with measurable quality, effective agent execution, monitored performance and cost, reusable components, and a successful transition from proof of concept to production.
  
  
How to Apply
  
  
**Interested Candidates Can Share Their Updated Resumes At**
hr@letzbizz.com
  
  
Please mention Senior AI Engineer – Generative AI and AWS in the email subject.

title: AI Innovation Engineer
description:
**Vestas is the global leader in sustainable energy solutions and a driving force in the wind energy industry. Our core business encompasses the development, manufacturing, sales, installation, and servicing of wind turbines worldwide. At Vestas, we are committed to accelerating the transition to renewable energy while creating innovative solutions that deliver value to our customers and stakeholders.**
**Digital Solutions & Development > Digital Solutions > Autonomous Flows - IN**
The Autonomous Flows Advisors team sits within Vestas' Digital Development Platform and accelerates the AI and automation transformation across the business. We act as internal advisors and enablers, partnering with product teams and business areas across the value chain (R&D, commercial, manufacturing, supply chain, services and business services) to help shape the AI strategy, scope high-impact solutions, and ensure responsible, scalable AI adoption. We work closely with cyber, legal, and data governance, and collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders at all levels.As an AI Innovation Lead, you will support the redesign and operationalize frontline workflows using AI and automation. Working closely with the business teams, local technology leads, and global product teams, you will help translate business priorities into measurable workflow transformations and operational prototypes. You'll be responsible for implementing the local solutions while keeping in mind potential risks and opportunities to turn your solutions into global product features. This is not a research or purely strategic role. You will be expected to get into the details, challenge assumptions, and deliver tangible innovation.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
As an AI Innovation Lead, you will play an instrumental role in our efforts to enable the Vestas AI transformation. You will be responsible for:
  
  

* Supporting the mapping and redesign of frontline workflows together with the relevant business teams - Assessing data readiness, technical feasibility, and implementation complexity for proposed automation initiatives
* Supporting the definition of success metrics and expected business outcomes for each AI initiative, in collaboration with stakeholders
* Developing local automations in collaboration with business stakeholders and subject matter experts
* Connecting automations to relevant enterprise data and systems using approved integrations and connectors
* Testing deployed prototypes with live frontline data and iteratively improving solution quality based on structured SME feedback and evaluation results
* Identifying recurring workflow patterns, reusable components, and enterprise-scaling opportunities
* Translating learnings into a structured backlog for global solutions product owners

**Qualifications**
To be successful in this role, you need to be a highly motivated, energetic, and self-driven person, who can work independently and collaboratively with a diverse set of stakeholders. We imagine that you have most of the qualifications and competences below:
  
  

* A relevant degree in a quantitative field (IT, physics, mathematics, etc.), business transformation, or similar, combining strong technical understanding and excellent communication skills - At least 3 years of relevant experience in a similar role
* Practical understanding of automation and AI use cases, limitations, and pitfalls
* Hands-on experience building AI, automation, or software solutions using modern AI development tools
* Experience with product discovery, business process redesign, automation, operational excellence, or digital transformation initiatives

**Competencies**

* Pragmatic and structured approach to problem solving, with a focus on value creation
* Excellent communication skills, both oral and written - Ability to work across complex organizations and manage conflicting stakeholder interests
* Ability to translate complex AI concepts into clear, actionable language for non-technical stakeholders
* You seek to constantly acquire new knowledge, stay up to date within AI, and challenge yourself
* Fluent spoken and written English is a prerequisite

**What We Offer**

* Purpose. An opportunity to impact climate change and the future of next generations through automation and AI.
* Steep learning curve. You will be joining a strong team of AI advisors with both broad and deep knowledge. That means that you will have somebody to learn from, just as we will invest in continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and upskilling.
* Strong relationships. We will strive to build an informal environment of mutual trust and a tightly knit team, where we can support and inspire each other to deliver great impact for Vestas.
* Opportunity to shape your role. We have been asked to scale and anchor the impact of AI and automation across Vestas. The rest is up to us.
* Healthy work life balance, with flexible working options.
* Commitment to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. Everyone can thrive and bring their unique perspectives and skills to the team.

**Additional Information**
Your primary location will be in Chennai, India
  
  
Please note: We do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to the advertised closing date. Please be advised to apply on or before 30th Nov 2026
  
  
Learn more about Vestas at www.vestas.com and follow us on our social media channels
  
  
**Our commitment to a fair hiring.**
At Vestas, we evaluate all candidates solely based on their professional experience, education, and relevant skills. To support a fair recruitment process, we kindly ask that you remove any photos, dates of birth or graduation, gender pronouns, marital status, or other personal information not relevant to the role before submitting your CV/resume. Your CV/resume should focus on your professional and educational background, along with the necessary contact details (email and phone number). We train our hiring teams in inclusive evaluation and regularly review process outcomes to ensure fairness.
  
  
**DEIB Statement**
At Vestas, we recognize the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future.
  
  
**BEWARE – RECRUITMENT FRAUD**
It has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails from people pretending to work for Vestas. Read more via this link, https://www.vestas.com/en/careers/our-recruitment-process
  
  
**About Vestas**
Vestas is the energy industry’s global partner on sustainable energy solutions. We are specialised in designing, manufacturing, installing, and servicing wind turbines, both onshore and offshore.
  
  
Across the globe, we have installed more wind power than anyone else. We consider ourselves pioneers within the industry, as we continuously aim to design new solutions and technologies to create a more sustainable future for all of us. With more than 200 GW of wind power installed worldwide and 40+ years of experience in wind energy, we have an unmatched track record demonstrating our expertise within the field.
  
  
With 39,000 employees globally, we are a diverse team united by a common goal: to power the solution – today, tomorrow, and far into the future.
  
  
Vestas promotes a diverse workforce which embraces all social identities and is free of any discrimination. We commit to create and sustain an environment that acknowledges and harvests different experiences, skills, and perspectives. We also aim to give everyone equal access to opportunity.
  
  
To learn more about our company and life at Vestas, we invite you to visit our website at www.vestas.com and follow us on our social media channels. We also encourage you to join our Talent Universe to receive notifications on new and relevant postings.

title: AI & GENAI LEAD
description:
**Function:**
Information Systems

**Location:**
Brakes India, Chennai, Padi

**Experience:**
**15+ years overall, including strong polyglot full-stack engineering experience and at least 5 years in AI/ML/GenAI, with demonstrated production deployments**

**Role Summary**

Lead the technical architecture, engineering implementation and production operations for Brakes India’s enterprise AI, Generative AI and agentic AI solutions. This is a senior hands-on technology leadership role for a polyglot full-stack engineer who has grown through enterprise software engineering, cloud-native application development, APIs, integrations and production operations, and can now apply that foundation to AI, GenAI and agentic AI at scale. The role will work as a technical lead within the AI CoE, translating the enterprise AI roadmap into scalable, secure, cost-effective and well-operated platforms, products and deployment pipelines.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Translate the enterprise AI, GenAI and agentic AI roadmap into technical architecture, delivery plans, engineering standards, implementation approaches and production operating models.
* Lead technical discovery with business, data and application teams to assess feasibility, integration needs, model approach, deployment architecture and engineering complexity.
* Own end-to-end solution architecture for production AI systems covering models, data, retrieval, agents, orchestration, applications, APIs, security, observability and resilience.
* Guide development of RAG, tool-using agents, multi-agent workflows, copilots and AI-enabled enterprise applications.
* Ensure robust evaluation for quality, grounding, safety, latency, cost, resilience and business effectiveness.
* Establish and manage reusable engineering patterns, reference architectures, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, release practices and secure deployment standards.
* Implement responsible AI, model risk, access, privacy, intellectual property, auditability and human-oversight controls as part of the technical design and operating model.
* Build, mentor and technically guide a multidisciplinary team of AI engineers, Python developers, full-stack engineers, data scientists and platform specialists.
* Partner with enterprise architects, data teams, cybersecurity, infrastructure, SAP and digital product teams for scaled adoption.
* Lead platform operations across MLOps, LLMOps, AgentOps, AI observability and AIOps, including monitoring, incident response, lifecycle management and production support.
* Manage pipeline engineering, environment management, deployment readiness, performance tuning, capacity planning, FinOps and ongoing cost optimisation for AI workloads.

**Required Experience & Skills**

* Strong polyglot software engineering background across Python and one or more modern enterprise programming languages, with proven ability to move across languages, frameworks, tools and technology stacks as needed.
* Strong full-stack engineering foundation across frontend, backend, APIs, microservices, databases, cloud platforms, DevOps and production support, with the ability to review architecture and code credibly.
* Deep knowledge of machine learning, deep learning, LLMs, embeddings, prompt engineering, RAG and agentic AI patterns.
* Hands-on understanding of agent frameworks such as LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen or comparable orchestration approaches.
* Experience designing and operating enterprise-grade applications involving APIs, microservices, event-driven integrations, relational and vector data stores, containers, CI/CD, identity, secrets management and secure enterprise integration.
* Ability to guide teams across the complete engineering lifecycle: solution design, coding standards, code reviews, testing, deployment, monitoring, performance tuning, incident handling and continuous improvement.
* Strong knowledge of LLM evaluation, guardrails, tracing, monitoring, model and prompt lifecycle, cost optimisation and production support.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure AI services, Azure OpenAI and Microsoft Foundry or equivalent enterprise AI platforms.
* Ability to connect AI architecture choices to process transformation, adoption, risk and measurable business value.

**Demonstrated Experience Required**

Candidates must substantiate their individual ownership and contribution through specific examples, scale and measurable outcomes.

* Prior leadership in building and scaling production-grade enterprise software platforms, full-stack applications, API-led integrations or cloud-native products before or alongside AI/GenAI solutions.
* Multiple AI or GenAI solutions personally led into production, with active users and measurable business outcomes.
* Candidate’s individual role in use-case selection, architecture, engineering decisions, risk controls, deployment and scale-up.
* Examples of RAG, agentic or workflow-integrated solutions beyond demonstrations or isolated proofs of concept.
* Scale and performance evidence, including users, transaction or document volumes, quality measures, latency, cost and support model.
* AI technical architecture, engineering standards, platform operating model, deployment practices or AI CoE technical capability personally established or materially shaped.
* Team mentoring outcomes and evidence of improving engineering quality, delivery speed and production readiness.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science or a related discipline.
* Relevant cloud, AI or architecture certifications are preferred.

**Leadership Attributes**

* Hands-on polyglot technology leader with strong engineering fundamentals, architectural depth and a builder mindset.
* Balances experimentation with engineering discipline, responsible deployment and measurable value.
* Develops internal capability and anticipates the evolution of models, platforms and operating practices.

**Stakeholder & Communication Skills**

* Able to frame use cases with business leaders and explain architecture, risk and value in clear business language.
* Strong mentoring, influencing and cross-functional leadership across business, engineering, data, security and operations.

**Diversity Statement**

Brakes India is an equal opportunity employer committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Women candidates are strongly encouraged to apply.

title: AI Ops Engineer
description:
The Ford Credit Global Data Insights and Analytics (FC - GDIA) department is looking for a motivated and talented AI – Ops Engineer with strong cloud infrastructure and AI operations expertise to build, automate, and secure the platform that powers our advanced artificial intelligence solutions for the Ford Credit team.
  
  
In this role, you will act as the backbone of our quantitative analytics and AI engineering teams. Your primary mission will be to design, automate, and operate the end-to-end cloud and AI infrastructure — including CI/CD pipelines, containerized microservices, observability, and platform guardrails — so that our Generative AI applications and modelers can run safely, scalably, and reliably in production.
  
  

* Cloud Platform Engineering: Architect and operate highly available, multi-service AI infrastructure on the cloud, managing the full lifecycle of compute, storage, networking, and security for AI workloads.
* AI-Ops / LLMOps Pipelines: Establish robust MLOps and LLMOps pipelines covering the end-to-end lifecycle of Generative AI tools — including model deployment, version control, prompt and artifact tracking, automated evaluation, and continuous monitoring for performance, drift, and hallucination mitigation.
* CI/CD Automation: Design and maintain automated build, test, and deployment pipelines for full-stack AI applications, ensuring seamless and secure continuous integration and delivery across front-end, back-end, and AI components.
* Infrastructure as Code: Manage cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, Cloud Build, Kubernetes manifests) to deliver reproducible, auditable, and scalable environments.
* Containerization & Orchestration: Build and operate containerized microservices (Docker/Kubernetes), managing scaling, rolling deployments, resource optimization, and service resilience for AI workloads.
* Observability & Reliability: Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, and SRE practices to ensure platform reliability, availability, and performance of AI applications in production.
* Security & Governance: Embed security across the platform — identity and access management, secrets management, network policies, and data protection — ensuring all AI workloads meet Ford's strict data privacy, security, and compliance standards.
* Developer Enablement: Work closely with AI engineers, software engineers, and analytical modelers to provide self-service tooling, environments, and automated workflows that remove friction from development to production.

**Skills Knowledge Required**

* Cloud Platform: Extensive hands-on experience with a leading cloud provider (e.g., Google Cloud Platform), including Cloud Run, Cloud Build, GKE, GCS, BigQuery, IAM, VPC networking, and Secret Manager.
* DevOps / SRE Practices: Strong proficiency in CI/CD tooling, GitOps, containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and cloud-native monitoring and logging.
* AI-Ops / LLMOps: Proficiency in tools and platforms for model deployment, prompt/model versioning, evaluation, tracing, and monitoring of LLM and GenAI outputs.
* Scripting & Automation: Hands-on experience with a programming/scripting language such as Python, or Bash for automating infrastructure and operational tasks, and for building tooling that serves collaborators.
* Software Engineering Fundamentals: Working knowledge of full-stack application architecture and modern deployment patterns for AI tools, with the ability to integrate front-end, back-end, and AI services reliably.
* Security & Compliance: Familiarity with cloud security best practices, identity and access management, secrets management, and compliance standards in regulated environments.
* Analytics Workflow Understanding: Awareness of the typical workflows of data scientists and modelers (data wrangling, feature engineering, model validation) so you can build reliable platforms and pipelines that serve them.

* Qualifications Experience
* Education: Master's or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cloud Computing, Data Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* DevOps/Cloud Engineering Experience: 3–5 years of overall experience in cloud engineering, DevOps, or SRE, with at least 1–2 years of dedicated, hands-on experience deploying and operating AI, ML, and Generative AI applications in production.
* AI/MLOps Engineering: Proven track record of implementing CI/CD for AI workloads, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and cloud infrastructure management (Terraform, Cloud Build, GKE).
* Automation & Reliability: Demonstrated experience with infrastructure automation, incident response, and building observable, self-healing production systems.
* Good to Have (Optional):: Previous exposure to the Banking, Financial Services, or Credit Analytics industries. Experience with Machine Learning engineering and model serving frameworks, or relevant cloud certifications (e.g., Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer / Cloud Architect).

title: Associate Director, Software Architecture
description:
**About Us**
Volante Technologies is the leading global provider of low-code cloud Payments as a Service solution for financial businesses. We are disruptors and innovators and we are growing fast. For the last three years, we have been the #1 seller of wholesale payment systems worldwide. At Volante, we are all about revolutionizing the world of Payments.
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
We are looking for a seasoned Technical Architect who is currently active in hands-on engineering and brings deep expertise across messaging systems, Java-based backend technologies, large-scale distributed architecture, and modern cloud-native delivery. The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of architecture and engineering — capable of drawing design blueprints in the morning and writing production code or conducting a proof of concept in the afternoon.
  
  
This is a practitioner-first role. You will be expected to make informed architectural decisions grounded in proven patterns, lead by example in technical execution, and mentor engineering teams through complex design and delivery challenges. You should be comfortable using AI/LLM tools in your day-to-day work and have the ability to quickly understand, learn, and implement AI-enabled solutions where they add clear value.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  
Hands-On Architecture & Design
  
  

* Design and evolve large-scale, distributed systems with a focus on scalability, reliability, and performance, including AI/LLM-enabled components where appropriate.
* Make well-reasoned architectural decisions based on proven patterns such as Event-Driven Architecture, CQRS, Saga, Circuit Breaker, and API Gateway, and apply similar rigor to AI integrations (guardrails, fallbacks, observability).
* Create clear architecture blueprints, sequence diagrams, and technical specifications to guide engineering teams, including designs for services that interact with LLM APIs or AI workflows.
* Actively participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and sprint ceremonies to ensure architectural alignment, and leverage AI tools to accelerate reviews, refactoring, and documentation where suitable

Messaging & Integration Systems
  
  

* Design and implement messaging solutions using Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, IBM MQ, and ActiveMQ.
* Leverage Apache Camel for enterprise integration patterns, routing, and transformation pipelines, including integration with AI/LLM services where relevant.
* Ensure high-throughput, fault-tolerant messaging architectures that meet SLA requirements.
* Evaluate and recommend the right messaging technology based on use-case, volume, and latency requirements.

Software Engineering (Java & Spring Ecosystem)
  
  

* Develop and review production-quality code in Java and Spring Boot, leading by technical example, and use AI/LLM tools to assist with boilerplate, tests, and refactoring while maintaining high quality.
* Champion microservices best practices including API design, service decomposition, and inter-service communication, including secure and observable integration with AI services.
* Conduct and lead Proof of Concepts (POCs) for evaluating new frameworks, libraries, and technologies.
* Ensure adherence to coding standards, design patterns, and engineering best practices, including safe and responsible use of AI-generated code and suggestions.

Containerization, Kubernetes & Cloud
  
  

* Design and oversee containerized deployment strategies using Docker and Kubernetes (K8s).
* Manage workload orchestration, autoscaling, resource quotas, and namespace design on Kubernetes clusters.
* Collaborate with DevOps and platform teams to build robust CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code practices, incorporating AI-enabled tooling to improve productivity and reliability.
* Ensure container security, network policies, and secrets management are baked into the architecture.

Observability & Performance Monitoring
  
  

* Establish and embed observability frameworks covering distributed tracing, structured logging, and metrics collection.
* Define performance monitoring and alerting standards across services and infrastructure.
* Conduct performance profiling and tuning of Java applications including JVM, heap, and GC optimization.
* Lead performance benchmarking exercises and resolve bottlenecks in high-traffic, latency-sensitive systems.

Memory Management & Performance Tuning
  
  

* Demonstrate deep expertise in JVM memory management — heap sizing, GC strategies, metaspace, and memory leak analysis.
* Utilize profiling tools (e.g., JProfiler, VisualVM, async-profiler) to diagnose and resolve performance issues.
* Tune application performance at the code, runtime, and infrastructure levels.
* Define best practices for resource utilization and memory-efficient programming patterns.

Database Architecture (RDBMS & NoSQL)
  
  

* Design relational data models and optimize queries for PostgreSQL, Oracle, or MySQL.
* Architect NoSQL solutions using MongoDB including schema design, indexing strategies, and aggregation pipelines.
* Define data access patterns, connection pooling strategies, and caching layers.
* Ensure data consistency, integrity, and resilience across distributed data stores.

Proof of Concepts & Innovation
  
  

* Proactively identify technology gaps and propose PoCs to validate architectural decisions before broader adoption, including AI/LLM-based approaches where they can improve productivity, reliability, or customer outcomes.
* Work hands-on with engineering teams during PoC phases to prototype and evaluate solutions.
* Translate PoC outcomes into actionable architectural recommendations and implementation roadmaps.

What You Bring
  
  
Must-Haves
  
  

* 12 to 16 years of progressive hands-on experience in software engineering with a strong architecture track record.
* Currently active in coding and engineering — not purely a management or advisory role.
* Demonstrable expertise in Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, IBM MQ, ActiveMQ, and Apache Camel.
* Strong proficiency in Java and Spring Boot for building enterprise-grade microservices and APIs.
* Proven experience designing large-scale distributed systems that handle high volumes and strict SLAs.
* Deep knowledge of Kubernetes and containerization including production cluster operations.
* Expertise in observability practices — distributed tracing (e.g., Jaeger, Zipkin), logging (ELK/EFK), and metrics (Prometheus/Grafana).
* Strong understanding of JVM internals, memory management, and performance tuning techniques.
* Solid experience with both RDBMS (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB).
* Ability to make architecture decisions grounded in established patterns and proven engineering principles.
* Experience conducting and leading Proof of Concepts (PoCs) end-to-end.
* Comfortable using AI/LLM tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) in day-to-day work for design, coding, reviews, documentation, and debugging.
* Demonstrated ability to quickly understand, learn, and implement AI/LLM-based solutions and integrate them pragmatically into enterprise architectures when they add clear value.

Nice-to-Haves
  
  

* Experience in payments, financial messaging, or regulated financial technology platforms.
* Exposure to event sourcing, stream processing (e.g., Kafka Streams, Apache Flink).
* Experience with chaos engineering and resilience testing practices.
* Hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs or using AI frameworks (e.g., Spring AI, LangChain4j, or similar) in Java-based systems.
* Familiarity with vector databases or vector search (e.g., pgvector, Weaviate, Pinecone, Milvus) and RAG patterns.
* Exposure to responsible-AI practices in production (data governance, auditability, cost/latency monitoring, human-in-the-loop where needed).

What We Offer
  
  
✔ Competitive compensation
  
  
✔ Health benefits
  
  
✔ Remote/flexible work options
  
  
✔ Professional development support
  
  
📍 Location
  
  
Chennai / Pune

At Volante Technologies, we believe diversity drives innovation and inclusion fuels success. We are committed to creating a performance driven workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic self to work. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and ensure equitable opportunities for growth. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, age, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. Together as ONE TEAM, we celebrate differences and foster collaboration, creativity, and belonging.

title: System Development Engineer I, Amazon

Our massively scaled out distributed systems process hundreds of millions of updates on the billions of products across physical, digital, and services offerings. To achieve this, we develop the algorithms and build the systems and tools to ensure the safety of the selection and maximize their impact on the Amazon top-line, all the while continuously growing the overall selection. We develop and apply technologies spanning parallel processing, storage, Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, and Image Recognition.
  
  
You will be part of Services Support Team under Catalog Support and Programs (CSP) in ASCS Org. The mission of the Catalog Support and Programs (CSP) team is to provide a single point of contact for item-related problems and issues related to all retail and merchant catalog. As a member of ASCS team, you’ll play a key role in driving Amazon’s business. You will be responsible for providing Service Level issue support to all ASCS Engineering teams who built tier 1-3 systems and keep their software packages/configurations free from vulnerability, setup and monitor new metrics and alarms for their systems and drive root cause resolutions to the recurrent issues. You will build tools to improve operational efficiency.
  
  
This role requires an individual with excellent System/Tool coding abilities along with AWS services understanding. The successful candidate will be a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity, have strong attention to detail, and will be comfortable accessing and working with data from multiple sources. The candidate should also have strong communication skills, enabling them to work with Engineering team to understand requirements and shape analytical deliverables. Candidate should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically and analytically about business, product, and technical challenges, with the ability to work cross-organizationally. A keen sense of ownership and drive is must. The role will work with a diverse set of data and cross-functional teams as well as use data to drive process improvement. An ideal engineer is one who enjoys discovering and solving ambiguous problems, can quickly learn complex systems, and enjoys building actionable insights from data.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* You handle all incoming system and service tickets with responsibilities covering multiple products, features and services.
* Software deployment support in staging and production environments.
* Given a defined problem, you deliver a solution which is logical, maintainable, that uses appropriate technologies, and is delivered on time.
* You learn current engineering best practices and get their designs, code & procedures reviewed, and incorporate feedback.
* You identify and scope problems and opportunities arising from technical discussions, calculate costs of proposed solutions, and make technical trade-offs.
* You contribute to operational excellence and perform troubleshooting to resolve defects.
* Drive Company Wide Campaigns and keep the Compliance risks (SAS, Shepherd etc.) for ASCS systems under control.

A day in the life

* Global Culture: Opportunity to thrive in a diverse, inclusive, and multicultural multinational environment.

title: AI Research Engineer
description:
You will turn research ideas into working models. That means reading the latest papers, reproducing them, adapting them to Indian data, training at scale, and shipping what works into products used by millions.

This is a hands-on role for someone equally comfortable in a training loop and a research paper. You will own experiments end to end and work directly with the Head of AI Research.

**What You'll Work On**

You will join one or more of these workstreams, based on your strengths:

* **Image and video generation:**
  Diffusion and flow-matching models for culturally grounded Indian imagery and cinematic video.
* **Voice and speech:**
  Multilingual, emotion-controllable TTS for Indian languages.
* **Music generation:**
  Multi-language music models, LoRA adaptation and serving.
* **Language models:**
  Fine-tuning and evaluating Indic LLMs against public benchmarks.
* **Agentic AI:**
  Multi-agent systems that power creative and production workflows.
* **Film and media AI:**
  Restoration, rotoscoping and masking for film archives.
* **Evaluation:**
  Benchmarks for model reliability, uncertainty and cultural accuracy.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Read, reproduce and extend state-of-the-art papers in generative AI, speech and LLMs.
* Design and run experiments: data pipelines, model architecture changes, training and ablations.
* Train and fine-tune large models on multi-GPU clusters using distributed training (DeepSpeed, FSDP).
* Build and curate Indic datasets, including annotation, cleaning and quality filtering.
* Define evaluation metrics and benchmarks, and compare models rigorously against public baselines.
* Optimise models for production: quantisation, distillation and serving with Triton or vLLM.
* Write clear design docs, experiment reports and code that others can build on, following our Jira and PR process.
* Contribute to papers for top conferences and workshops (CVPR, NeurIPS, ICASSP, Interspeech and similar).

**Must Have**

* B.Tech/B.E., M.Tech/MS or PhD in CS, AI, EE, Maths or a related field — or equivalent proven work.
* Strong Python and PyTorch; you can write a training loop and debug it without a framework hiding the details.
* Solid grasp of deep learning fundamentals: transformers, attention, optimisation, and at least one of diffusion models, speech models or LLMs.
* Hands-on experience training or fine-tuning models on GPUs, including LoRA or other parameter-efficient methods.
* Ability to read a paper and implement it from scratch.
* Good maths foundation: linear algebra, probability and calculus.
* Clear written communication you document experiments so others can reproduce them.
* At least one concrete artefact: a paper, a strong GitHub repo, a Kaggle result or a shipped ML system.

**Nice to Have**

* Publications at top AI, vision or speech venues.
* Experience with large-scale distributed training (DeepSpeed, Megatron, FSDP) on GPU or TPU clusters.
* Inference optimisation: TensorRT, Triton Inference Server, vLLM, CUDA kernels.
* Work with Indian languages, speech or media data.
* Experience building agents or tool-using LLM systems.
* Cloud experience on GCP (Vertex AI, GKE, GCS).
* Open-source contributions to ML libraries.

**What We Offer**

* Access to world-class GPU compute and a large proprietary Indian film and music catalog.
* Ownership of real research problems from the first month, not just support tasks.
* Support and time to publish at top conferences.
* A small, fast team with direct access to research leadership.
* Competitive compensation, based on experience.

Job Description:
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Job Description: Azure Data Cloud Architect
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
We are seeking an experienced and visionary Azure Data Cloud Architect to lead the strategy, design, and modernization of cutting-edge, enterprise-scale data solutions on Microsoft Azure. In this role, you will serve as a strategic technical leader bridging business strategy and technology execution. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders—including the Data Hub, Digital & AI teams, and DevOps—to translate complex business requirements into high-performing, resilient, secure, and cost-effective cloud data architectures.
  
  
Your deep expertise in Azure cloud data services, advanced data modeling, modern ETL/ELT pipelines, cloud governance, and enterprise digital transformation will drive continuous innovation, scalability, and efficiency across our global data ecosystem.
  
  
Key Strategic Focus Areas
  
  

* Solution Architecting: Designing robust, multi-region end-to-end architectures that leverage the full power of Azure native data and analytics services.
* Modernization & Cloud Migration: Leading the evolution from legacy data warehouses, databases, and on-premises infrastructure to cloud-native Azure data solutions.
* Digital & AI Transformation: Enabling advanced analytics, machine learning, and business intelligence capabilities that empower data-driven decision-making across the enterprise.

Detailed Roles, Responsibilities & Key Activities
  
  

* Strategic Solution Architecting
* End-to-End Architectural Leadership: Design, architect, and deliver scalable, resilient, and secure data platform architectures utilizing the complete Azure data ecosystem (e.g., Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Azure SQL Database, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure SQL Managed Instance, and Azure Data Lake Storage).
* Business & Technical Alignment: Partner closely with business stakeholders, product managers, and leadership in Digital & AI to evaluate business needs and translate them into high-level architectures (HLD) and technical architecture documents (TAD).
* Target State Architecture: Define future-state data architecture roadmaps, network flow matrices, environment topologies, secret inventories, and enterprise data models (star/snowflake schemas, Data Vault, or relational models).
* Modernization & Enterprise Data Transformation
* Legacy System Cloud Migration: Architect and execute cloud migration strategies to transition legacy on-premises databases, data warehouses, and ETL jobs into modernized Azure cloud-native equivalents with minimal operational disruption.
* Modern Data Integration (ETL/ELT): Oversee and optimize real-time, micro-batch, and batch data pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Databricks, and Event Driven architectures to accelerate time-to-insight.
* Innovation & Emerging Technologies: Continuously evaluate emerging cloud, AI/ML, and IoT technology capabilities (e.g., Azure ML, Logic Apps, Service Bus) to solve complex data challenges and expand automated operational workflows.
* Implementation, Governance, Security & Operations
* Data Security & Regulatory Compliance: Ensure full compliance with global and enterprise data privacy and security standards (including GDPR, HIPAA, UK data residency regulations, and client-specific security standards such as Sodexo policies).
* Automated Governance & Lineage: Establish comprehensive data governance frameworks encompassing metadata management, enterprise data cataloging, lineage tracking, data quality monitoring, and role-based access control (RBAC).
* DevOps, IaC & Automation: Work with DevOps teams to drive automated infrastructure provisioning and continuous delivery using Infrastructure as Code (IaC with Azure Bicep/ARM templates/Terraform) and Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines.
* Security & Vulnerability Remediation: Regularly review security compliance reports (e.g., Sodexo's CACTUS tool, Azure Security Center) and leverage Azure Key Vault, Private Endpoints, and Managed Identities to remediate security risks.
* Performance Tuning & Cost Optimization: Monitor, audit, and tune data pipelines, query performance, and storage tiers for maximum speed, enterprise resilience, and cloud cost efficiency (FinOps).
* Technical Leadership, Mentorship & Stakeholder Collaboration
* Team Mentorship & Guidance: Act as a hands-on technical mentor to data engineers, data analysts, and data scientists, instilling cloud design patterns and architecture best practices.
* Cross-Functional Synergy: Foster seamless collaboration between data engineering, infrastructure, security, DevOps, and business analytics teams.
* Operational Guidelines & Standards: Author standard operating procedures, architectural guidelines, reference architectures, and deployment documentation.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**
Education
  
  

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related quantitative field (Master’s Degree preferred).

**Experience**

* Overall Experience: Minimum 5+ years of progressive experience in data engineering and solution architecture.
* Azure Cloud Focus: Minimum 3+ years of dedicated experience architecting, building, and deploying enterprise-scale cloud data solutions specifically on Microsoft Azure.
* Migration Experience: Demonstrated track record of leading complex data warehouse and pipeline migrations from legacy platforms to Azure.

**Preferred Certifications**

* Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203)
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)

Technical & Professional Skills
  
  
Primary Azure Services & Data Architecture
  
  

* Core Data Services: Expert-level knowledge of Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure Databricks, Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS Gen2), Blob Storage.
* Integration & Security: Azure Key Vault, Azure Private Link / Private Endpoints, Azure Data Gateway, Azure Relay, RBAC.
* Supporting Cloud Infrastructure: Azure IaaS/PaaS, Application Gateway, Azure Load Balancer, Web Apps, Function Apps, Logic Apps, Azure Service Bus, Azure Machine Learning.

Engineering, DevOps & Methodologies
  
  

* Data Engineering & Query Languages: Advanced proficiency in SQL, T-SQL, Python/PySpark, PowerShell, and database design.
* DevOps & IaC: Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps (pipelines, repos), Infrastructure as Code (Azure Bicep, ARM, or Terraform), and continuous deployment practices.
* Monitoring & Analytics: Familiarity with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and business intelligence suites (Power BI).

**Soft Skills & Leadership Capabilities**

* Communication: Exceptional communication and storytelling skills with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical executive stakeholders.
* Strategic Problem Solving: Highly analytical mindset with strong organizational, risk management, and decision-making skills.
* Collaboration: Natural collaborator who thrives in global, matrixed enterprise environments.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
**Job Description: Solution Architect**

We are looking for an experienced
**Solution Architect**
to lead the design and implementation of scalable, high-performance Python and cloud-native backend systems. This role balances hands-on technical execution with high-level architectural design, leading engineering teams to build resilient, event-driven microservices that translate complex business needs into production-ready software solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**System Architecture & Design**

* Define and own the end-to-end architecture for scalable, reliable, and maintainable systems using microservices and event-driven architectures.
* Define High-Level Design (HLD) and Low-Level Design (LLD) specifications, data models, and service boundaries.
* Ensure all systems are designed with an API-first approach, applying SOLID principles and clean architecture practices.
* Evaluate and manage system trade-offs between speed, cost, performance, availability, and security.

**Technical Leadership & Delivery**

* Lead a team of engineers and drive the end-to-end software development lifecycle (SDLC) from discovery to production deployment.
* Collaborate closely with product, QA, and DevOps teams for seamless execution and timely delivery.
* Take complete ownership of engineering deliverables and unblock team members to ensure alignment with project milestones.

**Backend Development & Cloud Engineering**

* Design and develop robust RESTful and GraphQL APIs using Python frameworks (FastAPI, Django, Flask).
* Work extensively with relational databases (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL systems (MongoDB, Redis).
* Develop and deploy cloud-native applications on AWS or Azure using serverless compute (AWS Lambda) and container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes / EKS).

**Quality, Observability & Governance**

* Conduct thorough code reviews, enforce strict coding standards, and actively reduce technical debt.
* Implement end-to-end observability, including logging, monitoring, metrics, and alerting frameworks (Datadog, Prometheus).
* Ensure non-functional requirements—performance, security, fault tolerance, and low latency—are built into every solution.

**Communication & Mentorship**

* Mentor and guide junior and mid-level engineers to foster continuous technical growth.
* Conduct and present technical demos, architecture reviews, and solution walkthroughs to executive stakeholders.
* Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, architecture decision records (ADRs), and developer guides.

**Required Qualifications**

* **Experience:**
  8–12 years in software engineering with a strong background in backend delivery and system design.
* **Python Mastery:**
  Deep knowledge of core Python (decorators, generators, async programming, AsyncIO, and concurrency).
* **API & Backend Frameworks:**
  Proven hands-on track record building enterprise APIs using FastAPI, Django, or Flask.
* **Microservices & System Design:**
  Strong experience with microservices architecture, event-driven systems, and messaging queues (Kafka, SQS, RabbitMQ).
* **Cloud & Containers:**
  Hands-on experience with AWS and/or Azure services (Lambda, EKS, ECS), containerization (Docker), and CI/CD automation pipelines.
* **Databases:**
  Practical experience with PostgreSQL and NoSQL database query optimization.
* **Soft Skills:**
  Excellent communication and collaboration skills with a proven ability to own and drive projects independently.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience designing and consuming GraphQL APIs.
* Exposure to observability and monitoring suites (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana).
* Practical exposure to AI/ML integrations, Generative AI workflows, or LLM-based microservices.
* Knowledge of multi-cloud architectures and hybrid enterprise setups.

**Tech Stack (Indicative)**

**Area**

**Technologies**

**Languages & Frameworks**

Core Python, FastAPI, Django, Flask, Node.js (Optional)

**API Architecture**

RESTful APIs, GraphQL, OpenAPI, WebSockets

**Cloud & Containers**

AWS (Lambda, EKS, ECS, S3, RDS), Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm

**Messaging & Events**

Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS, EventBridge

**Databases**

PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis

**DevOps & CI/CD**

Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Terraform, Azure DevOps

**Observability**

Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, AWS CloudWatch

* The overall microservices architecture and technical strategy of the organization.
* Build vs. buy decisions for cloud services and developer tooling.
* Engineering culture around clean code practices, automated testing, and cloud-native system design.
* Technical mentorship and hiring standards for backend and platform engineering teams.
