title: Cloud Services Manager (Container)
description:
Req ID: 142267
  
  
Remote Position: Hybrid
  
  
Region: Asia
  
  
Country: India
  
  
State/Province: Chennai
  
  
City: Guindy, Chennai
  
  
**Summary**
Seeking an execution-focused, technically proficient
**Manager of Cloud Services**
to lead the day-to-day engineering and operations of our multi-cloud ecosystem across
**AWS, Azure, and GCP**
. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Cloud Architecture & Engineering, you will lead a dedicated squad of cloud, DevOps, and platform engineers tasked with translating high-level architecture designs into robust, production-grade deployments.
  
  
You will manage the implementation, maintenance, and reliability of our enterprise container platforms (GKE, AKS, OpenShift, and native Kubernetes), operationalize infrastructure for AI models and agentic workflows, and drive hands-on GitOps and IaC practices. This is an active, technical leadership role requiring direct participation in code reviews, pipeline automation, disaster recovery execution, and operational support.
  
  
Detailed Description
  
  
Performs tasks such as, but not limited to, the following:
  
  

* Blueprint Execution: Translate multi-cloud architectural frameworks into production-ready infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
* Container Environment Provisioning: Implement and standardize cluster topologies across Red Hat OpenShift, GKE, AKS, and upstream Kubernetes per architectural guidelines.
* AI Runtime Infrastructure: Deploy and support execution infrastructure for machine learning and agentic AI systems (e.g., configuring GPU/TPU nodes, model serving runtimes like vLLM/Triton, vector database clusters, and secure runtime sandboxes for agent execution).
* IaC Authoring & Review: Write, review, and maintain production Terraform modules, Helm charts, and raw Kubernetes/Kustomize manifests.
* GitOps Delivery: Manage and optimize automated GitOps pipelines using ArgoCD or Flux to ensure version-controlled, continuous deployments across staging and production clusters.
* Internal Platform Enablement: Maintain CI/CD pipelines, container registries, and self-service templates enabling software engineering and data science teams to deploy microservices smoothly.
* Cluster Lifecycle Execution: Coordinate and execute rolling cluster version upgrades, worker node pool patching, and OS maintenance across multi-cloud Kubernetes fleets with zero service disruption.
* Capacity & FinOps Tracking: Monitor resource consumption, configure cluster autoscalers (KEDA, Karpenter), implement pod resource quotas, and track daily compute costs across cloud providers.
* Vulnerability & Compliance Remediation: Enforce container base image hardening, automate CVE scanning (Trivy, Grype), and ensure runtime admission controllers (OPA/Gatekeeper/Kyverno) adhere to enterprise standards.
* Backup Automation: Implement, test, and manage automated backup routines for Kubernetes cluster states and persistent storage using tools such as Velero or Kasten.
* Model & Artifact Protection: Ensure secure, regular backups and snapshot validation for persistent AI datasets, model weights, and state stores.
* Incident Management & Escalations: Serve as an operational escalation point for L2/L3 production incidents, directing troubleshooting for container, network, and cloud outages.
* Telemetry Operations: Manage centralized logging, metrics, and tracing stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Datadog), configuring actionable alerting rules and dashboards.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Lead post-incident retrospectives, track action items to resolution, and implement self-healing automations to avoid recurrence.

Knowledge/Skills/Competencies
  
  

* Multi-Cloud Administration: Hands-on operational experience with AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (VPC/VNet configuration, IAM roles, cloud storage, security groups).
* AI & Agentic Workload Enablement: Practical experience deploying and managing infrastructure supporting AI/LLM workloads, containerized inference runtimes, or AI agent toolsets.
* Infrastructure as Code & Templating: Advanced proficiency writing and maintaining Terraform code, Helm charts, and native Kubernetes manifests.
* GitOps & Automation: Practical experience configuring and debugging GitOps tools (ArgoCD, Flux) and CI platforms (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI).
* Observability: Strong working knowledge of Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry collectors, and centralized log aggregation tools.
* Leadership: Proven track record of managing technical teams and delivering enterprise cloud infrastructure services.

Physical Demands
  
  

* Duties of this position are performed in a normal office environment.
* Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data. Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required.

Typical Experience
  
  

* 7 to 10 years of relevant IT experience that shows consistent progression, and at least 5 years hands-on technology and team leadership experience.

Typical Education
  
  

* Bachelor's Degree or consideration of an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Educational requirements may vary by geography.
* Preferred Qualifications & Certifications

+ Certifications:

- Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
- Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration
- Associate or Professional Cloud certifications (AWS Solutions Architect/SysOps, Azure Administrator, GCP Cloud Engineer)

Notes
  
  
This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities of the position. Employees are held accountable for all duties of the job. Job duties and the % of time identified for any function are subject to change at any time.
  
  
Celestica is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on any protected status (including race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran or disability status or other characteristics protected by law).
  
  
At Celestica we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected and supported. Special arrangements can be made for candidates who need it throughout the hiring process. Please indicate your needs and we will work with you to meet them.
  
  
**Company Overview**
Celestica, Inc. (NYSE: CLS; TSX: CLS) is a technology leader dedicated to driving customer success and market advancements. With deep expertise in design, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and platform solutions, Celestica enables critical data center infrastructure for AI, cloud, and hybrid cloud and advances technologies in high-growth markets. Today, Celestica delivers innovative supply chain solutions globally to customers in strategic two operating and reporting segments: Advanced Technology Solutions (ATS) and Connectivity and Cloud Solutions (CC):
  
  
**ATS:**
This segment serves customers in complex, regulated and high-reliability markets such as Industrial & Smart Energy, Aerospace & Defense, Semiconductor Capital Equipment, and HealthTech. It is engineering led, with deep expertise in design, manufacturing and lifecycle solutions.

title: Senior C++ Engineer
description:
**Job Summary**

Seeking an experienced Senior C++ Engineer to join the team building our next-generation embedded writer platform. The selected candidate will be responsible for porting core application logic from a legacy real-time embedded platform to a modern embedded Linux system, and for building the regression-testing infrastructure that proves the ported software behaves identically to the original. This role requires strong expertise in modern C++ development, cross-platform porting, protocol and file-format design, and test-harness engineering, applied to software that produces a legally significant data record and therefore cannot tolerate correctness regressions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Port core application and domain logic from a legacy RTOS-based C/C++ codebase to a Linux-based embedded platform, preserving exact functional behavior.
* Design and build an automated regression harness that replays historical input data through both the legacy and ported implementations and verifies bit-exact output equivalence; integrate this harness into continuous integration so every change is verified automatically.
* Reconcile divergent copies of shared logic that evolved independently on different platforms into a single, verified, canonical implementation.
* Design and implement serialization and communication protocol logic (framing, checksums, versioning) ensuring wire-level compatibility with existing external client software.
* Rework legacy file- and storage-management logic that is tightly coupled to a proprietary real-time operating system into a clean implementation on a standard Linux filesystem, while preserving on-disk data formats and data-safety guarantees (no data loss on crash or power loss).
* Port cryptography and data-integrity logic, and extend it to support a tamper-evident, cryptographically signed data journal.
* Port audio codec/compression logic into a new platform-appropriate audio pipeline. • Design clean internal interfaces (abstraction seams) that isolate ported business logic from platform-specific concerns, without building a full compatibility-emulation layer.
* Collaborate with platform, firmware, QA, and program leadership to align on process boundaries, data-safety guarantees, and real-time performance budgets.
* Participate in design and code review, with particular attention to correctness on the legally-sensitive data-capture path.
* Utilize modern AI-assisted development tools to accelerate large-scale code translation and test generation, while applying independent engineering judgment to verify correctness rather than trusting generated output at face value.
* Support the product from early architecture through production release

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 8+ years of professional C++ software development experience, including production/shipping systems. • Strong experience with modern C++ (C++14/17/20).
* Demonstrated experience porting or migrating a large existing codebase across platforms or operating systems (e.g., RTOS to Linux, or similar cross-platform migration).
* Experience designing or implementing serialization formats or communication protocols (framing, checksums, versioning, backward compatibility).
* Solid understanding of concurrent/multithreaded programming.
* Hands-on experience with Linux operating systems in an embedded or application context.
* Strong Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and software design skills.
* A test-first, verification-driven approach to correctness, with experience building or operating automated regression or golden-master style test harnesses.
* Excellent troubleshooting and debugging skills.
* Demonstrated, hands-on effectiveness with AI-assisted software engineering tools (agentic coding assistants, AI-based code review), with clear judgment about when to trust generated output and when it requires independent verification.
* Experience using Git for version control and standard issue-tracking tools for project/task management.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with embedded cryptography, data integrity, or licensing/security subsystems. • Experience with audio codec integration or digital signal processing basics.
* Experience with hash-chained, append-only, or tamper-evident log/journal data structures.
* Familiarity with embedded Linux storage semantics (journaling filesystems, write-through/O\_SYNC data-safety patterns, flash/eMMC wear considerations).
* Prior experience in a regulated, safety-critical, or legal/records-integrity software domain.
* Experience mentoring engineers and contributing to software architecture decisions.
* Experience working in Agile development environments.

**Required Skills**

* AI-Assisted Software Development
* C++ (14/17/20) • Embedded Linux
* Cross-Platform Porting / Migration
* Multithreading
* Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
* Serialization & Protocol Design
* Automated/Regression Test Harness Design
* Cryptography & Data Integrity
* Git
* Debugging & Troubleshooting
* Software Design & Architecture

title: Product Specialist
description:
Fieldproxy is the AI-first field service platform for mid-market and enterprise operators. We replace legacy FSM tools like ServiceTitan, Simpro, ServiceM8 and IQ, plus spreadsheets, with software built around how each customer actually runs. That software is live in days, not months.

We’re hiring Solutions Architects to own that build, from the first discovery call to a team using it in the field.

What the role is

You’ll take a customer’s operation (dispatch, jobs, quotes, invoices, subcontractors, compliance, field apps) and turn it into a working Fieldproxy workspace. Often you’ll have it running before the sales call, so the prospect sees their own business in the demo.

You’ll build with AI in the loop. Most of the configuration is written with Claude Code and our internal skills. Your job is to know what good looks like, steer the build, check it against live data and ship it safely. You’re the person who knows whether the saved value comes back when the record is reopened, whether a status shows up on any list, and whether a write is properly gated.

What you’ll do

* **Run discovery.**
  Learn a customer’s workflow, the tools they use now and what they actually need. Write it up as a clear requirements doc and build plan.
* **Build tenants end to end:**
* PostgreSQL schemas and seed data
* web portals and mobile field apps (JSON-configured views, code widgets)
* customer-facing public forms: quote approvals, job trackers, sign-offs, payment links
* **Automate the operation**
  with Fieldproxy’s automation engine: SLA escalations, recurring work, inbound-email-to-job, PDF generation, reminders, webhooks.
* **Deploy AI**
  on customer workspaces:
* Command Center (ask and act on your data in plain English)
* SMS, email and voice agents
* AI extraction, summaries and scheduling
* MCP connections to Claude, ChatGPT and Grok
* **Integrate**
  with the systems customers already run: CRMs, accounting, helpdesks (Freshservice, Zoho), Shopify, Twilio, telematics, plus REST APIs and webhooks.
* **Migrate data**
  off legacy systems cleanly: imports, date and format traps, deduplication, reconciliation.
* **Validate before anything goes live.**
  Run our preflight and regression checks, test as real user roles, keep rollback versions, and never test against live customer data or send real emails or SMS from a build.
* **Present the solution**
  to owners, ops managers and finance leads. Explain what the system does in plain language, record walkthrough videos, and keep the customer hub up to date.
* **Support live customers.**
  Debug reported issues down to the root cause, fix them with a versioned change, and write up what happened.
* **Document what you build**
  so the next build is faster: reusable kits, patterns and known traps.

What we’re looking for

* **Strong SQL and PostgreSQL.**

title: Director - Business Intelligence
description:
The Data Experience (DEx) practice builds the data foundations, pipelines, and products that power Dentsu's media and marketing effectiveness work across Carat, iProspect, and Dentsu X. We are seeking a Director, Data Engineering to lead our offshore (DGS) engineering capability — owning the architecture, quality, and delivery of the data platform that everything downstream depends on.
  
  
This is a senior leadership and hands-on engineering role. You will set the standard for how DEx ingests, models, and serves media and marketing data on Databricks, and you will do it as a modern practitioner — using AI-assisted data development (Databricks Genie, Copilot, Claude Code) to move faster and raise quality. You will lead and mentor a team of DGS engineers while staying close enough to the code to set the bar yourself. This role demands deep Databricks expertise and a genuine understanding of what media data means, not just how to move it.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Core Skills & Requirements**
Databricks & Data Engineering
  
  

* Deep, hands-on Databricks expertise: Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow / Delta Live Tables, Medallion architecture, and performance tuning.
* Expert-level SQL and strong Python for data engineering; production experience building and operating pipelines at scale.
* Solid grasp of data modeling, orchestration, data quality, and governance — building for reuse and maintainability, not one-off delivery.
* Experience with the surrounding ecosystem (Azure, lightweight ETL / data-prep tooling such as Trifacta or dbt) is a strong plus.

AI-Assisted Data Development
  
  

* Hands-on experience developing data solutions with AI tooling — Databricks Genie, GitHub / Databricks Copilot, Claude Code, or comparable AI coding agents.
* Able to use AI assistants to accelerate pipeline build, transformation logic, and debugging while maintaining correctness, governance, and quality.
* A builder's mindset: comfortable pairing with AI tools as a force multiplier for the team, not a novelty.

Media & Marketing Data Fluency
  
  
*You must understand not just how to engineer the data, but what the data means.*

* Strong command of media and marketing data: what impressions, spend, clicks, and conversions represent, and how they relate.
* Understanding of how reach and frequency work — served vs. viewable impressions, de-duplicated reach, and frequency capping — and the implications for how data must be modeled.
* Familiarity with conversion tracking and attribution mechanics — pixels, tags, post-click vs. post-view, and lookback windows.
* Knowledge of how media data connects across campaigns, placements, creatives, and channels, and how spend flows through to outcomes.
* Practical experience with media taxonomies and naming conventions as the foundation of trustworthy, joinable data.

Leadership
  
  

* Proven experience leading and developing an engineering team, ideally in an offshore / DGS or global delivery model.
* Ability to set architecture and code standards, review work critically, and raise the quality bar across a team.
* Strong communication across time zones with onshore leads and stakeholders.

**Preferred / Nice To Have**

* Experience with streaming / near-real-time ingestion patterns.
* Familiarity with trafficking / ad ops platforms (CM360, Prisma, DV360, TTD) and how their data lands in the platform.
* Exposure to semantic / metrics layers and how engineering choices affect downstream reporting (Power BI, dbt metrics).
* Experience in an agency, ad tech, or marketing analytics environment.
* CI/CD, testing, and DataOps practices for data pipelines.

**Qualifications**

* 12+ years in data engineering, with several years in a leadership or director-level capacity.
* Demonstrated deep Databricks / Lakehouse expertise in production.
* Demonstrated domain knowledge of media and/or marketing data (hard requirement).
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Paragon

Permanent#DGS

As an organisation, we foster creativity, continuous learning and inclusivity, creating an environment where bold ideas thrive and make a measurable difference in people's lives.
  
  
**Your Mission**
We are hiring Forward Deployed Engineers who treat AI as the substrate of how software gets built not a tool to be cautious of, not something they are "exploring," but the medium they work in.
  
  
You will sit close to clients and product leaders, reframe vague problems into something concrete, and ship working software end-to-end.
  
  
You won't wait for a refined backlog, a PM in the middle, or a separate platform team.
  
  
You will shape the idea, build the thing, and stand it up in production yourself.
  
  
This is a builder-first individual-contributor role for engineers who live at the current edge of AI development and work fluently with Claude Code, Cursor, agents, eval harnesses, MCP, and modern TypeScript and Python.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Problem / Opportunity Discovery :

* Partner closely with product, design, and client stakeholders to translate ambiguous ideas into software that ships.

* Reframe problems out loud.
* Don't get stuck waiting for someone else to make the decision.
* Lead POCs, innovation sprints, and internal research experiments to validate emerging AI techniques.
* Build (fast) with AI :
* When the brief is clear, head down and produce.
* Build modular backends in Python or TypeScript aligned with clean architecture, OOP, SOLID, and domain-driven design.
* Create fullstack applications, APIs, agents, workflows, and similar systems using frameworks such as Next.js, React, FastAPI, Fastify, FastMCP, and Hono.

* Build with a clear-eyed view of where current AI tooling helps and where it falls short.
* Apply engineering practices that hold up in production : TDD, secrets management and rotation, SAST/DAST, structured logging, metrics, tracing, and automated CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins).
* Own what you build end-to-end, including the infrastructure and operations that keep it running.
* Mentor others on system design, agentic patterns, and AI engineering best practices.

* 3+ years relevant experience building production applications using AI / agentic development approaches fullstack applications, agents, workflows, MCPs, and more.
* Hands-on experience with agents, not just prompted models.
* You have wired tools to a model and let it run multi-step using LangGraph, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants, or your own orchestration.
* Active, structured use of AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) with demonstrable workflows, sub-agents, skills, and innovative approaches.

The Data Science Manager will develop and implement advanced AI and process-modelling solutions in complex pharmaceutical manufacturing environments. This individual contributor role will focus on large language models, agentic systems, real-time soft sensors and advanced process control to generate actionable insights and support continuous improvement across manufacturing and quality operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Contribute technical expertise to high-impact analytics, modelling and optimisation projects.
* Identify high-value applications for advanced analytics, advanced process control, AI, machine learning, large language models, agentic AI and the Industrial Internet of Things.
* Design and deploy fit-for-purpose solutions for pharmaceutical manufacturing environments.
* Develop mathematical models, machine-learning systems and LLM-enabled agentic workflows, and support their implementation in GMP environments.
* Apply engineering principles, modelling tools and experimental methods to data-rich laboratory, pilot and manufacturing systems.
* Improve process understanding and enable real-time process monitoring and control.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams and key stakeholders, communicate progress clearly and drive projects to timely completion.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Expert-level Python proficiency is a must
* Experience preparing and analysing large, real-world datasets, including structured time-series data containing thousands of variables is required
* Demonstrated experience applying AI methods—including LLMs, knowledge graphs and agentic architectures—to generate insights and support decision-making.
* Proven ability to develop autonomous agents or AI copilots for manufacturing or scientific workflows.
* Strong collaboration skills and experience working in diverse, cross-functional teams.
* Knowledge of pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical manufacturing processes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into actionable insights for technical and non-technical audiences.
* Adherence to best practice software engineering principles eg PEP8

**Preferred Qualifications**

* A PhD with at least 2-3 years experience or Masters with 5-6 years experience in engineering, mathematics, computer science, or related discipline.
* Expertise in first-principles modelling, including thermodynamics, reaction modelling and heat and mass transfer.
* Experience developing hybrid and practical process models for real-time applications.
* Experience with cloud-based development platforms such as AWS SageMaker.
* Familiarity with cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake or Redshift and relational databases using SQL.

title: Forward Deployed AI Strategist {Chennai}
description:
**About DevRev**
At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
*Computer*
– your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools,
*Computer*
unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a
**Forward Deployed AI Strategist**
, you will serve as the lead technical strategist embedded with our customers. You'll own the end-to-end design of AI-driven business transformation projects from understanding domain-specific needs to architecting scalable agent-based solutions using DevRev’s platform. This role requires a unique blend of enterprise architecture, AI solutioning, customer empathy, and cross-functional collaboration. You’ll act as the connective tissue between pre-sales, customer success, engineering, and product teams bringing our AI capabilities to life for real-world impact.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own Customer Context: Deeply understand customer business domains, systems, and OKRs/KPIs to guide solution design.
* Architect AI Transformation: Design and document AI-driven workflows, agents, skills, and system integrations that align with customer goals and industry best practices.
* Be a Trusted Advisor: Build strong partnerships with customer stakeholders as their technical counterpart, delivering confidence in our platform’s capabilities.
* Translate & Coordinate: Bridge the gap between pre-sales/CS and engineering, ensuring requirements are actionable and outcomes measurable.
* Design Reusability: Architect modular, scalable solutions that can be extended across customers and verticals.
* Drive Delivery: Collaborate with Applied AI engineers to oversee solution implementation, ensuring architectural alignment and execution excellence.
* Support Pre-Sales: Partner with sales engineers and customer teams to scope new opportunities, define technical requirements, and provide input on feasibility and effort.
* Lead Innovation: Stay ahead of emerging trends in AI, software integration, and business transformation—and bring that insight to our solution designs.
* Maintain Quality & Compliance: Ensure all solutions meet performance, security, and compliance standards.

**What You'll Bring**

* Experience: 7+ years in solution architecture or consulting roles, focused on enterprise-scale, customer-facing software implementations.
* AI & Cloud: Hands-on experience with generative AI tools, cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), and modern integration patterns (APIs, webhooks, pipelines).
* Business Acumen: Strong understanding of customer priorities, with the ability to translate business needs into technical execution plans.
* Design Thinking: A problem-solver with a growth mindset, skilled in crafting scalable and future-proof architectures.
* Communication: Exceptional ability to convey complex technical and business concepts to diverse stakeholders, both technical and non-technical.
* Project Leadership: Proficiency with project planning tools and methodologies; capable of managing multiple solution tracks and timelines.
* Metrics Focus: Proven ability to define and track success through OKRs, KPIs, and tangible business outcomes.
* SaaS & Platform Fluency: Background in SaaS or enterprise platforms, with understanding of extensibility and multi-tenant design principles.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline. Advanced degrees or certifications in AI/architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF, SAFe) are a plus.

**Travel Ready:**
**Willingness to travel up to 80% for on-site implementations, technical workshops, and customer engagements.**
As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will undergo a Background Verification (BGV). By applying, you consent to sharing personal information required for this process. Any offer made will be subject to successful completion of the BGV.
  
  
**How do we work?**
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.
  
  
**Be a bridger**
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.
  
  
**Care loudly**
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.
  
  
**Own the outcome**
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.
  
  
That’s DevRev!
  
  
*DevRev is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.*

description:
**About WPP Production**
We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. For more information, visit WPP.com.
  
  
What Does a Creative Technologist Do at WPP Production?
  
  
A Creative Technologist at WPP Production operates at the intersection of creativity, technology, and generative AI to design and deliver AI-powered creative solutions at scale. * Collaborate with creative, strategy, production, and technology teams to design AI-powered creative solutions for marketing campaigns.
* Translate creative concepts into structured prompt frameworks and multimodal content generation strategies.
* Develop and optimize workflows using generative AI tools for image, video, text, and audio content creation.
* Partner with technical teams to build, test, and improve AI-driven production pipelines and automation workflows.
* Prototype and evaluate emerging AI tools, models, and technologies to enhance creative production capabilities.
* Ensure AI-generated content aligns with brand guidelines, creative quality standards, and campaign objectives.
* Support the development of reusable prompt libraries, templates, workflows, and best practices for scalable content production.
* Work closely with cross-functional teams to integrate AI capabilities into existing creative and production processes.
* Present AI-powered creative solutions, demonstrations, and recommendations to internal stakeholders and clients.
* Identify opportunities to improve production efficiency through automation, workflow optimization, and AI innovation.
* Stay up to date with advancements in Generative AI, multimodal models, creative technologies, and industry trends.

**Requirements**

* 3+ years of experience in Creative Technology, Digital Production, Creative Development, Design Technology, Innovation, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of Generative AI technologies, prompt engineering, and multimodal content generation (image, video, text, and audio).
* Experience working with AI creative tools such as Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Runway, Flux, Stable Diffusion, OpenAI, Google Veo, Kling, or similar platforms.

* Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills with the ability to work across multidisciplinary teams.
* Ability to balance creative thinking with technical execution in a fast-paced production environment.

Good to Have
  
  

* Experience working in an advertising, creative, production, or digital agency environment.
* Knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, and multimodal AI systems.
* Familiarity with Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma, motion design, or video production workflows.
* Experience developing AI playbooks, prompt libraries, or scalable creative automation frameworks.
* Certifications in Generative AI, Machine Learning, Cloud AI Platforms, or related technologies are an added advantage.

At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. title: Pyspark Engineer
description:
We are seeking an experienced and results-driven
**PySpark / Big Data Engineer**
to design, develop, and maintain large-scale batch and real-time data pipelines. In this role, you will be responsible for transforming complex raw data into actionable analytical data models, optimizing distributed computing workloads, and ensuring data integrity, scalability, and security across enterprise data platforms.
  
  
The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in Apache Spark architecture, advanced Python programming, distributed systems optimization, modern cloud platforms, and data warehousing/lakehouse paradigms.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Data Pipeline Design & Development**

* Architect, build, and maintain robust, scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using PySpark and Python to ingest data from diverse batch and streaming sources (Kafka, relational databases, REST APIs, Object Storage).
* Design and implement Lakehouse architectures using formats such as Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, or Apache Hudi.
* Build reusable frameworks and data ingestion libraries to standardize enterprise data processing.

**Spark Performance Tuning & Optimization**

* Diagnose and tune Spark application performance, managing memory allocation, partitions, execution plans, broadcast joins, data skews, and garbage collection.
* Optimize query execution plans using Catalyst Optimizer and Tungsten execution engine.
* Monitor and troubleshoot production Spark jobs across cluster management environments (YARN, Kubernetes, or Databricks).

**Data Modeling & Architecture**

* Collaborate with Data Architects to design dimensional (Star/Snowflake), normalized, and Data Vault schemas optimized for analytical workloads.
* Ensure efficient data storage, partitioning strategies, and file format selection (Parquet, ORC, Avro).

**Orchestration, CI/CD & DevOps**

* Schedule and orchestrate complex workflow DAGs using workflow orchestrators such as Apache Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines (Git, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions) for automated testing, packaging, and deployment of data pipelines.
* Write unit tests, integration tests, and data validation routines (e.g., Great Expectations, PyTest).

**Governance, Security & Quality**

* Implement enterprise data governance, lineage tracking, metadata management, and data quality frameworks.
* Ensure strict compliance with data security, masking, tokenization, RBAC, and regulatory privacy standards (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).

**Required Technical Qualifications & Skills**

* Core Technologies - Apache Spark, PySpark (Spark SQL, DataFrames, Datasets, Structured Streaming), Python 3.x
* Database & Querying - Advanced SQL, Query optimization, Indexing, Window functions
* Data Lake & Lakehouse - Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, Apache Hudi, Parquet, Avro, ORC
* Workflow & Orchestration - Apache Airflow, Luigi, Prefect, or Databricks Workflows
* Cloud Platforms - AWS (EMR, Glue, S3, Redshift), Azure (Synapse, ADLS, HDInsight), or GCP (Dataproc, BigQuery, GCS)
* Streaming Technologies - Apache Kafka, Spark Structured Streaming, Event Hubs, or Kinesis

**Key Competencies & Experience**

* Distributed Computing Fundamentals: In-depth knowledge of Spark internals (RDD, Catalyst Optimizer, DAG execution, Shuffling, Narrow vs. Wide dependencies).
* Production Experience: Minimum 4+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying production-grade PySpark applications at enterprise scale.
* Problem Solving: Proven track record in debugging memory bottlenecks, Out-Of-Memory (OOM) errors, and resolving data skew issues.
* Data Engineering Best Practices: Experience implementing modular code architectures, logging, monitoring (Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch), and alerting.
* Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-Have)
* Hands-on experience with Databricks platform (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Photon engine, MLflow).
* Familiarity with Scala/Java in addition to Python.
* Knowledge of DataOps and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
* Experience with modern analytical data warehouses (Snowflake, Google BigQuery, Amazon Redshift).
* Relevant certifications: Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate / Professional AWS Certified Data Engineer / Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203)CCA Spark and Hadoop Developer (or equivalent)
* Educational Requirements
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).

* Perform source-to-metric mapping for ALETL logs, RunContext, SSAS DMVs and Extended Event outputs.

* Develop advanced T-SQL procedures, views and transformations for monitoring and observability data.

* Correlate processing events using available identifiers and RunContext information without relying only on timestamps.
* Implement duplicate detection, malformed/incomplete event quarantine, auditability and safe rerun/reprocessing patterns.
* Build derived metrics, snapshots, baselines, trends and threshold-supporting data structures.
* Create approved SQL serving views for Power BI and support source-to-report reconciliation.
* Optimise SQL queries, indexes and data structures for expected monitoring volumes and collection frequencies.
* Package database changes using SSDT/DACPAC/Git-aligned deployment practices.

**Mandatory Skills**

* Advanced T-SQL and strong SQL Server development skills.
* Logical and physical data modelling.
* Dimensional modelling: facts, dimensions, grain and conformed dimensions.
* Historisation patterns including snapshots and SCD1/SCD2 where appropriate.
* Stored procedures, views, functions, indexing and query optimisation.
* Log parsing, event correlation and data transformation.
* Error handling, auditability, duplicate prevention and safe rerun design.
* SSDT/DACPAC and Git/source-control based database delivery.
* Ability to build Power BI-ready serving views.

**Desirable Skills**

* SSAS Multidimensional data/metadata familiarity.
* Experience with monitoring, telemetry or operational data.

**Recommended Experience**

* Logical and physical monitoring data model.

10–13 years

* Lead the design and implementation of enterprise AI platforms that support AI/ML, GenAI, Agentic AI and RAG workloads across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.

* Establish platform observability with centralized logging, monitoring, tracing, telemetry, performance diagnostics and cost optimization for AI systems.
* Enable secure AI platform controls with policy enforcement, access governance, auditability and support for Responsible AI, compliance and risk requirements.
* Drive standardization of AI platform architecture through reusable patterns, landing zones, environment templates and enterprise engineering best practices.

**Client & Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as primary technical advisor to CxOs, account leadership teams and enterprise engineering stakeholders on AI platform strategy, cloud modernization and deployment architecture.
* Conduct technical workshops demonstrating platform blueprints, deployment models, MLOps capabilities, observability approaches and AI operational readiness.
* Bridge platform engineering with business strategy by translating complex infrastructure capabilities into scalable business outcomes and delivery roadmaps.
* Build trusted relationships through hands-on PoC delivery, architecture discussions and strategic guidance on AI platform adoption.

**Cloud, Automation & Deployment Engineering Leadership**

* Lead automation of AI infrastructure provisioning using Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates and CloudFormation.
* Design and implement CI/CD and CT pipelines for AI platforms, model deployment services, APIs, microservices and environment lifecycle management.
* Drive containerization and orchestration patterns using Docker and Kubernetes including workload isolation, autoscaling, high availability and release automation.
* Build deployment frameworks for AI and GenAI applications using REST services, FastAPI, model serving frameworks, serverless patterns and integration middleware.
* Automate configuration management, secrets handling, policy validation, artifact promotion and environment provisioning across dev, test and production landscapes.
* Implement release engineering practices including blue-green deployment, canary rollout, rollback mechanisms and platform upgrade planning.
* Ensure platform reliability, scalability and supportability through automated testing, operational runbooks, resilience engineering and incident readiness.

**MLOps, Data Pipelines & Operationalization Leadership**

* Lead the setup and scaling of MLOps and LLMOps capabilities including experiment tracking, model versioning, model registry, artifact management, pipeline orchestration and deployment governance.
* Establish standardized operationalization pipelines for model training, validation, packaging, deployment, monitoring and retraining across enterprise AI use cases.
* Drive integration of AI platforms with batch and real-time data pipelines using Airflow, Prefect, Spark, Kafka, Databricks and cloud-native data services.
* Design and govern reliable data flows for AI workloads including ingestion, transformation, feature engineering, feature store integration, vector store enablement and metadata lineage.
* Implement monitoring for models and services covering drift detection, latency, throughput, failure diagnostics and service-level performance.
* Collaborate closely with data science, AI engineering and application teams to productionize prototypes, notebooks and GenAI use cases into enterprise-grade deployments.
* Drive operational best practices around reproducibility, traceability, auditability and support for regulated or risk-sensitive environments.

**Asset and Accelerator Development**

* Lead creation of EY IP including AI platform reference architectures, reusable IaC modules, deployment blueprints, MLOps templates and observability accelerators.
* Develop reusable frameworks for secure AI environment setup, platform monitoring dashboards, model deployment factories and RAG infrastructure enablement.
* Package technical accelerators as EY market offerings for rapid client deployment across industries and cloud ecosystems.

**Business Development & GTM Initiatives**

* Lead technical solutioning for AI platform transformation RFPs including architecture blueprints, deployment approaches, cloud landing patterns and live PoC demonstrations.
* Develop industry-specific GTM strategies that combine EY assets with hyperscaler AI platform services and enterprise automation capabilities.
* Collaborate with sales teams to position EY as a trusted partner for AI platform engineering, cloud AI operationalization and secure enterprise AI deployment.

**Program Governance & Delivery Excellence**

* Oversee end-to-end AI platform transformation programs from infrastructure discovery through production deployment, operational handover and value realization.
* Manage cross-functional delivery teams including cloud engineers, platform engineers, ML engineers, DevOps specialists and data engineers across multiple workstreams.
* Ensure technical excellence, risk mitigation and KPI achievement in complex enterprise AI platform and deployment programs.

**Practice Development & Team Leadership**

* Mentor consultants and seniors in AI platform engineering, cloud architecture, automation practices and MLOps operationalization across the broader EY GDS AI practice.
* Lead technical recruitment and capability building for cloud AI platform engineering excellence.
* Drive innovation PoCs showcasing enterprise AI platforms, scalable GenAI deployment models, advanced observability and sovereign AI infrastructure capabilities.

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**
**Education:**
B.Tech/B.E. (Computer Science / IT / AI / ML mandatory); M.Tech / MS in Cloud Computing, AI, Data Engineering or Machine Learning (preferred).
  
  
**Core Technical Expertise (Hands-on Implementation Required):**

* AI Platform & Infrastructure Engineering: Strong hands-on experience in designing and managing enterprise AI platforms, model hosting environments, inference systems, vector database infrastructure, API-based AI services and secure runtime environments.
* Cloud Platforms: Deep expertise in AWS, Azure and GCP with focus on AI and infrastructure services such as SageMaker, Bedrock, Azure ML, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, AKS, EKS, GKE, IAM, networking, storage and monitoring.
* Automation & Deployment Engineering: Strong knowledge of Terraform, Bicep, ARM, CloudFormation, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, Kubernetes, deployment automation, microservices architecture and release engineering.
* MLOps / LLMOps: Experience with MLflow, Kubeflow, Azure ML pipelines, Vertex AI pipelines, model registry, experiment tracking, model serving, deployment governance and monitoring.
* Data Engineering & Operationalization: Understanding of ETL and ELT pipelines, Airflow, Prefect, Spark, Kafka, Databricks, feature stores, streaming and batch processing and production data pipelines for AI workloads.
* Programming & APIs: Proficiency in Python, shell scripting, YAML, JSON, REST APIs, FastAPI and automation scripting for platform and cloud operations.
* Security & Governance: Familiarity with platform security, secrets management, policy controls, auditability, observability and support for Responsible AI and enterprise governance requirements.

**Consulting & Leadership Experience:**

* 10–13 years in cloud platform engineering, AI platform engineering, DevOps, MLOps or AI consulting (Big 4 / tech preferred).
* Proven track record leading enterprise AI platform implementations across BFSI, manufacturing, healthcare or public sector.
* Experience with sovereign AI, regulated industry deployments and multi-cloud architecture programs.

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 1000+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.

description: Job Title: DAnR Python Dashboard DeveloperExperience: 2 to 5 years of relevant development experienceAbout the Job:We are looking for a Python Dashboard Developer within DAnR to own custom web-based monitoring dashboards for Tonik's lending scorecards. You will build flexible analytical applications with an open-source Python stack and deploy them on Tonik's internal web server in partnership with IT.The priority is to give Risk, DS and business teams timely visibility into scorecard performance, data coverage and operational issues. Dash and Plotly with enterprise authentication are a preferred approach. You will use reusable components and, where appropriate, AI-assisted development to accelerate delivery while maintaining reviewed code and verified calculations.Job Responsibilities:Build and maintain interactive Python web dashboards using Dash and Plotly, or an agreed comparable open-source framework. Deliver clear navigation, filters, drilldowns and export capabilities for internal users.Develop a reusable monitoring framework so new or refreshed scorecards can be onboarded quickly. Target operational dashboards within one week of model go-live, with outcome-based measures becoming available as repayment cohorts mature.Implement monitoring views for underwriting, behavioural and offer scores, collections, payroll-backed lending and other assigned models. Support component and stacked-score views, product segments and model-version comparisons.Work with DS and Risk to define and implement Gini, KS, PSI, CSI, calibration, deciles, approval rates and bad rates. Capture agreed cohort, numerator, denominator and outcome-maturity rules rather than hard-coding ambiguous definitions.Separate input and score monitoring available at launch from performance metrics that require matured outcomes. Clearly label reporting windows, sample sizes, data freshness and insufficient-data conditions.Connect to BigQuery and approved data sources using efficient SQL and reusable data-access layers. Use pre-aggregation, caching and controlled refreshes to keep dashboards responsive and query costs manageable.Build visibility into partner coverage, missingness, API failures and score-range changes. Implement agreed threshold alerts and exception views with enough detail for teams to investigate.Deploy and maintain dashboards on the internal web server with IT, including service configuration, dependencies, logging and health checks. Integrate enterprise authentication and appropriate access controls for sensitive lending data.Reconcile dashboard results to independently checked SQL or DS calculations. Use tests, code review and user acceptance testing to prevent misleading metrics, filter behaviour or exports.Use approved AI coding tools where useful; review generated code and validate logic before release. Maintain version control, technical documentation and a prioritized backlog with users.Migrate and retire legacy BI (Power BI) dashboards as the Python stack matures, so refresh cycles are no longer constrained by the old setup.Required Experience and Qualifications:2 to 5 years of relevant Python dashboard, analytical application or web development experience, with examples of applications deployed for business users.A bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, data analytics or a related discipline, or equivalent practical development experience.Strong Python and SQL skills, including pandas and experience building interactive applications with Dash and Plotly or a comparable Python web framework.Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, responsive layouts, callback or application state management, APIs and debugging web applications.Experience connecting dashboards to databases, validating calculated metrics, managing performance and maintaining production applications.Practical knowledge of Git, testing, Linux-based deployment, authentication and authorization. Ability to work with IT on secure internal hosting.Ability to clarify business metric definitions, present data accurately and collaborate with analysts, Data Scientists and Risk users.Preferred Experience and Qualifications:Prior lending or credit risk scorecard monitoring experience, including Gini, KS, PSI, CSI, vintage analysis, deciles and matured bad-rate reporting.Experience with GCP and BigQuery, query optimization, caching, scheduled data refreshes and monitoring multiple model versions.Experience with enterprise SSO, role-based access, Docker, reverse proxies or deployment through CI/CD.Experience using AI-assisted development productively while retaining code review, tests, data protection and calculation validation.What Success Looks Like:A reusable dashboard framework makes monitoring available quickly after go-live and supports frequent scorecard refreshes.Metrics reconcile to agreed definitions, with clear maturity, freshness and sample-size information.Dashboards remain responsive, secure and useful for identifying degradation and directing investigation.Who are we looking for?We value teamwork, honesty, reliability, practical problem-solving and a sense of humour. You take ownership of your work, communicate early when something is wrong, and challenge assumptions respectfully. You are comfortable collaborating across locations and improving how the team works.Willingness to go the extra mile for success.Energetic and lively, and street smart.As our approach to banking is far from ordinary, we are looking for an innovative and creative individual to join our team.Above all, a great team player and proactive communicator. This is a table-stake criterion.About Tonik:We are a transformative digital bank with a mission to revolutionize the way money works. We create better financial products for the world by encouraging inclusivity through simplifying processes, reducing costs, improving transparency, and embracing flexibility to empower more people with unique financial needs. All these are on the most secure mobile banking platform. To enable this, innovation is woven into the DNA of our company. We do not just search for the best talent, but for people who seek to challenge the status quo and are passionate about transforming the impossible into reality.Tonik (www.tonikbank.com) is the first digital-only neo bank in the Philippines, providing loan, deposit, payment, and card products to consumers on a highly secure digital banking platform. The neo bank operates based on the first private digital bank license issued by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas. Tonik is led by a team of retail finance veterans who have previously built and scaled multiple retail banks and fintechs across the global emerging markets. It is backed by top international venture capital funds. Tonik operates out of hubs in Singapore (HQ), Manila, Chennai, and Kyiv.Our Data team works with Risk, Product, Technology and business teams to improve lending decisions and customer outcomes through reliable data, analytics and machine learning.

At Fuller, APC engineering is not just about control algorithms — it is about understanding the process, earning customer trust, and delivering performance that lasts.
  
  
**About The Role**
You will be part of Fullers Process Optimisation Team, working with the ECS/ProcessExpert® APC toolbox and advanced control techniques such as MPC and AI/ML. Your role focuses on delivering APC and soft-sensor solutions that stabilise plant operations, improve throughput, and reduce energy and fuel consumption.

'

**''**

title: AI Engineering Manager
description:
**Job Description:**

AI Engineering Manager / Lead – Purple Fabric

**Company:**
Intellect Design Arena Ltd.

**Business Unit:**
Purple Fabric (Enterprise AI Platform)

**Location:**
Chennai, India

**Experience:**
12–15 years (indicative; can be calibrated based on role seniority)

**Role Type:**
Full-time

**Mode of Work:**
Work From Office (WFO) – 5 days a week.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a highly experienced
**AI Engineering Manager / Lead**
to drive the architecture, development, and delivery of enterprise-grade Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions for Purple Fabric, Intellect Design Arena’s enterprise AI platform.

The ideal candidate will combine deep hands-on technical expertise in AI engineering with strong engineering leadership, capable of translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure, reliable, and production-ready AI solutions. The role will involve building AI-powered applications, agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems, and enterprise integrations while driving engineering excellence, innovation, and delivery outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. AI Engineering & Solution Development**

* Lead the design, development, and deployment of enterprise-grade AI applications leveraging Generative AI, LLMs, and Agentic AI architectures.
* Architect and implement multi-agent systems, intelligent workflows, tool calling, and autonomous task execution with appropriate human oversight.
* Build scalable RAG pipelines integrating enterprise data sources, knowledge repositories, vector databases, and semantic search capabilities.
* Develop reusable AI components, frameworks, APIs, and services to accelerate product engineering and solution delivery.
* Drive end-to-end AI application development, from proof of concept and experimentation to production deployment and continuous improvement.

**2. AI Architecture & Technical Leadership**

* Define and implement scalable AI application architectures aligned with enterprise requirements for performance, reliability, security, and maintainability.
* Evaluate and integrate LLMs, embedding models, orchestration frameworks, vector databases, and other AI technologies based on business and technical requirements.
* Design robust prompt engineering, context management, agent orchestration, memory, and model interaction strategies.
* Establish engineering standards and best practices for AI application development, testing, deployment, and monitoring.
* Drive architectural decisions related to model selection, latency, token consumption, inference costs, and scalability.

**3. Enterprise Integration & Platform Engineering**

* Integrate AI capabilities with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, knowledge systems, and existing technology ecosystems.
* Build secure, reusable microservices and APIs to support enterprise AI workflows.
* Collaborate with platform, cloud, DevOps, and security teams to establish reliable deployment and operational practices.
* Enable interoperability across AI models, tools, enterprise systems, and data sources.
* Contribute to reusable platform capabilities supporting Purple Fabric’s enterprise AI and decisioning use cases.

**4. AI Quality, Governance & Responsible AI**

* Establish evaluation frameworks to assess AI output quality, factual accuracy, groundedness, relevance, and reliability.
* Implement guardrails to address hallucinations, prompt injection, unsafe outputs, data leakage, and unauthorised tool execution.
* Drive observability and monitoring for AI applications, including tracing, latency, token usage, cost, and failure analysis.
* Ensure adherence to enterprise security, privacy, access control, auditability, and responsible AI practices.
* Implement continuous evaluation and regression testing to maintain AI solution quality as models, prompts, and data evolve.

**5. Engineering Management & Delivery**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of AI engineers, software engineers, and other technical specialists.
* Own technical delivery, engineering quality, resource planning, prioritisation, and execution against agreed timelines.
* Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, design discussions, and technical problem-solving sessions.
* Establish engineering KPIs covering delivery predictability, code quality, production stability, performance, and productivity.
* Work closely with Product Management, Solution Architects, Presales, and business stakeholders to translate product requirements into engineering deliverables.
* Foster a culture of technical ownership, experimentation, collaboration, and continuous learning.

**Mandatory Technical Skills**

* **AI / GenAI:**
  Strong hands-on experience in Generative AI, LLM-based application development, and production AI systems.
* **Agentic AI:**
  Experience designing agent-based applications, multi-agent orchestration, tool calling, and workflow automation.
* **RAG:**
  Strong understanding of document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, retrieval optimisation, reranking, and grounded response generation.
* **Programming:**
  Strong proficiency in Python and experience building production-grade applications, services, and APIs.
* **LLM Frameworks:**
  Practical experience with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent technologies.
* **Model Ecosystem:**
  Experience working with commercial or open-source LLMs, such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or Llama-based models.
* **Data & Integration:**
  Experience with REST APIs, databases, data pipelines, enterprise integrations, and distributed systems.
* **Cloud & Deployment:**
  Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP; containerisation and deployment using Docker and Kubernetes.
* **AI Evaluation & Security:**
  Experience with LLM evaluation, observability, prompt security, guardrails, and production monitoring.
* **Engineering Practices:**
  Strong knowledge of software architecture, CI/CD, automated testing, Git, code reviews, and production support.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building enterprise AI platforms, reusable AI frameworks, or AI products at scale.
* Exposure to financial services, banking, payments, lending, fraud detection, risk, or other regulated enterprise environments.
* Experience with model gateways, model routing, inference optimisation, caching, and cost management.
* Familiarity with enterprise knowledge management, identity and access management, data governance, and audit requirements.
* Experience with MLOps, LLMOps, model lifecycle management, and AI application observability.
* Exposure to on-premises or private-cloud AI deployments and enterprise security constraints.
* Experience taking AI products from 0-to-1 development through production rollout and scaling.

**Leadership & Competencies**

* Strong technical ownership and the ability to make sound architecture and engineering decisions.
* Proven ability to lead engineering teams and deliver complex technology initiatives.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to balance experimentation and innovation with production reliability and delivery commitments.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to explain complex AI concepts to engineering teams, product leaders, and business stakeholders.

**Success Measures**

* Successful delivery of scalable, production-ready enterprise AI capabilities.
* Improved reliability, quality, and performance of AI applications and agentic workflows.
* Reduced inference costs and latency through effective architecture and optimisation.
* Strong engineering quality, predictable delivery, and effective team development.
* Reusable AI components that accelerate product development and enterprise adoption.
* Compliance with enterprise security, governance, and responsible AI standards.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is a hands-on AI engineering leader who has
**built and scaled production-grade GenAI or Agentic AI solutions**
, rather than someone whose experience is limited to traditional machine learning, data science, AI research, or integrating basic LLM APIs.

The candidate should demonstrate the ability to architect end-to-end AI systems, lead engineering teams, solve enterprise-scale technical challenges, and translate AI capabilities into secure, reliable, business-ready products.

This is a data‑architecture‑led role. The primary deliverable is the target‑state data architecture – layering, canonical models, event and entity design, the semantic and KPI layer, and the data quality and lineage framework – that allows the Control Tower to detect exceptions, trigger alerts, and support root‑cause analysis with confidence in the underlying data.
  
  
The role works closely with Command Centre operations, BI delivery, Data Engineering, GDA, Data Platform, source system owners, and Enterprise Architecture, and operates within the standards set by the Tech Governance Lead.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Data Architecture & Design
  
  
Own the end‑to‑end data architecture for the Command Centre – how data flows from operational source systems across product domains (e.g. Contracts, Ocean) through to the Control Tower consumption layer.
  
  
Define the target‑state data architecture and transition roadmap, including the layering model (landing, raw, integrated/curated, consumption) and the storage, compute, and serving choices at each layer.
  
  
Design the canonical, cross‑domain data layer that gives the Control Tower one consistent representation of the core business objects, independent of the source systems they originate from.
  
  
Define master and reference data requirements, entity resolution, and cross‑system key mapping so that events from different systems resolve to the same business entity.
  
  
Establish data domain boundaries, data ownership, and data product definitions aligned to the Command Centre operating model.
  
  
Produce and maintain core architecture artefacts – conceptual, logical, and physical data models, data flow and lineage diagrams, integration maps, and architecture decision records.
  
  
Data Integration & Pipeline Architecture
  
  
Architect real‑time, near real‑time, and batch ingestion patterns – streaming, event‑driven, CDC, API, and scheduled – and define which pattern applies to which source and use case.
  
  
Define the operational event model and payload standards for the milestones, status changes, and exceptions that drive Control Tower views.
  
  
Design pipeline patterns for reliability at scale: idempotency, replay, late‑arriving and out‑of‑order events, backfill, and reconciliation back to source.
  
  
Set standards for orchestration, dependency management, error and dead‑letter handling, and pipeline observability.
  
  
Define and agree data contracts and SLAs with source system teams, covering schema, frequency, volume, and change management.
  
  
Define latency, freshness, and throughput targets per data domain and ensure the architecture demonstrably meets them.
  
  
Data Modelling & Semantic / KPI Layer
  
  
Design the dimensional, event, and state models required for end‑to‑end milestone tracking, cycle time, dwell, and exception analysis.
  
  
Architect the semantic and KPI layer so that each metric is defined once, certified, and reused consistently across Control Tower views and downstream reporting.
  
  
Model for drill‑down, so an alert on the Control Tower can be traced to transaction‑level detail and root cause without leaving the platform.
  
  
Define the historisation approach – slowly changing dimensions, snapshots, and point‑in‑time reporting – to support trend and retrospective analysis.
  
  
Design aggregation, pre‑computation, and caching strategies so Control Tower dashboards meet response‑time expectations at production data volumes.
  
  
Data Quality, Governance & Security
  
  
Define data quality dimensions, rules, and thresholds at each architectural layer, and design how failures are detected, quarantined, and escalated.
  
  
Ensure Control Tower alerting is built on trusted data – design the freshness, completeness, and validity checks that gate what is surfaced to operations.
  
  
Design end‑to‑end metadata and lineage capture, from source system field through to published KPI.
  
  
Design role‑based access, row and column level security, masking, retention, and audit into the data architecture rather than bolting it on later.
  
  
Ensure alignment with enterprise data architecture, cloud strategy, and BI governance standards, and work with the Tech Governance Lead on dataset certification.
  
  
Identify, document, and drive remediation of data architecture technical debt.
  
  
Delivery & Execution
  
  
Translate the architecture into sprint‑ready designs, data contracts, and backlog items for data engineering and BI delivery teams.
  
  
Provide hands‑on technical direction – prototypes, proofs of concept, performance tuning, and resolution of complex modelling and pipeline problems.
  
  
Review data models, pipelines, and semantic layers for adherence to the agreed architecture.
  
  
Own volumetrics and capacity planning, and support performance, resilience, and reconciliation testing ahead of each Control Tower release.
  
  
Drive reuse of data products, models, and patterns across Command Centre use cases to reduce duplication and rework.
  
  
Stakeholder & Cross-functional Collaboration
  
  
Partner with Command Centre operations and business owners to translate operational visibility and exception‑management needs into concrete data requirements.
  
  
Collaborate closely with Data Engineering and Platform teams, GDA, source system owners, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and Infrastructure and Cloud teams.
  
  
Present data architecture proposals to design authorities and governance forums for review and approval.
  
  
Communicate data design trade‑offs, risks, and dependencies clearly to non‑technical stakeholders.
  
  
Mentor data engineers and modellers on architecture patterns, modelling standards, and design quality.
  
  
**Required Qualifications / Skills**
Education & Experience
  
  
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related field.
  
  
Extensive experience as a data architect designing large‑scale, multi‑source data platforms, with hands‑on delivery experience rather than documentation only.
  
  
Proven experience designing the data architecture behind a control tower, command centre, or comparable real‑time operational visibility solution.
  
  
Track record of integrating operational and transactional source systems across multiple business domains.
  
  
Certifications in cloud data platforms, data architecture, or frameworks such as DAMA‑DMBOK or TOGAF are a plus.
  
  
Technical Competencies
  
  

* Deep data modelling expertise – conceptual, logical, and physical modelling; dimensional (Kimball), Data Vault, and event/state modelling.
* Strong experience with cloud data platforms, lakehouse and warehouse architectures, and layered (medallion‑style) design.
* Hands‑on experience with streaming and event‑driven architectures, CDC, message/event platforms, and API‑based integration.
* Advanced SQL and data performance engineering – partitioning, clustering, incremental processing, query tuning, and cost optimisation.
* Experience with orchestration and transformation frameworks and with data quality and observability tooling.
* Working knowledge of master data management, reference data, and entity resolution techniques.
* Experience with metadata, lineage, and data catalogue tooling, and with certified dataset practices.
* Strong understanding of data security, privacy, compliance, and governance, and the ability to design to them.
* Sufficient BI and visualisation knowledge to design a semantic layer that Control Tower dashboards can consume efficiently.

Leadership & Behavioural Competencies
  
  
Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, particularly with source system owners.
  
  
Ability to communicate complex data concepts clearly and effectively.
  
  
High attention to detail combined with strategic, big‑picture thinking.
  
  
Sound judgement under operational pressure and in incident‑driven environments.
  
  
Proven ability to work across teams and drive alignment without direct authority.

The developer will support integrations across procurement, supplier collaboration, HR, finance, tax, manufacturing, labeling, banking, analytics, planning, and third-party enterprise applications. The position requires strong hands-on technical skills, rigorous documentation discipline, structured testing support, cutover readiness, hypercare support, and knowledge transfer to support/COE teams.
  
  
Day-to-Day Job Duties
  
  

* Design, build, test, deploy, monitor, and support integration flows using SAP Integration Suite / Cloud Integration for SAP-to-SAP and SAP-to-non-SAP integration scenarios.
* Design, build, schedule, monitor, and support CPI-DS jobs for SAP IBP integration, including master data and transactional data movement between SAP S/4HANA and SAP IBP.

* Develop integrations involving SAP S/4HANA, SAP Ariba, SAP Business Network, SuccessFactors, Concur, BlackLine, OneSource, OpenText VIM/OCR, SAP Sales Cloud, SimpleMDG, SAP IBP, SAP PLM, SAP ECTR, SAP Integrated Product Development, MES platforms, Loftware, Enlabel, SAP Document Compliance/DRC, SAP Multibank Connectivity/MBC, SAP BCM, SAC, Datasphere, Power BI, Snowflake, Workday, Dayforce/Ceridian, Oracle EBS, Oracle Demand Management, Oracle intercompany, Legal Tracker, Kiosk, CTSI, Reliance, tax/e-invoicing platforms, supplier/customer EDI partner systems, and other enterprise applications.

* Support synchronous, asynchronous, file-based, API-based, message-based, EDI, B2B, cXML, and event-driven integration patterns.
* Develop integrations using adapters and protocols including IDoc, OData, REST, SOAP, cXML, ANSI X12, EDIFACT, SFTP, APIs, XML, JSON, OAuth, certificates, PGP/encryption, and related message formats.
* Support SAP Ariba Managed Gateway / Cloud Integration Gateway scenarios for purchase orders, purchase order changes, goods receipts, service entry sheets, invoices, invoice status, payment remittance, supplier collaboration, and Business Network processes.
* Support EDI scenarios for supplier and customer-facing transactions, including direct supplier/customer EDI where standard network connectivity is not sufficient.
* Support banking and treasury integrations including payment files, bank statements, inbound/outbound messages, SWIFT/EBICS connectivity, bank onboarding, format validation, certificate/security setup, exception handling, and bank connectivity testing.
* Monitor CPI and CPI-DS jobs, troubleshoot failures, analyze logs, coordinate data corrections, manage retries and reloads, and resolve integration defects during SIT, UAT, mock cutover, production cutover, and hypercare.
* Support formal integration testing including SIT1, SIT2, UAT, regression testing, performance testing, security testing, cutover rehearsals, production deployment, hypercare stabilization, and handover to support/COE teams.

SAP BTP Integration Suite Capabilities
  
  

* SAP Integration Suite / Cloud Integration for integration flow development, monitoring, troubleshooting, and operations.
* SAP API Management for API exposure, proxy configuration, policy enforcement, and API lifecycle governance where applicable.
* Trading Partner Management and B2B capabilities where applicable for EDI and partner integration scenarios.
* SAP Event Mesh or event-driven integration concepts where applicable.
* SAP Cloud Connector, destinations, secure connectivity, OAuth, certificates, PGP/encryption, SFTP keys, principal propagation, and network/security coordination.
* Operational monitoring, alerting, retry/reprocess procedures, interface runbooks, production support handover, and COE enablement.

Testing, Validation, Cutover, and Hypercare Responsibilities
  
  

* Support test preparation by creating integration test cases, test data needs, expected results, and interface readiness criteria.
* Support SIT1, SIT2, UAT, regression testing, performance testing, and integration validation using SAP Cloud ALM or approved project tools.
* Support GxP/CSV-aware delivery where applicable, including controlled documentation, traceability, test evidence, defect resolution notes, and approval support.
* Support cutover planning, endpoint readiness, certificate/key validation, partner readiness, job scheduling, interface freeze windows, mock cutover, production cutover, and post-load reconciliation.
* Provide hypercare support including triage, root cause analysis, monitoring, reprocessing, issue closure, knowledge transfer, and support handover documentation.

Nice to Have

description:
