title: Chief Technology Officer
description:
About Moative

Moative is an AI diffusion company. We partner with midmarket companies in asset-heavy, regulated industries to co-build deeply industry-specific agentic and machine learning solutions, which then get diffused across the industry through revenue-share and equity-linked models.

**Our Past**

: We have built and sold two companies, one of which was an AI company. Our founders and leaders are Math PhDs, Ivy League University Alumni, Ex-Googlers, and successful entrepreneurs.

**Team**

: Our team of 20+ employees consists of data scientists, AI/ML Engineers, and mathematicians from top engineering and research institutes such as IITs, CERN, IISc, UZH. Our team includes academicians, IBM Research Fellows, and former founders. This role leads technology for our healthcare business, working alongside forward-deployed engineers, data scientists and revenue cycle operators to build an AI management services organization (AI MSO) for US healthcare practices.

Work you’ll do

We are building an AI management services organization (AI MSO) for US healthcare practices. We combine operational expertise, data infrastructure and AI to manage and improve revenue cycle and administrative workflows. We automate suitable tasks progressively, with clear controls and human accountability for exceptions and consequential decisions.

As CTO, you will own the technology strategy, platform architecture and engineering organization behind this business. You will work with our founders, practice owners and billing leaders to decide what to build, which workflows to prioritize and how to measure results. You will remain hands-on in architecture, prototypes, code reviews and difficult production problems.

You will build a reusable platform that connects practice systems, supports reliable automation and captures operational learning across engagements, while maintaining appropriate separation of each practice’s data. The work includes payer-portal agents, voice-based payer follow-up, claim-journey analysis, denial management and payment-posting workflows.

Technical leads will own day-to-day pod delivery within the direction you set. You will resolve major technical trade-offs, develop those leaders and remain accountable for platform quality, reliability and technical risk.

Responsibilities

* Own technology strategy, platform architecture and engineering standards for the healthcare AI MSO.
* Work with founders, practice owners and billing leaders to assess workflows, establish baselines and prioritize investments by business value, feasibility and dependencies.
* Lead product and platform decisions, balancing practice-specific requirements with capabilities that can be reused across customers and specialties.
* Design solutions across EHRs, practice-management systems, clearinghouses and payer portals, connecting data pipelines, AI agents and operator workflows.
* Define the practice data architecture, integrating claims, remittances, EOBs, denial codes and operational records into validated, traceable data with clear access controls and isolation between practices.
* Separate operational data that requires patient identifiers from de-identified analytical datasets, and define approved uses of each.
* Stay hands-on through architecture and code reviews, targeted prototypes and resolution of complex production issues.
* Make build-versus-buy, vendor and model decisions based on reliability, security, cost and business value.
* Establish technical controls for healthcare privacy, security and compliance, working with legal, compliance and client stakeholders on approved data flows, retention, vendor access and incident response.
* Set production evaluation and release criteria, including monitoring, human escalation, recovery procedures and ownership of failures.
* Own engineering and infrastructure budgets, platform operating costs and investment in reusable capabilities.
* Hire, develop and retain engineers, data scientists and technical leads, with clear accountability for quality and delivery.
* Represent Moative’s technology with practice owners, partners and investors, explaining technical choices and their implications for practice economics.

Who you are

You are a technology leader who has built products and remains close to engineering. You can decide what to build with a practice owner, examine an architecture with an engineer and explain investment choices to an executive or investor.

You have worked with fragmented operational systems, inconsistent data and workflows that depend on people’s judgment. You investigate how work is actually done before deciding what to automate, and you understand that reliable data and clear processes are foundations for useful AI.

You have built and scaled products or a technology business, made decisions with incomplete information and stayed accountable for customer adoption and commercial outcomes. You can develop strong technical leaders while stepping into difficult engineering problems when needed.

You want to build the technology foundation of an AI MSO and take responsibility for how it performs as the business grows.

Skills & Requirements

Must have

* At least 15 years of relevant engineering and technology leadership experience, with recent hands-on involvement in architecture, solution design, prototyping and production troubleshooting.
* Experience building and scaling a product or technology business in a founding, CTO or senior engineering leadership role, with clear evidence of customer adoption, commercial outcomes and your own contribution.
* Experience owning product and technology decisions from customer discovery through production, adoption and ongoing improvement.
* Deep experience integrating, cleaning and modeling fragmented operational data, including building reusable platforms serving multiple customers with clear data isolation and access boundaries.
* Experience leading teams that deploy and support AI in live operations, including LLM-based applications or agents, with evaluation, monitoring and human escalation.
* Strong Python, SQL and cloud architecture skills across at least one platform—AWS, Azure or GCP—with the ability to review code, challenge designs and build prototypes.
* Experience delivering healthcare or RCM products, with practical understanding of billing workflows, claim submission, payer interactions, denials, appeals and payment posting.
* Experience establishing technical controls for sensitive healthcare data, including access management, audit trails, secure logging, vendor access and incident response.
* Experience building engineering and data teams, hiring senior technical leaders and establishing engineering standards.
* Experience owning technology budgets, vendor decisions and operating costs, and explaining investment trade-offs in business terms.
* Experience working directly with CXOs, founders and investors to agree priorities, resolve conflicting expectations and communicate technical risk.
* Ability to demonstrate a product you chose to build, the architecture and team you developed, the trade-offs you made and the results achieved.

Preferred experience

* Experience building for US outpatient practices, MSOs or RCM companies, including working with US billing teams and payer workflows.
* Experience taking a company through an acquisition, merger or other successful exit, including technical diligence and transition responsibilities.
* Experience turning services engagements or client-specific solutions into reusable products and platforms.
* Experience with healthcare data exchange and integrations involving claims, remittances, EHRs, practice-management systems or clearinghouses.
* Experience with process mining, operational knowledge systems or adapting smaller models for domain-specific tasks.
* Experience building browser automation or voice agents for operational workflows.

**Location: Chennai or Bangalore.**

Chennai preferred. This role involves regular in-person collaboration with our founders and the healthcare AI pod.

Working at Moative

Moative is a young company, but we believe strongly in thinking long-term, while acting with urgency. Our ethos is rooted in innovation, efficiency and high-quality outcomes. We believe the future of work is AI-augmented and boundaryless. Here are some of our guiding principles:

* **Think in decades. Act in hours.**

  As an independent company, our moat is time. While our decisions are for the long-term horizon, our execution will be fast – measured in hours and days, not weeks and months.
* **Own the canvas.**

  Throw yourself in to build, fix or improve – anything that isn’t done right, irrespective of who did it. Be selfish about improving across the organization – because once the rot sets in, we waste years in surgery and recovery.
* **Use data or don’t use data.**

  Use data where you ought to but not as a ‘cover-my-back’ political tool. Be capable of making decisions with partial or limited data. Get better at intuition and pattern-matching. Whichever way you go, be mostly right about it.
* **Avoid work about work**

  . Process creeps on purpose, unless we constantly question it. We are deliberate about committing to rituals that take time away from the actual work. We truly believe that a meeting that could be an email, should be an email and you don’t need a person with the highest title to say that out loud.
* **High revenue per person.**

  We work backwards from this metric. Our default is to automate instead of hiring. We multi-skill our people to own more outcomes than hiring someone who has less to do. We don’t like squatting and hoarding that comes in the form of hiring for growth. High revenue per person comes from high quality work from everyone. We demand it.

We’d love to hear about a product you helped build and scale, ideally in healthcare or another regulated, data-intensive industry—covering the customer problem, key decisions, team, challenges, results, and your role. Founding or exit experience is welcome. Please share only authorized information; anonymized examples work well.

title: Manager - Navigation & Control
description:
**About Planys Technologies**

Planys Technologies is a next-gen defence technology startup building intelligent autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) and maritime robotic systems that give naval and security forces a real-time, machine-driven picture of the undersea battlespace. Inspired by the pace, ambition, and product mindset of modern defence innovators, we are designing persistent, ROVs, AUVs, and hybrid surface vessel edge-compute heavy payloads, and advanced undersea sensing that turn oceans into knowledgeable, navigable, and defendable environments.

Engineers and researchers work like full-stack product teams: shaping hydrodynamics and propulsion, architecting navigation and perception stacks, and building autonomy and mission-systems software that must perform in GPS-denied, low-comms, high-risk conditions. You will see your code and hardware leave the lab quickly, iterate through real sea trials, and plug into high-impact naval, coastal security, and strategic deterrence missions in India and beyond. You’ll be part of a small, high-caliber team empowered to move fast, take end-to-end ownership, and push the boundaries of what underwater systems can sense, decide, and achieve in one of the most demanding environments on Earth.

**Job Description**

We are looking for a Manager – Navigation & Control to design, develop, integrate, and validate navigation and control systems for autonomous underwater vehicles.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Design and implement navigation algorithms (INS, DVL, USBL aiding, EKF/UKF sensor fusion) for AUV platforms operating in GPS-denied environments.
* Develop and tune guidance and control systems, including autopilots, path-following (LOS, Pure Pursuit), station-keeping, and depth/heading controllers.
* Build high-fidelity simulation environments for algorithm validation, including Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing.
* Integrate and calibrate navigation sensors, including IMU, DVL, USBL, pressure sensors, and magnetometers, on vehicle hardware.
* Implement real-time GNC software on embedded Linux platforms with deterministic timing requirements.
* Develop harbour-to-harbour navigation, mission planning, and waypoint management modules, and integrate them with the vehicle autonomy stack.
* Analyse and resolve navigation and control anomalies using sea-trial data, and drive post-trial reviews.
* Define and execute verification and validation (V&V) plans for GNC subsystems against system-level requirements.
* Support system-level integration, sea trials, and field deployments, and troubleshoot vehicle behaviour on-site.
* Collaborate with mechanical, electrical, and software teams on vehicle-level design trade-offs and interface definitions.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including algorithm design documents, test reports, and calibration procedures.
* Create and track team work plans, mentor junior engineers, and provide technical guidance.

**Required Skills**

* Strong mathematical and analytical background.
* Strong knowledge of navigation, estimation, sensor fusion, and control systems.
* Proficiency in C/C++ and Python.
* Experience with ROS/ROS2, Linux, Git, and simulation tools.
* Knowledge of INS, DVL, USBL, EKF/UKF, PID, LQR/MPC.
* Experience with robotic or autonomous systems.
* Strong problem-solving and teamwork skills.

**Qualification**

* M.Tech / M.S. / Ph.D. in Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Ocean Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Robotics, or related fields.
* 4–8 years of relevant experience in navigation, guidance, and control for robotic/autonomous systems.
* Experience in marine or underwater robotics is preferred.
* Research/thesis experience in navigation, control, or state estimation is an added advantage.

  Integrate AI into existing APIs, web apps, and internal services (assistants, automations, copilots).
* **Full stack:**
  Own simple full-stack slices: backend endpoints, data stores, background jobs, and a clean frontend for internal tools and product UI.
* **Model choice:**
  Compare models and vendors (hosted APIs vs open-source), and choose based on quality, latency, and cost.
* **Quality and safety:**
  Add logging, basic evals, fallbacks, and practical safety (PII, wrong answers, access control).
* **Delivery:**
  Turn a vague product idea into a scoped MVP, then harden it for real use.
* **Cloud:**
  Build and run these systems on AWS.

**What you need to know:**

**Must have:**

* **Experience:**
  1–2 years of professional software or AI engineering. Strong internships or real shipped projects count.
* **LLMs:**
  Hands-on LLM work: prompting, function/tool calling, RAG, embeddings. LangChain / LlamaIndex or equivalent custom pipelines.
* **Voice:**
  Practical speech/voice experience, or a clear ability to get there quickly (Whisper or similar STT, audio pipelines).
* **Backend:**
  Python and/or Node.js, REST APIs, async jobs, Postgres or similar.
* **Frontend:**
  React or similar, enough to build internal tools and product screens.
* **Tooling:**
  Git, Linux, Docker, and third-party AI APIs (OpenAI, AWS, or self-hosted models).
* **AWS:**
  Working knowledge of AWS (for example S3, Lambda, EC2, ECS, SQS, or equivalent services you have actually used).
* **Communication:**
  Clear written English. Able to scope and ship without a fully written spec.

**Nice-to-haves:**

* Real-time voice (WebRTC, websocket audio, live captions).
* Agents that call tools and write back to systems, not chat-only demos.
* Vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone, Qdrant, or similar).
* FastAPI / Express / Nest, websockets, background workers.
* Prompt versioning, eval harnesses, cost/latency tracking.
* Deeper AWS experience (Bedrock, Transcribe, SageMaker, IAM, CloudWatch).

**Education:**

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.

title: AI Engineer
description:
**Career Area**
Technology, Digital and Data
  
  
**Job Description**
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
Caterpillar IT is at the forefront of enabling Caterpillar’s digital transformation, delivering technology solutions that support our global business, manufacturing operations, products, and customers. We leverage data, cloud technologies, advanced analytics, AI, and modern software engineering to build secure, scalable, and innovative solutions that improve operational efficiency and help Caterpillar build a better, more sustainable world.
  
  
Build the Digital Backbone of Modern Manufacturing
  
  
We’re assembling a dynamic team to develop and scale our Manufacturing & Supply Digital Platform—a next-generation software framework that transforms how manufacturing and supply operations connect, collaborate, and optimize.
  
  
This platform is not an ERP system. It’s a purpose-built digital layer that integrates data, processes, and resources across the entire manufacturing lifecycle—from design and engineering to production and distribution.
  
  
This initiative is powered by NVIDIA technologies, including the Omniverse platform and AI computing capabilities, enabling immersive digital twins, accelerated simulation, and intelligent automation. You’ll be part of a team that’s not just building software—but shaping the future of how manufacturing works through AI-driven, collaborative, and scalable digital solutions.
  
  
**As Part Of This Initiative, You’ll Contribute To**

* System Integration: Seamlessly connecting diverse manufacturing and supply systems, data sources, and workflows into a unified digital ecosystem.
* Data-Driven Decision Making: Harnessing real-time data collection, analysis, and visualization to deliver actionable insights and operational intelligence.
* Automation & Optimization: Driving efficiency through intelligent scheduling, AI Agents, predictive maintenance, and quality control—without replacing core transactional systems.
* Enhanced Collaboration: Enabling transparent communication and coordination across teams, functions, and geographies.

If you're passionate about digital platforms, industrial innovation, and working with cutting-edge technologies—this is your opportunity to make a meaningful impact.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Build, integrate, and optimize AI Assistants and agent-based solutions capable of retrieving information, executing workflows, and supporting business processes through natural language interactions.
* Develop and maintain integrations with enterprise data sources, APIs, knowledge bases, document repositories, and business applications to enable accurate and context-aware AI experiences.
* Implement prompt engineering, grounding, retrieval, memory management, and agent orchestration techniques to improve response quality, reliability, and user experience.
* Develop document ingestion, metadata extraction, chunking, indexing, and knowledge management pipelines to support enterprise search and AI Assistant capabilities.
* Evaluate, test, and optimize AI solutions using techniques such as prompt tuning, model selection, caching, reranking, and retrieval optimization to improve accuracy, latency, and cost efficiency.
* Collaborate with product, engineering, and domain teams to define requirements, translate business needs into AI capabilities, and deliver production-ready solutions.
* Implement observability, monitoring, evaluation, and feedback mechanisms to measure AI Assistant performance, identify issues, and drive continuous improvement.
* Support deployment, productionization, and operational readiness activities, including security, entitlements, access controls, auditability, and governance requirements.
* Stay current with advancements in LLMs, agent frameworks, RAG architectures, vector databases, knowledge graphs, and AI platform technologies, and contribute to the adoption of relevant capabilities.

**Required Skills**

* Experience with Agentic AI frameworks such as LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar orchestration platforms.
* Familiarity with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, vector databases (Milvus, Pinecone) and enterprise knowledge base implementations.
* Experience building and deploying AI Assistants, Copilots, or conversational AI solutions for business or operational use cases.
* Exposure to agent orchestration, tool calling, workflow automation, and multi-agent systems.
* Deep expertise in Python especially with PyTorch/TensorFlow (model training, fine-tuning for vision, text, and audio; Supervised, Unsupervised, Reinforcement learning experience is a plus).
* Knowledge of Machine Learning techniques: anomaly detection, predictive analytics

**Nice To Have Skills**

* Knowledge of document ingestion, OCR, metadata extraction, and document processing frameworks such as Textract, Docling, or equivalent technologies.
* Understanding of LLM evaluation, observability, prompt engineering, and responsible AI practices.
* Familiarity with Graph databases, Knowledge Graphs, and Ontology-based retrieval and reasoning.
* Experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise platforms through REST APIs, FastAPI, microservices, and event-driven architectures.
* Exposure to cloud-based AI services such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Amazon Textract, Azure AI Foundry, or similar platforms.
* Knowledge of security concepts including OAuth, OIDC, RBAC, entitlements, auditability, and enterprise AI governance.

**Educational Background:**
Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree, preferably in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, mathematics, or a similar field with quantitative coursework, and 4-5 years of professional experience utilizing quantitative analysis, a Master’s degree and 2-3 years of experience.
  
  
This position requires working onsite five days a week.
  
  
Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.
  
  
**Posting Dates**
October 22, 2026 - October 25, 2026
  
  
Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

title: Director AI – Enterprise AI, Generative AI & Agentic Platforms
description:
Role Overview

Our company is seeking an accomplished
**Head of AI Division**
to lead its enterprise-wide Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Intelligent Automation initiatives. This is a senior leadership position responsible for defining the AI vision, building and scaling AI capabilities, establishing enterprise AI platforms, and driving measurable business transformation across the organization's engineering, product, and operational ecosystems.

The ideal candidate will bring 20+ years of experience across software engineering, enterprise architecture, technology leadership, and platform development, including substantial hands-on experience in designing and deploying production-grade AI and Generative AI solutions.

The role requires a unique combination of executive leadership, deep technical expertise, product and business acumen, and the ability to transform emerging AI technologies into secure, scalable, and commercially valuable enterprise solutions.

The Head of AI Division will work closely with executive leadership, Engineering, Product, Operations, Architecture, and Customer Success teams to establish AI as a strategic organizational capability, accelerate innovation, improve engineering productivity, and deliver sustainable business value.

Key Responsibilities

1. Enterprise AI Strategy & Business Transformation

* Define and execute Solartis' enterprise AI strategy, vision, and multi-year transformation roadmap.
* Identify opportunities to leverage Generative AI, Agentic AI, intelligent automation, and AI-powered decision systems across products and business functions.
* Translate business objectives into scalable AI initiatives with clearly defined outcomes, investment priorities, and measurable ROI.
* Establish enterprise AI reference architectures, technology standards, implementation frameworks, and reusable accelerators.
* Advise executive leadership on AI adoption, emerging technologies, investment priorities, opportunities, and associated risks.
* Drive an AI-first engineering and product development culture across the organization.

2. AI Division Leadership & Organizational Development

* Build, lead, and scale a high-performing AI division comprising AI architects, AI/ML engineers, Generative AI specialists, platform engineers, and research or innovation teams.
* Define the organizational structure, operating model, hiring strategy, capability development plans, and performance expectations for the AI division.
* Establish clear ownership and accountability across AI strategy, architecture, engineering, platform development, and production operations.
* Mentor senior technical leaders and develop a strong leadership pipeline within the AI organization.
* Foster collaboration across Engineering, Product, Security, Infrastructure, Operations, and business stakeholders.
* Manage resource allocation, delivery priorities, technology investments, and AI program budgets.

3. Enterprise Generative AI & Foundation Model Strategy

* Lead the evaluation, selection, architecture, and enterprise adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), and open-source foundation models.

* Drive the adoption of platforms and technologies such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini, Llama, Mistral, and other relevant foundation models.

* Oversee enterprise knowledge assistants, AI copilots, intelligent search solutions, and domain-specific AI applications.
* Establish standards for data access, source attribution, information security, and evaluation of knowledge-grounded AI systems.

5. Agentic AI & Intelligent Automation

* Define the enterprise roadmap for autonomous AI agents, multi-agent systems, and intelligent workflow orchestration.
* Lead the design and deployment of AI systems capable of planning, reasoning, tool use, task execution, and controlled decision support.
* Drive Agentic AI adoption across software engineering, testing, customer support, business operations, and relevant domain-specific workflows.
* Establish frameworks for agent orchestration, memory management, human-in-the-loop controls, exception handling, and safe execution.
* Define standards for agent observability, evaluation, access control, governance, and operational reliability.
* Ensure that autonomous workflows operate within clearly defined business rules, permissions, and accountability boundaries.

6. AI Platform Engineering & Production Delivery

* Own the architecture, engineering, deployment, and scaling of enterprise AI platforms in production environments.
* Establish engineering practices for MLOps, LLMOps, and AgentOps, including CI/CD, model lifecycle management, testing, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Drive the development of production-ready AI applications using robust APIs, microservices, distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native platforms.
* Establish end-to-end AI evaluation frameworks covering quality, accuracy, reliability, security, latency, scalability, and cost.
* Ensure AI solutions meet enterprise requirements for availability, resilience, performance, maintainability, and operational support.
* Maintain strong technical oversight of critical architecture decisions, engineering standards, and production implementations.

7. AI-Powered Engineering Transformation

* Lead enterprise-wide adoption of AI-assisted software development and intelligent engineering workflows.
* Drive AI-enabled code generation, code review, automated testing, documentation, developer assistance, and DevOps automation.
* Partner with engineering leadership to identify productivity bottlenecks and establish measurable improvements in software delivery.
* Develop frameworks to assess AI-assisted engineering quality, developer productivity, defect reduction, and delivery efficiency.
* Promote responsible adoption of AI development tools while maintaining software quality, intellectual property protection, and security standards.

8. AI Governance, Security & Responsible AI

* Establish enterprise AI governance frameworks covering responsible AI, privacy, security, risk management, and regulatory compliance.
* Define policies for model access, data protection, prompt injection mitigation, sensitive information handling, and AI application security.
* Ensure appropriate human oversight, auditability, explainability, and traceability for AI-assisted and agent-driven decisions.
* Partner with Security, Legal, Compliance, and Architecture teams to establish risk-based controls for enterprise AI adoption.

* Lead AI innovation programs, technology incubation, proofs of concept, and enterprise-scale pilots.

* Establish strategic technology partnerships and guide build-versus-buy decisions.
* Convert promising AI experiments into scalable production capabilities with clear adoption and business-value criteria.

* Define measurable business cases for AI initiatives and track their impact on productivity, operating costs, quality, customer experience, and revenue opportunities.

title: Robotic Engineer - Internship

AerX Space Labs

Robotics, Autonomous Systems & AI

Robotics Design & Development Intern

Chennai, Tamil Nadu

3–6 Months

Engineering students, final-year students and recent graduates

Full-time / Project-based

AerX Space Labs is focused on developing next-generation intelligent robotic and autonomous systems, including aerial drones, quadruped robotic dogs, autonomous ground robots and underwater robotic platforms.

We are looking for
**highly motivated, technically capable and hands-on robotics interns**

4. AI & Computer Vision Integration

Students pursuing or recently completing:

* B.E./B.Tech – Robotics & Automation

* Mechanical Engineering
* Electronics & Communication Engineering
* Electrical & Electronics Engineering
* Computer Science / Artificial Intelligence

Students from other disciplines with demonstrated robotics project experience are also welcome.

title: Junior APC Engineer - Process Optimisation Application (PXP)
description:

At Fuller Technologies, momentum isn’t a slogan — it’s how we work. For over 140 years, we’ve improved the systems that keep the cement industry running: optimizing processes, reducing friction, and elevating performance. That mindset shapes not only our solutions — but how we operate as a company.
  
  
When you join Fuller, you’re joining a team that supports your growth and values your contribution. You’ll find the stability of a global organization and the agility of one that’s actively expanding — a place where your career can accelerate alongside the business.
  
  
If you want to move forward with a company that brings its people with it — Fuller is where that happens.
  
  
**About The Role**
For more than 140 years, Fuller Technologies has helped industrial producers solve complex process challenges and operate more efficiently, reliably, and sustainably. Our success is built on two foundations:
  
  
engineering excellence and long-standing partnerships with our customers.
  
  
As a Junior APC Engineer, you will carry this legacy forward by applying advanced process control, analytics, and AI/ML technologies to cement and mining operations worldwide. At Fuller, APC engineering is not just about control algorithms — it is about understanding the process, earning customer trust, and delivering performance that lasts.
  
  
You will be part of Fullers Process Optimisation Team, working with the ECS/ProcessExpert® APC toolbox and advanced control techniques such as MPC and AI/ML. Your role focuses on delivering APC and soft-sensor solutions that stabilise plant operations, improve throughput, and reduce energy and fuel consumption. This is a hands-on technical role with responsibility across the full APC project lifecycle — from processanalysis and model development to commissioning, optimisation, and long-term performance support.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities:**

* Perform process and data analysis using historical and real-time data from cement and minerals plants to identify optimisation opportunities.
* Design, develop, test, and deploy predictive models and soft sensors using linear and nonlinear AI/ML algorithms. Implement, validate, and maintain real-time APC applications using MPC, AI/ML, fuzzy logic, and PID control strategies.
* Estimate and quantify process improvement benefits using data analytics, supporting performance guarantees and technical proposals.
* Adapt, tune, and retrain models and controllers to ensure sustained performance and operational stability. Define and implement process control strategies, including configuration and commissioning of APC solutions.
* Fine-tune MPC, fuzzy, and PID controllers to achieve guaranteed performance targets related to productivity, energy efficiency, and stability.
* Support system integration activities, including hardware selection, software installation, and connectivity with PLCs, DCS, and historians.
* Collaborate with project managers and customer teams to ensure APC projects are delivered on schedule and to specification.
* Provide training and technical mentoring to customer engineers on data analytics and AI/ML applications within the ECS/ProcessExpert® platform.
* Evaluate emerging developments in advanced analytics and non-linear modelling to continuously improve APC applications.
* Contribute across the broader APC lifecycle, including sales support, product development, feature testing, and service support as required.

**You bring**

* Strong hands-on experience in Advanced Process Control, Data Analytics, Machine Learning, and AI applied to industrial processes.
* Proven experience in data mining, statistical modelling, model deployment, and real-time implementation.
* Background in process manufacturing industries; cement and minerals process knowledge is a strong advantage.
* Solid understanding of process optimisation, control strategy development, and benefit analysis.
* Experience with industrial data connectivity and historians, including SQL, MQTT, PLCs, DCS, and modern data platforms.
* Familiarity with AI/ML and data analytics tools commonly used in process industries, including: Python, Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn, TensorFlow, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Databricks
* Willingness to travel (50–70%) within India and internationally for commissioning, pilot testing, customer engagement, and training.

*As an equal opportunity employer, Fuller Technologies embraces diversity and equality by promoting an environment of inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply irrespective of sex, gender identity/expression, disability, sexual orientation, or age. The more diverse our employees are, the stronger our team is.*
**Application and contact**
Please apply by clicking “apply” on this page. Kindly note that we will be reviewing applications and conducting interviews - also on a virtual setting as required - on an ongoing basis so please apply as soon as possible.
  
  
No recruiters and unsolicited agency referrals, please.
  
  
**Build a better world**
Fuller Technologies helps build societies all over the world by contributing to the infrastructure needed for global economic growth. It is a big responsibility, and we are committed to driving growth while minimising environmental impact. To achieve this, your skills, your curiosity, and your drive for change are important. Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
  
  
**Global Business Services\***
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview\***
Global Operations Technology and Client Data Platforms: Development / Support/ testing of the technology solutions for the bank’s Marketing line of business applications.
  
  
**Job Description\***
The Analytics and Intelligence Engine (AIE) team transforms analytical and operational data into Consumer and Wealth Client insights and enables personalization opportunities that are provided to Associate and Customer-facing operational applications. The Big data technologies used in this are Hadoop /PySpark / Scala, HQL as ETL, Unix as file Landing environment, and real time streaming applications, like Spark Streaming, Kafka.
  
  
We are actively seeking a skilled Senior Hadoop Developer to develop and maintain insights, with strong technical expertise in Hadoop and related technologies, and who excels at collaborating with both onshore and offshore team members. The role requires both hands-on coding and collaboration with stakeholders to drive strategic design decisions. While functioning as an individual contributor for one or more teams, the Senior Hadoop Data Engineer may also lead and take responsibility for end-to-end solution design and delivery, based on the scale of implementation and required skillsets.
  
  
**Responsibilities\***

* Develop high-performance and scalable solutions for Insights, using the Big Data platform to facilitate the collection, storage, and analysis of massive data sets from multiple channels.
* Utilize your in-depth knowledge of Hadoop stack and storage technologies, including HDFS, Spark, Scala, MapReduce, Yarn, Hive, Sqoop, Impala, Hue, and Oozie, to design and optimize data processing workflows.
* Implement Near real-time and Streaming data solutions to provide up-to-date information to millions of Bank customers using Spark Streaming, Kafka.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify system bottlenecks, benchmark performance, and propose innovative solutions to enhance system efficiency.
* Take ownership of defining Big Data strategies and roadmaps for Enterprise, aligning them with business objectives.
* Apply your expertise in NoSQL technologies like MongoDB, SingleStore, or HBase to efficiently handle diverse data types and storage requirements.
* Stay abreast of emerging technologies and industry trends related to Big Data, continuously evaluating new tools and frameworks for potential integration.
* Provide guidance and mentorship to junior teammates.

**Education\***

* Graduation / Post Graduation

+ B.E. / B. Tech/M.E. /M. Tech/ MCA

* Certifications If Any:

+ Not Mandatory

**Experience Range\***

* 15+ Years

**Foundational Skills\***

* Must have 15+ years of application development experience, focused on hands-on work in the Big Data domain.
* Highly skilled in Hadoop stack technologies, such as Spark, Hive, Yarn, Sqoop, Impala, Hue, HDFS.
* Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Scala, and Bash/Shell Scripting.
* Excellent problem-solving abilities and the capability to deliver effective solutions for business-critical applications.
* Must understand common Hadoop architectural patterns, design patterns, frameworks and programming best practices, automations.
* Support production incident troubleshooting and planned application production releases.
* Must be able to work with Product Owners to translate business requirements into technical requirements and explain to the offshore developers, as required.
* Should understand common non-functional requirements, such as those related to security, compliance, operations/ resiliency, scalability, automation etc.
* Having experience mentoring relatively junior and/or peer developers in a technical sense is a further plus.

**Desired skills\***

* Effective communication, Strong stakeholder engagement skills, Proven ability in leading and mentoring a team of software engineers in a dynamic environment.

* Having experience leading development teams in any capacity.

* Chennai

title: Specialist - Corporate Audit
description:
**Company Profile**
**Lennox (NYSE: LII)**
Driven by 130 years of legacy, HVAC and refrigeration success, Lennox provides our residential and commercial customers with industry-leading climate-control solutions. At Lennox, we win as a team, aiming for excellence and delivering innovative, sustainable products and services. Our culture guides us and creates a workplace where all employees feel heard and welcomed. Lennox is a global community that values each team member’s contributions and offers a supportive environment for career development. Come, stay, and grow with us.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Objective**
The Data Analytics Specialist will support the Corporate Audit function by developing and executing data analytics solutions to enable risk-based audits, SOX compliance, fraud detection, continuous auditing, and ERM initiatives. The role will focus on
**leveraging analytics-related tools**
(e.g., IDEA, Alteryx, Azure) and
**SAP data**
to deliver actionable insights and scalable audit analytics.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Audit Data Analytics & Automation**

* Design, develop, and maintain models and/or workflows for audit analytics, fraud detection, SOX testing, and continuous auditing.
* Document the processes and procedures for models or workflows developed.
* Build, document, and maintain an inventory of audit analytics and use cases across business processes (e.g., P2P, O2C, Inventory, GL, etc.).
* Automate repetitive audit testing procedures to improve audit coverage and efficiency (e.g., test populations versus samples).
* Perform risk-based data analysis, including exception testing, trend analysis, and anomaly detection.

**Risk Monitoring, Fraud & ERM Support**

* Support fraud desk initiatives through advanced analytics and red flag identification using structured SAP data.
* Enable risk response monitoring aligned with ERM and Internal Audit priorities.
* Develop analytics to support management’s proactive risk identification and control effectiveness assessment.

**Technology & Data Enablement**

* Work directly with SAP source data (e.g., FI, MM, SD, Inventory modules) and ensure accurate data extraction and transformation.
* Leverage Azure or similar data platforms for large-scale risk analysis and enterprise analytics.
* Address data sourcing limitations and improve data reliability for audit consumption.
* Act as a subject-matter expert for analytics tools (e.g., IDEA and Alteryx), including workflow optimization and complexity review.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Partner with Internal Audit, Compliance, IT, Finance, and Supply Chain teams to understand risk areas and data availability.
* Provide clear visibility on analytics deliverables, scope, and outcomes to audit leadership.
* Support follow-up discussions with stakeholders on analytics-driven observations.

**Governance & Capability Building**

* Define standards and governance for audit analytics development and documentation.
* Review and validate complex models and workflows developed by the team to ensure quality and sustainability.
* Support training and mentoring of auditors on the use and interpretation of analytics.

**Qualifications**

* Requires a bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 5 - 7 Years of relevant experience in Data Analytics using Alteryx.

title: Specialist - Data Engineering
description:
**Role Description**
Location- Chennai, Bangalore
  
  
Experience - 5 to 8years
  
  
Shift- 2:30 pm to 12 am Hybrid
  
  
SAS Developer SAS to Snowflake Migration
  
  
**Job Description Data Analytics**
Role Snapshot
  
  
Role TitleSAS Lead Developer SAS Migration Specialist
  
  
FunctionData Analytics Data Modernisation
  
  
Experience 5 to 8 years with at 5 years handson in SAS
  
  
EngagementFulltime
  
  
Reports to Principal Architecture Data Analytics
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for an experienced SAS developer to join a legacy modernisation programme that is moving an established SAS estate onto Snowflake The person in this role will be the teams authority on what the existing SAS code actually does reading Base SAS and SAS macro programs tracing the data lineage behind them and translating that logic into Snowflake and modern ELT pipelines without changing business outcomes
  
  
This is a handson engineering role rather than a support role Expect to spend most of your time in code in reconciliation and in conversation with the business users who rely on the reports and datasets being migrated The work is well suited to someone who has lived inside a large SAS codebase and now wants to carry that knowledge into a cloud data platform
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Analyse and document the existing SAS estate Base SAS programs macros PROC SQL DATA steps scheduled jobs and stored processes and produce the code inventory complexity rating and dependency map that drive the migration wave plan
  
  
Convert SAS logic into equivalent Snowflake stored procedures and ELT pipelines preserving business rules joins aggregations formats and edgecase handling rather than reimplementing from assumption
  
  
Own data reconciliation between the SAS output and the Snowflake output build rowcount controltotal and recordlevel comparison scripts investigate breaks and sign off each migrated object against agreed tolerance
  
  
Reengineer SAS data access layers that read from files RDBMS sources and SAS datasets so they land in Snowflake through the programmes chosen ingestion pattern
  
  
Work with the architecture team on target data models translating SASera structures into curated Snowflake schemas that suit setbased processing
  
  
Tune migrated workloads for cost and performance warehouse sizing clustering pruning and query rewrites so that converted jobs meet or beat their existing batch windows
  
  
Engage report owners and business analysts to confirm interpretation of legacy logic retire redundant code instead of migrating it and support user acceptance testing through to cutover
  
  
Maintain migration artefacts mapping documents conversion standards test evidence and runbooks and mentor junior engineers on reading SAS code safely
  
  
MustHave Skills
  
  
Strong handson Base SAS SAS Macro PROC SQL and DATA step development including formats informats arrays hash objects and bygroup processing
  
  
Proven ability to read and reverseengineer undocumented longlived SAS programs and explain what they do in business terms
  
  
Advanced SQL with practical exposure to Snowflake virtual warehouses stages streams tasks time travel cloning and micropartition behaviour
  
  
Experience on at least one completed legacytocloud data migration with responsibility for validation and reconciliation not only code conversion
  
  
Working knowledge of Python or a comparable scripting language for conversion accelerators automated comparison and repetitive refactoring
  
  
Comfortable with version control structured testing and defect tracking in a deliverymanaged environment

title: Senior AI & Cloud Security Architect
description:
**Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.**
At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.
  
  
Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Genesys Global Security, Privacy & Compliance Centre of Excellence (COE SPC) provides expert security advisory services to Sales, Pre-Sales, Customers, and Partners. The team serves as the single point of contact for all security, privacy, and compliance-related customer engagements within the Genesys Cloud Business Unit.
  
  
**Role Summary**
We are seeking an experienced Senior
**AI Cloud Security Architect**
to join the Genesys Global Security, Privacy & Compliance Centre of Excellence (COE SPC) as a technical Security Subject Matter Expert (SME). This is a hands-on, customer-facing technical security role, not a compliance or GRC position. You will work closely with Sales, Engineering, Product Security, and Architecture teams to support consulting, customer audits, security assessments, technical reviews, executive briefings, and evidence-based engagements for Genesys Cloud.
  
  
As one of the team's technical security SMEs, you will apply your expertise in cloud security, AI security, and security controls to explain and defend the Genesys Cloud security, privacy, and compliance posture. You will interpret technical evidence, respond to complex security inquiries, defend security contractual terms, and engage directly with customers, partners, auditors, and executive stakeholders within the APAC region.
  
  
This role is highly consultative and requires excellent English communication and presentation skills. You will regularly represent Genesys Cloud during customer executive briefings, security workshops, webinars, conferences, partner events, and industry forums. You must be comfortable presenting complex technical security concepts to audiences ranging from security practitioners and architects to CISOs, CIOs, and other senior executives, both remotely and in person, to any of our global customers.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead customer-facing security discussions with customers, prospects, partners, auditors, and internal stakeholders on Genesys Cloud architecture, penetration testing, vulnerability management, remediation, privacy, compliance, and AI security.
* Provide technical consulting that maps Genesys Cloud security capabilities and controls to customer security, regulatory, and risk management requirements.
* Develop, validate, and present technical evidence demonstrating the effectiveness of controls across identity and access management, encryption, key management, network security, logging, monitoring, incident response, application security, AI security, and secure software development.
* Deliver technical deep dives, security workshops, and executive briefings for audiences ranging from security practitioners and auditors to CISOs, CIOs, and senior business leaders.
* Own complex customer security, privacy, and compliance matters and contractual security negotiations.
* Represent Genesys at strategic customer engagements, partner events, conferences, webinars, and industry forums across APAC, contributing to external security thought leadership.

**This Role Offers**

* A highly technical, customer-facing Cloud Security Architect role within a global Centre of Excellence.
* Collaboration with Engineering, Product Security, Architecture, Privacy, Compliance, and AI teams.
* Exposure to complex enterprise cloud environments and leading global customer security organisations.
* The opportunity to shape customer trust in Genesys Cloud and its AI capabilities through technical assurance, executive engagement, and industry representation.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 7+ experience cybersecurity, cloud security, application security, security architecture, or related technical security disciplines.
* Strong practical expertise in AWS security, cloud-native architectures, APIs, Kubernetes, and modern SaaS security models.

title: Distinguished, Software Engineering
description:
Role Summary
  
  
As a Distinguished Engineer in Walmart's Data & AI Organization, you are one of the most senior technical leaders responsible for defining the long-term architecture, strategy, and execution of enterprise-scale data, AI, and software platforms. You combine deep expertise in Data Engineering, Software Engineering, AI Platforms, Security, Governance, and Enterprise Architecture to build trusted, scalable, and AI-ready systems that power Walmart's customer, associate, and business experiences globally.
  
  
You operate with Executive-level influence, driving cross-organizational technology decisions, shaping engineering standards, and solving the most complex technical and business challenges. You are expected to be hands-on, leading architectural design, reviewing code, guiding platform strategy, driving security and compliance by design, and mentoring senior technical talent across the organization.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  
Enterprise Data & AI Strategy
  
  
Define and execute the multi-year technology vision for Data, AI, Agentic AI, Analytics, Real-Time Platforms, and Customer Data ecosystems.
  
  
Align platform strategy with Walmart's enterprise AI, data governance, privacy, cybersecurity, and business objectives.
  
  
Drive standardization, platformization, and modernization initiatives across multiple product and engineering organizations.
  
  
Architecture & Platform Leadership
  
  
Architect global-scale data and software platforms supporting batch, streaming, AI/ML, Agentic AI, and real-time processing workloads.
  
  
Design highly scalable, secure, resilient, and observable systems spanning Data Lakes, Data Products, APIs, Microservices, Event-Driven Architectures, and AI and Agentic Platforms.
  
  
Serve as the final technical authority on complex architectural decisions affecting multiple organizations and markets.
  
  
Security, Governance & Trust
  
  
Champion security-by-design, privacy-by-design, and responsible AI principles across platforms and products.
  
  
Establish enterprise standards for identity, access management, data governance, lineage, compliance, risk mitigation, and operational resilience.
  
  
Partner with Information Security, Privacy, Legal, and Infrastructure teams to ensure platforms meet regulatory and enterprise requirements.
  
  
Engineering Excellence
  
  
Raise the engineering bar across Data Engineering and Software Engineering disciplines.
  
  
Drive adoption of modern engineering practices including DevSecOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, Observability, Reliability Engineering, Testing Automation, and AI-assisted development.
  
  
Lead architecture reviews, code reviews, design reviews, and operational excellence initiatives
  
  
AI & Innovation Leadership
  
  
Enable enterprise-scale AI and Agentic AI capabilities through reusable platforms, metadata foundations, governance frameworks, evaluation systems, and secure integration patterns.
  
  
Drive innovation in areas such as intelligent automation, AI-ready data platforms, knowledge systems, and next-generation engineering productivity tools.
  
  
Influence the adoption of emerging technologies while balancing risk, scalability, maintainability, and business value.
  
  
Organizational Leadership
  
  
Mentor Principal, Staff, and Senior Engineers across the organization.
  
  
Build strong technical communities, promote knowledge sharing, and develop future engineering leaders.
  
  
Foster a culture of innovation, inclusion, continuous learning, and operational excellence.
  
  
What You’ll Bring
  
  
15+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, Distributed Systems, or Enterprise Architecture.
  
  
Proven expertise building and operating large-scale data platforms, real-time systems, and cloud-native applications.
  
  
Deep understanding of enterprise data architecture, AI/ML platforms, security architecture, governance, and software engineering best practices.
  
  
Strong hands-on coding experience in Java, Scala, Python, SQL, and modern cloud technologies.
  
  
Demonstrated success leading enterprise-wide architecture and platform transformations.
  
  
Experience influencing senior executives and driving alignment across large engineering organizations without direct authority.
  
  
Proven track record of mentoring senior technical leaders and scaling engineering excellence.
  
  
Experience building enterprise Data & AI platforms supporting analytics, personalization, customer intelligence, optimization, and Agentic AI solutions.
  
  
Expertise in data platform modernization, platform engineering, security engineering, and cloud transformation.
  
  
Experience operating across global markets and highly regulated environments.
  
  

* Contributions to patents, publications, open-source projects, or industry thought leadership. Previous experience as a Chief Architect, Distinguished Engineer, Fellow, or equivalent senior technical leadership role.

**About Walmart Global Tech**
Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We’re a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world’s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered.
  
  
We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail.
  
  
Work
  
  
Walmart’s culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our Chennai office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives.
  
  
**Benefits**
Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more.
  
  
Belonging
  
  
We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone.
  
  
At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included." By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is—and feels—included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. title: AI Quality Engineer, Safety and RAG - Assistant Vice President
description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced AI Quality Engineer to join our Retail and Wealth Risk Engineering team under the Enterprise Risk Technology platform. This role spans the full spectrum of modern AI quality engineering — from
**Agentic AI flow testing**
and
**RAG pipeline validation**
to
**AI safety, test automation**
, and
**performance & reliability engineering**
.
  
  
You will be the quality pillar for complex autonomous AI systems, ensuring they are
**safe, accurate, explainable, resilient, and production-ready**
at scale. This is a high-impact, highly technical role that requires both depth in AI/ML and breadth across testing disciplines.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Agentic AI Testing
  
  

* Design and execute end-to-end test strategies for Agentic AI pipelines, including single-agent and multi-agent workflows.
* Validate agent reasoning, planning, and decision-making chains (e.g., ReAct, Chain-of-Thought, Plan-and-Execute, Reflexion).
* Test tool-use correctness — ensuring agents invoke the right tools, with correct parameters, at the right time.
* Evaluate agent memory systems (short-term, long-term, episodic) for accuracy and context retention across sessions.
* Validate agent handoff and delegation logic in multi-agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., AutoGen, CrewAI, LangGraph).
* Test termination conditions, loop detection, and infinite loop prevention in autonomous agent loops.

RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) Testing
  
  

* Design comprehensive test strategies for end-to-end RAG pipelines — covering ingestion, chunking, embedding, retrieval, reranking, and generation stages.
* Validate retrieval accuracy and relevance — ensuring the correct context chunks are retrieved for a given query.
* Test embedding model quality and vector similarity thresholds across different document corpora.
* Evaluate faithfulness, groundedness, and answer relevance of generated responses using frameworks like RAGAS, TruLens, DeepEval.
* Test chunking strategies (fixed, semantic, hierarchical) for their impact on retrieval quality.
* Validate context window management — ensuring retrieved context does not exceed token limits or degrade generation quality.
* Conduct end-to-end regression testing when the underlying knowledge base, embedding model, or LLM changes.
* Test multi-turn conversational RAG for context coherence and citation accuracy across turns.

Test Automation
  
  

* Build and maintain automated test harnesses for Agentic and RAG systems, including agent trajectory replay, tool mock injection, and prompt simulation.
* Develop automated evaluation pipelines integrated into CI/CD workflows for continuous model and agent validation.
* Create data validation and data quality frameworks (using Great Expectations, Deequ, or custom tooling) for training, retrieval, and inference data.
* Build prompt regression suites to detect behavioral drift across LLM versions or prompt changes.
* Implement determinism and reproducibility tests for stochastic LLM-based decisions.
* Automate vector database validation — index integrity, embedding drift, and retrieval consistency checks.

**AI Safety & Security Testing**

* Conduct red-teaming and adversarial testing to uncover jailbreaks, prompt injection vulnerabilities, and goal misalignment in LLM-based systems.
* Test output guardrails and content filters for unsafe, biased, toxic, or out-of-scope model behavior.
* Validate privilege escalation controls — ensuring agents do not exceed permitted actions or access unauthorized resources.
* Perform data poisoning and backdoor attack simulations to assess model robustness.
* Evaluate models for bias, fairness, and discrimination using frameworks such as AI Fairness 360 and Aequitas.
* Test PII leakage and data privacy controls in RAG and agent pipelines in accordance with GDPR, CCPA, and internal data governance policies.
* Conduct security testing aligned with the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, including:

+ Prompt Injection (Direct & Indirect)
+ Insecure Output Handling
+ Training Data Poisoning
+ Insecure Plugin / Tool Design
+ Sensitive Information Disclosure

* Validate constitutional AI constraints, RLHF-aligned behavior boundaries, and system prompt integrity.
* Collaborate with cybersecurity teams on AI-specific threat modeling and vulnerability management.
* Maintain safety testing playbooks and document red-team findings with severity ratings and remediation recommendations.

Performance & Reliability Testing
  
  

* Define and execute load, stress, soak, and spike testing for AI-powered APIs, inference endpoints, and agent orchestration services.
* Measure and optimize end-to-end latency across RAG and agentic pipelines — from query to final response.
* Benchmark LLM inference throughput (tokens/second) and identify bottlenecks across model serving infrastructure.
* Test auto-scaling behavior of AI services under variable load conditions.
* Validate circuit breaker, retry, and fallback mechanisms in agentic and RAG systems for graceful degradation.
* Test vector database performance — query latency, index build time, and retrieval accuracy under high concurrency.
* Conduct cost efficiency analysis — measuring token consumption, API call costs, and infrastructure spend per agent task.
* Establish SLOs (Service Level Objectives) and SLAs for AI system availability, latency percentiles (P50, P95, P99), and error rates.
* Collaborate with MLOps teams to set up observability dashboards, monitoring alerts, and automated anomaly detection for production AI systems.
* Perform chaos engineering experiments to validate agent and RAG system resilience under infrastructure failures.

Domain Knowledge
  
  

* Deep understanding of RAG architecture patterns — naive RAG, advanced RAG, modular RAG.
* Solid grasp of agent design patterns: ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, Reflexion, MRKL, Mixture-of-Agents.
* Familiarity with AI safety and alignment principles (RLHF, Constitutional AI, guardrail layers).
* Knowledge of token economics, context management, and LLM cost optimization.
* Proficiency in performance engineering methodologies for distributed AI systems.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar agentic communication standards.
* Exposure to multi-modal agent testing (agents handling text, images, code, documents).
* Experience in regulated industries (banking, finance, healthcare) with strict compliance requirements.
* Familiarity with chaos engineering tools (Chaos Monkey, Gremlin, LitmusChaos).

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Master’s degree is a plus.

**Experience**

* 8+ years of experience in software or AI/ML quality engineering.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience with RAG systems, or Agentic AI.
* Proven experience building automated test frameworks for non-deterministic AI systems.
* Strong background in performance testing and AI safety/security assessments.

ConvergeCONSUMER™ is a product-driven business that combines differentiated consumer insights with robust prediction and optimization capabilities to help consumer-focused businesses improve decision-making and deliver personalized experiences to drive growth, consumer loyalty, and profitability. We operate with the speed and agility of a startup within the world’s largest professional services firm.

ConvergeCONSUMER’s suite of solutions helps consumer-facing businesses prosper in a world being re-shaped by convergence, where the lines between industries, competitors and collaborators, consumers and suppliers, and even human and artificial intelligence have blurred. title: Specialist, Technology - Software
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
  
  
**Group/Division**
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The LS-SWIFT division delivers high-throughput patterned wafer inspection systems that support advanced semiconductor manufacturing. Its mission is to provide industry-leading defect detection with optimal cost of ownership across a wide range of applications. LS systems enable precise, cost-effective inspection for cutting-edge process nodes, while SWIFT systems offer comprehensive macro inspection of all wafer surfaces—capabilities that are especially critical for advanced packaging, as well as logic, memory, and automotive applications.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Strong software architecture expertise designing complex, distributed, scalable, high-performance, and data-intensive systems.
* Experience across legacy and modern technology stacks, with the ability to evolve existing platforms and drive architectural improvements.
* Deep technical knowledge in one or more areas: enterprise architecture, cloud-native services, microservices, AI/ML infrastructure, big data platforms, or DevOps automation.
* Proven ability to design and deliver medium-to-large scale software systems in multi-developer, cross-functional environments.
* Strong systems thinking and analytical skills, capable of simplifying ambiguity, evaluating trade-offs, and solving complex technical challenges.
* Expertise in scalability, performance optimization, reliability, and future-proof software design, ensuring robust architectures, code quality, and maintainability.
* Ability to translate complex business and technical requirements into architecture, detailed designs, and executable engineering plans.
* Strong technical leadership and mentoring skills, influencing architects, senior engineers, and technical leads across organizations, geographies, and disciplines.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, effectively engaging both technical and non-technical stakeholders in global teams.
* Ownership-driven mindset with a focus on execution, innovation, and engineering excellence, leveraging modern development practices and AI-assisted engineering tools.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience building and architecting complex distributed systems.
* Familiarity with UI/UX design considerations in engineering applications.

**Technical Skills:**

* Programming: C#, C++, Java, Python, .NET
* Architectural Paradigms: Microservices, service-oriented architecture, modular monolith, layered architecture, event-driven architecture
* Legacy Modernization: Monolith decomposition, migration from thick-client/desktop stacks to modern service-based platforms, backend/frontend separationWorking knowledge of container technologies, orchestration frameworks (e.g., Kubernetes), and workflow automation.Strong grasp of software development best practices, CI/CD, and DevOps principles.
* Leadership & Communication: Demonstrated ability to lead and drive functional teams. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Passion for mentoring and developing engineering talent.

**Minimum Qualifications**
Doctorate (Academic) Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 6 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 8 years
  
  
**About KLA**
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges.
